crossrefs.raw: 赛五八6～7，太九14，十七21，徒十三2

refs.text_gb: 我所拣选的禁食，岂不是要松开凶恶的绳，解下轭上的索，使被欺压的自由出去，并折断一切的轭么？
refs.text_big5: 我所揀選的禁食，豈不是要鬆開兇惡的繩，解下軛上的索，使被欺壓的自由出去，並折斷一切的軛麼？
refs.text_en: Is this not the fast that I choose, / To loosen the bonds of wickedness, / To undo the bands of the yoke, / And to let the oppressed go free, / And to break every yoke?

refs.text_gb: 岂不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中；见赤身的，给他衣服遮体；顾恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏么？
refs.text_big5: 豈不是要把你的餅分給飢餓的人，將飄流的窮人接到你家中；見赤身的，給他衣服遮體；顧恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏麼？
refs.text_en: Is it not to divide your bread to the hungry, / And to bring the wandering poor home; / When you see the naked, to cover him, / And not to hide yourself from your own flesh?

refs.text_gb: 那时，约翰的门徒到耶稣跟前来，说，为什么我们和法利赛人常常禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食？
refs.text_big5: 那時，約翰的門徒到耶穌跟前來，說，為甚麼我們和法利賽人常常禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食？
refs.text_en: Then the disciples of John came to Him, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast much, but Your disciples do not fast?

refs.text_gb: 至于这一类的鬼，若不祷告禁食，它就不出来。
refs.text_big5: 至於這一類的鬼，若不禱告禁食，牠就不出來。
refs.text_en: But this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting.

refs.text_gb: 他们事奉主，禁食的时候，圣灵说，要为我分别巴拿巴和扫罗，去作我召他们所作的工。
refs.text_big5: 他們事奉主，禁食的時候，聖靈說，要為我分別巴拿巴和掃羅，去作我召他們所作的工。
refs.text_en: And as they were ministering to the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, Set apart for Me now Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.

refs.text_gb: 你们要小心，不可将你们的义行在人前，故意叫他们注视；不然，在你们诸天之上的父面前，你们就没有赏赐了。
refs.text_big5: 你們要小心，不可將你們的義行在人前，故意叫他們注視；不然，在你們諸天之上的父面前，你們就沒有賞賜了。
refs.text_en: But take care not to do your righteousness before men in order to be gazed at by them; otherwise, you have no reward with your Father who is in the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 你们祷告的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，因为他们爱站在会堂里，并十字街口祷告，为要叫人看见。我实在告诉你们，他们已经充分的得了他们的赏赐。
refs.text_big5: 你們禱告的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，因為他們愛站在會堂裏，並十字街口禱告，為要叫人看見。我實在告訴你們，他們已經充分的得了他們的賞賜。
refs.text_en: And when you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites, because they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners, so that they may be seen by men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward in full.

verses.text_gb: 但你禁食的时候，要油[Cra]你的头，洗你的脸，
verses.text_big5: 但你禁食的時候，要油[Cra]你的頭，洗你的臉，
verses.text_en: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
verses.text_gb_plain: 但你禁食的时候，要油你的头，洗你的脸，
verses.text_big5_plain: 但你禁食的時候，要油你的頭，洗你的臉，

refs.text_gb: 你的衣服当时常洁白，你的头上也不要缺少膏油。
refs.text_big5: 你的衣服當時常潔白，你的頭上也不要缺少膏油。
refs.text_en: Let your garments always be white, and do not let oil be lacking on your head.

verses.text_gb: 为要不叫人，只叫你在隐[Cra]密中的父，看出你在禁食；你父在隐密中察看，必要报答你。
verses.text_big5: 為要不叫人，只叫你在隱[Cra]密中的父，看出你在禁食；你父在隱密中察看，必要報答你。
verses.text_en: So that you may not appear to men to be fasting, but to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will repay you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 为要不叫人，只叫你在隐密中的父，看出你在禁食；你父在隐密中察看，必要报答你。
verses.text_big5_plain: 為要不叫人，只叫你在隱密中的父，看出你在禁食；你父在隱密中察看，必要報答你。

refs.text_gb: 好叫你的施舍可在隐密中，你父在隐密中察看，必要报答你。
refs.text_big5: 好叫你的施捨可在隱密中，你父在隱密中察看，必要報答你。
refs.text_en: So that your alms may be in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will repay you.

refs.text_gb: 你祷告的时候，要进你的密室，关上门，祷告你在隐密中的父，你父在隐密中察看，必要报答你。
refs.text_big5: 你禱告的時候，要進你的密室，關上門，禱告你在隱密中的父，你父在隱密中察看，必要報答你。
refs.text_en: But you, when you pray, enter into your private room, and shut your door and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will repay you.

verses.text_gb: 不[Fn1][Cra]要为自己积蓄财宝在地上，地上有虫[Crb]蛀、锈蚀，也有贼挖洞偷窃；
verses.text_big5: 不[Fn1][Cra]要為自己積蓄財寶在地上，地上有蟲[Crb]蛀、銹蝕，也有賊挖洞偷竊；
verses.text_en: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on the earth, where moth and rust consume and where thieves dig through and steal.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不要为自己积蓄财宝在地上，地上有虫蛀、锈蚀，也有贼挖洞偷窃；
verses.text_big5_plain: 不要為自己積蓄財寶在地上，地上有蟲蛀、銹蝕，也有賊挖洞偷竊；

footnotes.zh: 19～34节，是王所颁布国度宪法的第五段，关于国度子民的理财。
footnotes.zh_big5: 19～34節，是王所頒佈國度憲法的第五段，關於國度子民的理財。
footnotes.en: 6:19 1 Do The fifth section of the King's decree, vv. 19-34, concerns the riches of the kingdom people.

refs.text_gb: 于是对众人说，你们要当心，要自守，免去一切的贪婪；因为人的生命，不在于家业丰富。
refs.text_big5: 於是對眾人說，你們要當心，要自守，免去一切的貪婪；因為人的生命，不在於家業豐富。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Watch and guard yourself from all covetousness, for no one's life is in the abundance of his possessions.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就告诉他们一个比喻，说，有一个财主的田地出产丰盛；
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就告訴他們一個比喻，說，有一個財主的田地出產豐盛；
refs.text_en: And He told them a parable, saying, The land of a certain rich man brought forth abundantly.

refs.text_gb: 他自己心里思量说，我的出产没有地方收藏，怎么办？
refs.text_big5: 他自己心裏思量說，我的出產沒有地方收藏，怎麼辦？
refs.text_en: And he reasoned in himself, saying, What shall I do, for I have no place where I may gather my crops?

refs.text_gb: 又说，我要这样办：要把我的仓房拆了，另盖更大的，好在那里收藏我一切的麦子和财物。
refs.text_big5: 又說，我要這樣辦：要把我的倉房拆了，另蓋更大的，好在那裏收藏我一切的麥子和財物。
refs.text_en: And he said, I will do this: I will tear down my barns and build larger ones, and I will gather there all my wheat and my goods.

refs.text_gb: 然后要对我的魂说，魂哪，你有许多财物积存，可供多年享用，你休息吧，吃喝快乐吧。
refs.text_big5: 然後要對我的魂說，魂哪，你有許多財物積存，可供多年享用，你休息罷，喫喝快樂罷。
refs.text_en: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years; rest, eat, drink, be merry.

refs.text_gb: 神却对他说，无知的人哪，今夜必要你的魂；你所预备的，要归谁？
refs.text_big5: 神卻對他說，無知的人哪，今夜必要你的魂；你所豫備的，要歸誰？
refs.text_en: But God said to him, Foolish one, this night they are requiring your soul from you; and the things which you have prepared, whose will they be?

refs.text_gb: 那为自己积财，对神却不富足的，也是这样。
refs.text_big5: 那為自己積財，對神卻不富足的，也是這樣。
refs.text_en: So is he who stores up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God.

refs.text_gb: 你们生活为人不可贪爱钱财，要以现有的为足；因为主曾说，“我绝不撇下你，也绝不丢弃你。”
refs.text_big5: 你們生活為人不可貪愛錢財，要以現有的為足；因為主曾說，“我絕不撇下你，也絕不丟棄你。”
refs.text_en: Let your way of life be without the love of money, being satisfied with the things which are at hand; for He Himself has said, "I shall by no means give you up, neither by any means shall I abandon you";

refs.text_gb: 你们的财物坏了，衣服也被虫子咬了。
refs.text_big5: 你們的財物壞了，衣服也被蟲子咬了。
refs.text_en: Your riches have rotted and your garments have become moth-eaten;

refs.text_gb: 你们的金银都锈蚀了，这锈要作见证，定你们的罪，又要像火一样，吃你们的肉。你们在末后的日子积蓄财宝。
refs.text_big5: 你們的金銀都銹蝕了，這銹要作見證，定你們的罪，又要像火一樣，喫你們的肉。你們在末後的日子積蓄財寶。
refs.text_en: Your gold and your silver have rusted, and their rust will be a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have stored up treasure in the last days.

verses.text_gb: 只要为自己积[Fn1]蓄财[Cra]宝在天上，天上没有虫蛀、锈蚀，也没有贼挖[Crb]洞偷窃。
verses.text_big5: 只要為自己積[Fn1]蓄財[Cra]寶在天上，天上沒有蟲蛀、銹蝕，也沒有賊挖[Crb]洞偷竊。
verses.text_en: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consumes and where thieves do not dig through nor steal.
verses.text_gb_plain: 只要为自己积蓄财宝在天上，天上没有虫蛀、锈蚀，也没有贼挖洞偷窃。
verses.text_big5_plain: 只要為自己積蓄財寶在天上，天上沒有蟲蛀、銹蝕，也沒有賊挖洞偷竊。

footnotes.zh: “积蓄财宝在天上，”乃是将财物分给贫穷的人(十九21)，并顾到缺乏的圣徒(徒二45，四34～35，十一29，罗十五26)，以及主的仆人(腓四16～17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: “積蓄財寶在天上，”乃是將財物分給貧窮的人，（十九21，）並顧到缺乏的聖徒，（徒二45，四34～35，十一29，羅十五26，）以及主的僕人。（腓四16～17。）
footnotes.en: 6:20 1 store To store up treasures in heaven is to give material things to the poor (Matt. 19:21) and to care for the needy saints (Acts 2:45; 4:34-35; 11:29; Rom. 15:26) and the Lord's servants (Phil. 4:16-17).

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，你若想要完全，就要去变卖你的家业，分给穷人，就必有财宝在诸天之上，你还要来跟从我。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，你若想要完全，就要去變賣你的家業，分給窮人，就必有財寶在諸天之上，你還要來跟從我。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to him, If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in the heavens; and come, follow Me.

refs.text_gb: 要变卖你们的家业，施舍给人；为自己预备永不旧的钱袋，用不尽的财宝在诸天之上，就是贼不能近，虫不能蛀的地方。
refs.text_big5: 要變賣你們的家業，施捨給人；為自己豫備永不舊的錢袋，用不盡的財寶在諸天之上，就是賊不能近，蟲不能蛀的地方。
refs.text_en: Sell your possessions and give alms; make for yourselves purses which do not become old, an unfailing treasure in the heavens, where thief does not come near nor even moth corrupts;

refs.text_gb: 耶稣听见了，就对他说，你还缺少一件：要变卖你一切所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在诸天之上，你还要来跟从我。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌聽見了，就對他說，你還缺少一件：要變賣你一切所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在諸天之上，你還要來跟從我。
refs.text_en: And hearing this, Jesus said to him, Still you lack one thing: all that you have, sell and distribute to the poor, and you will have treasure in the heavens; and come, follow Me.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要知道，家主若晓得贼在几更天要来，他就必儆醒，不容他的房屋被人挖透。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要知道，家主若曉得賊在幾更天要來，他就必儆醒，不容他的房屋被人挖透。
refs.text_en: But know this, that if the householder had known in which watch the thief was coming, he would have watched and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要知道，家主若晓得贼在什么时刻要来，他就不会容他的房屋被人挖透。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要知道，家主若曉得賊在甚麼時刻要來，他就不會容他的房屋被人挖透。
refs.text_en: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

verses.text_gb: 因为你的财宝在那里，你的心[Fn1][Cra]也必在那里。
verses.text_big5: 因為你的財寶在那裏，你的心[Fn1][Cra]也必在那裏。
verses.text_en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为你的财宝在那里，你的心也必在那里。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為你的財寶在那裏，你的心也必在那裏。

footnotes.zh: 国度子民必须将他们的财宝送到天上，使他们的心也能在天上。
footnotes.zh_big5: 國度子民必須將他們的財寶送到天上，使他們的心也能在天上。
footnotes.en: 6:21 1 heart The kingdom people must send their treasure to heaven so that their heart also can be in heaven.

refs.text_gb: 因为你们的财宝在那里，你们的心也必在那里。
refs.text_big5: 因為你們的財寶在那裏，你們的心也必在那裏。
refs.text_en: For where your treasure is, there also your heart will be.

verses.text_gb: 眼睛乃是身上的灯[Cra]。所以你的眼睛若单[Fn1]一，全身就明亮；
verses.text_big5: 眼睛乃是身上的燈[Cra]。所以你的眼睛若單[Fn1]一，全身就明亮；
verses.text_en: The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is single, your whole body will be full of light;
verses.text_gb_plain: 眼睛乃是身上的灯。所以你的眼睛若单一，全身就明亮；
verses.text_big5_plain: 眼睛乃是身上的燈。所以你的眼睛若單一，全身就明亮；

footnotes.zh: 我们的两眼一次只能注视一样东西，倘若想要同时看两样东西，眼光就会模糊。我们的眼睛若只注视一样东西，眼光就会单一，并且我们的全身就明亮。我们若将财宝积蓄在天上，又积蓄在地上，我们的眼光就会模糊。我们若要有单一的眼光，就必须将财宝积蓄在一处。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們的兩眼一次只能注視一樣東西，倘若想要同時看兩樣東西，眼光就會糢糊。我們的眼睛若只注視一樣東西，眼光就會單一，並且我們的全身就明亮。我們若將財寶積蓄在天上，又積蓄在地上，我們的眼光就會糢糊。我們若要有單一的眼光，就必須將財寶積蓄在一處。
footnotes.en: 6:22 1 single Our two eyes can focus on only one thing at a time. If we endeavor to see two things at once, our vision will be blurred. If we focus our eyes on one thing, our vision will be single and our whole body will be full of light. If we store up our treasure both in heaven and on earth, our spiritual vision will be blurred. For our vision to be single, we must store up our treasure in one place.

refs.text_gb: 你的眼睛就是身上的灯，你的眼睛单一的时候，全身就明亮；但你的眼睛不专的时候，身体就黑暗。
refs.text_big5: 你的眼睛就是身上的燈，你的眼睛單一的時候，全身就明亮；但你的眼睛不專的時候，身體就黑暗。
refs.text_en: The lamp of the body is your eye. When your eye is single, your whole body also is full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is dark.

refs.text_gb: 所以你要察看，你里面的光是否黑暗了。
refs.text_big5: 所以你要察看，你裏面的光是否黑暗了。
refs.text_en: Watch out therefore that the light which is in you is not darkness.

refs.text_gb: 若是你全身明亮，毫无黑暗，就必完全明亮，如同灯的明光照亮你。
refs.text_big5: 若是你全身明亮，毫無黑暗，就必完全明亮，如同燈的明光照亮你。
refs.text_en: If therefore your whole body is full of light and does not have any dark part, the whole will be full of light as when the lamp with its rays illuminates you.

verses.text_gb: 但你的眼睛若不[Fn1]专，全身就黑暗。所以你里面的光[Fn2]若黑[Cra]暗了，那黑暗是何等的大！
verses.text_big5: 但你的眼睛若不[Fn1]專，全身就黑暗。所以你裏面的光[Fn2]若黑[Cra]暗了，那黑暗是何等的大！
verses.text_en: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be dark. If then the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
verses.text_gb_plain: 但你的眼睛若不专，全身就黑暗。所以你里面的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等的大！
verses.text_big5_plain: 但你的眼睛若不專，全身就黑暗。所以你裏面的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等的大！

footnotes.zh: 直译，恶。同时看两样东西而不专视，会叫我们的眼睛变恶(参二十15，申十五9，箴二八22)。这样，我们的全身就黑暗。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，惡。同時看兩樣東西而不專視，會叫我們的眼睛變惡。（參二十15，申十五9，箴二八22。）這樣，我們的全身就黑暗。
footnotes.en: 6:23 1 evil To look at two objects at the same time, not focusing on one object alone, is to make our eye evil (cf. Matt. 20:15; Deut. 15:9; Prov. 28:22). In such a case, our whole body will be dark.

footnotes.zh: 我们的心若专注于那积蓄在地上的财宝，我们里面的光就成为黑暗，并且那黑暗是大的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們的心若專注於那積蓄在地上的財寶，我們裏面的光就成為黑暗，並且那黑暗是大的。
footnotes.en: 6:23 2 light If our heart is fixed on treasure laid up on earth, the light that is in us will become darkness, and great will be the darkness.

refs.text_gb: 我们若说我们与神有交通，却在黑暗里行，就是说谎话，不行真理了；
refs.text_big5: 我們若說我們與神有交通，卻在黑暗裏行，就是說謊話，不行真理了；
refs.text_en: If we say that we have fellowship with Him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and are not practicing the truth;

refs.text_gb: 但我们若在光中行，如同神在光中，就彼此有交通，祂儿子耶稣的血也洗净我们一切的罪。
refs.text_big5: 但我們若在光中行，如同神在光中，就彼此有交通，祂兒子耶穌的血也洗淨我們一切的罪。
refs.text_en: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from every sin.

verses.text_gb: 没有人能事[Fn1]奉两[Cra]个主；因为他不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠[Fn2]于这个轻视那个。你们不能事奉神，又事奉玛[Fn3][Crb]门。
verses.text_big5: 沒有人能事[Fn1]奉兩[Cra]個主；因為他不是恨這個愛那個，就是忠[Fn2]於這個輕視那個。你們不能事奉神，又事奉瑪[Fn3][Crb]門。
verses.text_en: No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will hold to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.text_gb_plain: 没有人能事奉两个主；因为他不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠于这个轻视那个。你们不能事奉神，又事奉玛门。
verses.text_big5_plain: 沒有人能事奉兩個主；因為他不是恨這個愛那個，就是忠於這個輕視那個。你們不能事奉神，又事奉瑪門。

footnotes.zh: 直译，作奴仆服事。
footnotes.en: 6:24 1 serve Lit., serve as a slave.

footnotes.zh: 原文有忠于这一方，反对那一方的意思。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文有忠於這一方，反對那一方的意思。
footnotes.en: 6:24 2 hold In Greek, hold to one and despise the other means to be devoted to one and be against the other.

footnotes.zh: 亚兰文，指钱财、财富。这里的玛门与神对立，指明钱财或财富是神的对头，夺取神子民对神的事奉。
footnotes.zh_big5: 亞蘭文，指錢財、財富。這裏的瑪門與神對立，指明錢財或財富是神的對頭，奪取神子民對神的事奉。
footnotes.en: 6:24 3 mammon An Aramaic word signifying wealth, riches. Mammon stands in opposition to God, indicating that wealth, or riches, is the opponent of God, robbing God's people of their service to Him.

refs.text_gb: 没有一个家仆能事奉两个主；因为他不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠于这个轻视那个。你们不能事奉神，又事奉玛门。
refs.text_big5: 沒有一個家僕能事奉兩個主；因為他不是恨這個愛那個，就是忠於這個輕視那個。你們不能事奉神，又事奉瑪門。
refs.text_en: No household servant can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will hold to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.

refs.text_gb: 我又告诉你们，要借着那不义的钱财，为自己结交朋友，到了钱财无用的时候，他们可以接你们到永远的帐幕里去。
refs.text_big5: 我又告訴你們，要藉著那不義的錢財，為自己結交朋友，到了錢財無用的時候，他們可以接你們到永遠的帳幕裏去。
refs.text_en: And I say to you, Make friends for yourselves by means of the mammon of unrighteousness, so that when it fails, they may receive you into the eternal tabernacles.

refs.text_gb: 你们若是在不义的钱财上不忠信，谁还把那真实的信托你们？
refs.text_big5: 你們若是在不義的錢財上不忠信，誰還把那真實的信託你們？
refs.text_en: If therefore you have not become faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will entrust to you what is true?

refs.text_gb: 没有一个家仆能事奉两个主；因为他不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠于这个轻视那个。你们不能事奉神，又事奉玛门。
refs.text_big5: 沒有一個家僕能事奉兩個主；因為他不是恨這個愛那個，就是忠於這個輕視那個。你們不能事奉神，又事奉瑪門。
refs.text_en: No household servant can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will hold to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.

verses.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，不[Cra]要为生[Fn1]命忧[Crb]虑，吃什么，喝什么；也不要为身体忧虑，穿什么。生命不胜[Fn2]于食物么？身体不胜于衣服么？
verses.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，不[Cra]要為生[Fn1]命憂[Crb]慮，喫甚麼，喝甚麼；也不要為身體憂慮，穿甚麼。生命不勝[Fn2]於食物麼？身體不勝於衣服麼？
verses.text_en: Because of this, I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you should eat or what you should drink; nor for your body, what you should put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than clothing?
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑，吃什么，喝什么；也不要为身体忧虑，穿什么。生命不胜于食物么？身体不胜于衣服么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮，喫甚麼，喝甚麼；也不要為身體憂慮，穿甚麼。生命不勝於食物麼？身體不勝於衣服麼？

footnotes.zh: 直译，魂。指魂生命，其中有对饮食和穿着的欲望和嗜好(赛二九8)。
footnotes.en: 6:25 1 life Lit., soul. Referring to the soul-life, where the desire, the appetite, for food and clothing resides (Isa. 29:8).

footnotes.zh: 我们的生命胜于食物，身体胜于衣服。我们的生命和身体，不是因我们的忧虑，乃是因神而有的。神既然为我们创造了生命和身体，祂必定会顾念我们生命和身体的需要。国度子民不需要为此忧虑。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們的生命勝於食物，身體勝於衣服。我們的生命和身體，不是因我們的憂慮，乃是因神而有的。神既然為我們創造了生命和身體，祂必定會顧念我們生命和身體的需要。國度子民不需要為此憂慮。
footnotes.en: 6:25 2 more Our life is more than food, and our body is more than clothing. Both our life and our body were brought into existence by God, not by our anxiety. Since God created us with a life and a body, surely He will care for their needs. The kingdom people do not need to be anxious about this.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣又对门徒说，所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑，吃什么，也不要为身体忧虑，穿什么。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌又對門徒說，所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮，喫甚麼，也不要為身體憂慮，穿甚麼。
refs.text_en: And He said to His disciples, Therefore I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you should eat; nor for your body, what you should put on;

refs.text_gb: 因为生命胜于食物，身体胜于衣服。
refs.text_big5: 因為生命勝於食物，身體勝於衣服。
refs.text_en: For the life is more than food, and the body more than clothing.

refs.text_gb: 你们想乌鸦，它们既不种，也不收，没有仓，也没有库，神尚且养活它们。你们比飞鸟贵重多了。
refs.text_big5: 你們想烏鴉，牠們既不種，也不收，沒有倉，也沒有庫，神尚且養活牠們。你們比飛鳥貴重多了。
refs.text_en: Consider the ravens. They neither sow nor reap, they have neither storehouse nor barn; yet God nourishes them. How much more valuable are you than the birds!

refs.text_gb: 你们中间谁能因忧虑使自己的身量多加一肘？
refs.text_big5: 你們中間誰能因憂慮使自己的身量多加一肘？
refs.text_en: And which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his stature?

refs.text_gb: 这最小的事，你们尚且不能作，为什么还忧虑其余的事？
refs.text_big5: 這最小的事，你們尚且不能作，為甚麼還憂慮其餘的事？
refs.text_en: If then you cannot do even the least, why are you anxious about the rest?

refs.text_gb: 你们想百合花，怎样生长；它们既不劳苦，也不纺线。但我告诉你们，就是所罗门在他极盛的荣耀里，也没有披戴得像这些花中的一朵。
refs.text_big5: 你們想百合花，怎樣生長；它們既不勞苦，也不紡線。但我告訴你們，就是所羅門在他極盛的榮耀裏，也沒有披戴得像這些花中的一朵。
refs.text_en: Consider the lilies, how they grow; they do not toil nor even spin thread; but I tell you, Not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed like one of these.

refs.text_gb: 小信的人哪，野地里的草，今天存在，明天就丢在炉里，神尚且这样给它穿戴，何况你们？
refs.text_big5: 小信的人哪，野地裏的草，今天存在，明天就丟在爐裏，神尚且這樣給它穿戴，何況你們？
refs.text_en: Now if God so arrays the grass in the field, which is here today and tomorrow is cast into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, you of little faith!

refs.text_gb: 你们不要寻求吃什么，喝什么，也不要挂心。
refs.text_big5: 你們不要尋求喫甚麼，喝甚麼，也不要罣心。
refs.text_en: And you, do not seek what you shall eat and what you shall drink, and do not be unsettled.

refs.text_gb: 因为这一切都是世上外邦人所急切寻求的，你们的父却知道你们需要这一切。
refs.text_big5: 因為這一切都是世上外邦人所急切尋求的，你們的父卻知道你們需要這一切。
refs.text_en: For all these things the Gentiles of the world are anxiously seeking, but your Father knows that you need these things.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要寻求祂的国，这些就都要加给你们了。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要尋求祂的國，這些就都要加給你們了。
refs.text_en: However, seek His kingdom, and these things shall be added to you.

refs.text_gb: 你们中间谁能因忧虑使自己的身量多加一肘？
refs.text_big5: 你們中間誰能因憂慮使自己的身量多加一肘？
refs.text_en: Who among you by being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?

refs.text_gb: 你们何必为衣服忧虑？你们细想野地里的百合花，怎样生长；它们既不劳苦，也不纺线。
refs.text_big5: 你們何必為衣服憂慮？你們細想野地裏的百合花，怎樣生長；它們既不勞苦，也不紡線。
refs.text_en: And why are you anxious concerning clothing? Consider well the lilies of the field, how they grow. They do not toil, neither do they spin thread.

refs.text_gb: 所以不要忧虑，说，我们要吃什么？喝什么？披戴什么？
refs.text_big5: 所以不要憂慮，說，我們要喫甚麼？喝甚麼？披戴甚麼？
refs.text_en: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, With what shall we be clothed?

refs.text_gb: 所以你们不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑，一天的难处一天当就够了。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們不要為明天憂慮，因為明天自有明天的憂慮，一天的難處一天當就彀了。
refs.text_en: Therefore do not be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself; sufficient for the day is its own evil.

refs.text_gb: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有今世的思虑，和钱财的迷惑，把道全然挤住了，道就不能结实。
refs.text_big5: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有今世的思慮，和錢財的迷惑，把道全然擠住了，道就不能結實。
refs.text_en: And the one sown in the thorns, this is he who hears the word, and the anxiety of the age and the deceitfulness of riches utterly choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

refs.text_gb: 应当一无挂虑，只要凡事借着祷告、祈求，带着感谢，将你们所要的告诉神；
refs.text_big5: 應當一無罣慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，帶著感謝，將你們所要的告訴神；
refs.text_en: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God;

refs.text_gb: 你们要将一切的忧虑卸给神，因为祂顾念你们。
refs.text_big5: 你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，因為祂顧念你們。
refs.text_en: Casting all your anxiety on Him because it matters to Him concerning you.

verses.text_gb: 你们看天空的飞[Cra]鸟，它们既不种，也不收，又不收积在仓里，你们的天父尚且养活它们。你们不比它们贵重么？
verses.text_big5: 你們看天空的飛[Cra]鳥，牠們既不種，也不收，又不收積在倉裏，你們的天父尚且養活牠們。你們不比牠們貴重麼？
verses.text_en: Look at the birds of heaven. They do not sow nor reap nor gather into barns, yet your heavenly Father nourishes them. Are you not of more value than they?
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们看天空的飞鸟，它们既不种，也不收，又不收积在仓里，你们的天父尚且养活它们。你们不比它们贵重么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們看天空的飛鳥，牠們既不種，也不收，又不收積在倉裏，你們的天父尚且養活牠們。你們不比牠們貴重麼？

refs.text_gb: 两只麻雀不是卖一个铜钱么？没有你们父的许可，一只也不会掉在地上。
refs.text_big5: 兩隻麻雀不是賣一個銅錢麼？沒有你們父的許可，一隻也不會掉在地上。
refs.text_en: Are not two sparrows sold for an assarion? And not one of them will fall to the earth apart from your Father.

refs.text_gb: 就是连你们的头发，也都被数过了。
refs.text_big5: 就是連你們的頭髮，也都被數過了。
refs.text_en: But even the hairs of your head are all numbered.

refs.text_gb: 所以不要怕，你们比许多麻雀还贵重。
refs.text_big5: 所以不要怕，你們比許多麻雀還貴重。
refs.text_en: Therefore do not fear; you are of more value than many sparrows.

refs.text_gb: 乌鸦之雏，因无食物飞来飞去，向神呼救时，谁为乌鸦预备食物？
refs.text_big5: 烏鴉之雛，因無食物飛來飛去，向神呼救時，誰為烏鴉豫備食物？
refs.text_en: Who provides for the raven its prey / When its young ones cry out to God / And wander about for lack of food?

refs.text_gb: 赐食物给走兽和啼叫的小乌鸦。
refs.text_big5: 賜食物給走獸和啼叫的小烏鴉。
refs.text_en: Who gives to the beast its food, / And to the young ravens who cry.

verses.text_gb: 你们中间谁能因忧虑使自己的身[Fn1]量多加一肘？
verses.text_big5: 你們中間誰能因憂慮使自己的身[Fn1]量多加一肘？
verses.text_en: Who among you by being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们中间谁能因忧虑使自己的身量多加一肘？
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們中間誰能因憂慮使自己的身量多加一肘？

footnotes.zh_big5: 或，壽數。（就如詩三九5的“一生。”）

footnotes.zh: 百合花象征在神看顾下的人(歌二1～2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 百合花象徵在神看顧下的人。（歌二1～2。）
footnotes.en: 6:28 1 lilies Lilies signify people under the care of God (S.S. 2:1-2).

refs.text_gb: 只要有养生与遮身之物，就当以此为足。
refs.text_big5: 只要有養生與遮身之物，就當以此為足。
refs.text_en: But having food and covering, with these we will be content.

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑，吃什么，喝什么；也不要为身体忧虑，穿什么。生命不胜于食物么？身体不胜于衣服么？
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮，喫甚麼，喝甚麼；也不要為身體憂慮，穿甚麼。生命不勝於食物麼？身體不勝於衣服麼？
refs.text_en: Because of this, I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you should eat or what you should drink; nor for your body, what you should put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than clothing?

refs.text_gb: 我是沙仑的玫瑰花，是谷中的百合花。
refs.text_big5: 我是沙崙的玫瑰花，是谷中的百合花。
refs.text_en: I am a rose of Sharon, / A lily of the valleys.

refs.text_gb: 我的佳偶在女子中，好像百合花在荆棘中。
refs.text_big5: 我的佳偶在女子中，好像百合花在荊棘中。
refs.text_en: As a lily among thorns, / So is my love among the daughters.

verses.text_gb: 但我告诉你们，就是所[Cra]罗门在他极盛的荣耀里，也没有披戴得像这些花中的一朵。
verses.text_big5: 但我告訴你們，就是所[Cra]羅門在他極盛的榮耀裏，也沒有披戴得像這些花中的一朵。
verses.text_en: But I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed like one of these.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但我告诉你们，就是所罗门在他极盛的荣耀里，也没有披戴得像这些花中的一朵。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但我告訴你們，就是所羅門在他極盛的榮耀裏，也沒有披戴得像這些花中的一朵。

refs.text_gb: 示巴女王见所罗门一切的智慧，和他所建造的宫室，
refs.text_big5: 示巴女王見所羅門一切的智慧，和他所建造的宮室，
refs.text_en: And when the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon and the house that he had built

refs.text_gb: 他席上的膳肴，群臣的座次，仆人的侍候，他们的服饰，和司酒的服饰，以及他在耶和华殿里所献的燔祭，就诧异得神不守舍。
refs.text_big5: 他席上的膳餚，群臣的座次，僕人的侍候，他們的服飾，和司酒的服飾，以及他在耶和華殿裏所獻的燔祭，就詫異得神不守舍。
refs.text_en: And the food of his table and the seating of his servants and the service and apparel of his ministers and his cupbearers and his burnt offerings that he offered up at the house of Jehovah, there was no more spirit in her.

refs.text_gb: 她对王说，我在我本地所听见的话，论到你的事和你的智慧，实在是真的；
refs.text_big5: 她對王說，我在我本地所聽見的話，論到你的事和你的智慧，實在是真的；
refs.text_en: And she said to the king, The word that I heard in my land concerning your deeds and your wisdom is true,

refs.text_gb: 我先前不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了，才知道人所告诉我的还不到一半；你的智慧和你的昌盛超过我所听见的传闻。
refs.text_big5: 我先前不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了，纔知道人所告訴我的還不到一半；你的智慧和你的昌盛超過我所聽見的傳聞。
refs.text_en: But I did not believe the words until I came and my own eyes saw. And indeed the half was not told to me; your wisdom and prosperity far exceed the report that I heard.

verses.text_gb: 小[Cra]信的人哪，野地里的草[Crb]，今天存在，明天就丢在炉里，神尚且这样给它穿[Crc]戴，何况你们？
verses.text_big5: 小[Cra]信的人哪，野地裏的草[Crb]，今天存在，明天就丟在爐裏，神尚且這樣給它穿[Crc]戴，何況你們？
verses.text_en: And if God so arrays the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is cast into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, you of little faith?
verses.text_gb_plain: 小信的人哪，野地里的草，今天存在，明天就丢在炉里，神尚且这样给它穿戴，何况你们？
verses.text_big5_plain: 小信的人哪，野地裏的草，今天存在，明天就丟在爐裏，神尚且這樣給它穿戴，何況你們？

refs.text_gb: 祂对他们说，小信的人哪，你们为什么胆怯？于是起来，斥责风和海，风和海就大大地平静了。
refs.text_big5: 祂對他們說，小信的人哪，你們為甚麼膽怯？於是起來，斥責風和海，風和海就大大的平靜了。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Why are you cowardly, you of little faith? Then He arose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣赶紧伸手拉住他，对他说，小信的人哪，为什么疑惑？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，對他說，小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑？
refs.text_en: And immediately Jesus stretched out His hand and took hold of him and said to him, You of little faith, why did you doubt?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道了，就说，小信的人哪，为什么因为没有饼就彼此议论？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道了，就說，小信的人哪，為甚麼因為沒有餅就彼此議論？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, knowing it, said, Why are you reasoning among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have no bread?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，因为你们的信心小；我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这座山说，从这边挪到那边，它也必挪去；并且在你们就没有一件事是不可能的。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，因為你們的信心小；我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說，從這邊挪到那邊，它也必挪去；並且在你們就沒有一件事是不可能的。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Because of your little faith; for truly I say to you, If you have faith like a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, Move from here to there, and it will move; and nothing will be impossible to you.

refs.text_gb: 有人声说，你喊叫吧。有一个说，我喊叫什么呢？说，凡属肉体的人尽都如草，他一切的荣美都像野地的花；
refs.text_big5: 有人聲說，你喊叫罷。有一個說，我喊叫甚麼呢？說，凡屬肉體的人盡都如草，他一切的榮美都像野地的花；
refs.text_en: A voice said, Cry out. / And he said, What shall I cry? / All flesh is grass / And all its glory is like the flower of the field;

refs.text_gb: 草必枯干，花必凋残，因为耶和华的气吹在其上。百姓诚然是草。
refs.text_big5: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘，因為耶和華的氣吹在其上。百姓誠然是草。
refs.text_en: The grass withers, the flower fades, / Because the breath of Jehovah blows upon it. / Surely the people are grass.

refs.text_gb: 草必枯干，花必凋残，唯有我们神的话必永远立定。
refs.text_big5: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘，惟有我們神的話必永遠立定。
refs.text_en: The grass withers and the flower fades, / But the word of our God will stand forever.

refs.text_gb: 富足的降卑，也该如此，因为他必要过去，如同草上的花一样。
refs.text_big5: 富足的降卑，也該如此，因為他必要過去，如同草上的花一樣。
refs.text_en: And the rich in his being brought low, because like a flower of the grass he will pass away.

refs.text_gb: 太阳升起，热气薰烤，草就枯干，花也凋谢，美容就消没了；那富足的人在他所行的事上，也要这样衰残。
refs.text_big5: 太陽升起，熱氣薰烤，草就枯乾，花也凋謝，美容就消沒了；那富足的人在他所行的事上，也要這樣衰殘。
refs.text_en: For the sun rises with its scorching heat and withers the grass, and its flower falls off, and the beauty of its appearance is destroyed; so also the rich man will fade away in his pursuits.

refs.text_gb: 我领你们在旷野四十年，你们身上的衣服没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏；
refs.text_big5: 我領你們在曠野四十年，你們身上的衣服沒有穿破，腳上的鞋也沒有穿壞；
refs.text_en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness; your clothing did not wear out from upon you, nor did your sandal wear out from upon your foot;

verses.text_gb: 所以不要忧[Cra]虑，说，我们要吃什么？喝什么？披戴什么？
verses.text_big5: 所以不要憂[Cra]慮，說，我們要喫甚麼？喝甚麼？披戴甚麼？
verses.text_en: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, With what shall we be clothed?
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以不要忧虑，说，我们要吃什么？喝什么？披戴什么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以不要憂慮，說，我們要喫甚麼？喝甚麼？披戴甚麼？

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑，吃什么，喝什么；也不要为身体忧虑，穿什么。生命不胜于食物么？身体不胜于衣服么？
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮，喫甚麼，喝甚麼；也不要為身體憂慮，穿甚麼。生命不勝於食物麼？身體不勝於衣服麼？
refs.text_en: Because of this, I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you should eat or what you should drink; nor for your body, what you should put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than clothing?

refs.text_gb: 你们何必为衣服忧虑？你们细想野地里的百合花，怎样生长；它们既不劳苦，也不纺线。
refs.text_big5: 你們何必為衣服憂慮？你們細想野地裏的百合花，怎樣生長；它們既不勞苦，也不紡線。
refs.text_en: And why are you anxious concerning clothing? Consider well the lilies of the field, how they grow. They do not toil, neither do they spin thread.

verses.text_gb: 因为这一切都是外邦人所急切寻求的，你们的天[Fn1]父原知道你们需[Cra]要这一切。
verses.text_big5: 因為這一切都是外邦人所急切尋求的，你們的天[Fn1]父原知道你們需[Cra]要這一切。
verses.text_en: For all these things the Gentiles are anxiously seeking. For your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为这一切都是外邦人所急切寻求的，你们的天父原知道你们需要这一切。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為這一切都是外邦人所急切尋求的，你們的天父原知道你們需要這一切。

footnotes.zh: 国度子民有天父神圣的生命，作他们遵行国度新律法的力量。他们也有天父顾念他们物质的需要，使他们不需要为此忧虑。天父是他们力量和供应的源头。因此，他们无需软弱，也无需缺乏。
footnotes.zh_big5: 國度子民有天父神聖的生命，作他們遵行國度新律法的力量。他們也有天父顧念他們物質的需要，使他們不需要為此憂慮。天父是他們力量和供應的源頭。因此，他們無需軟弱，也無需缺乏。
footnotes.en: 6:32 1 heavenly The kingdom people have the divine life of their heavenly Father as their strength to keep the new law of the kingdom. They also have their heavenly Father as the One who cares for their material needs, so that they do not need to be anxious about it. Their heavenly Father is the source of their strength and supply. Hence, they need not be weak or wanting.

refs.text_gb: 你们不可像他们，因为你们求祂以前，你们所需用的，你们的父早已知道了。
refs.text_big5: 你們不可像他們，因為你們求祂以前，你們所需用的，你們的父早已知道了。
refs.text_en: Therefore do not be like them, for your Father knows the things that you have need of before you ask Him.

verses.text_gb: 但你们要先寻求祂的国[Fn1][Cra]和祂的义[Crb]，这一切就都要加给你们了。
verses.text_big5: 但你們要先尋求祂的國[Fn1][Cra]和祂的義[Crb]，這一切就都要加給你們了。
verses.text_en: But seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但你们要先寻求祂的国和祂的义，这一切就都要加给你们了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但你們要先尋求祂的國和祂的義，這一切就都要加給你們了。

footnotes.zh: 父的国是今天诸天之国的实际(就是今天召会生活的实际)，也是来世诸天之国的实现；父的义乃是因遵行国度新律法而有的义(就是国度子民所活出的基督)，如五20所说的。因着国度子民先寻求他们天父的国和祂的义，不仅祂的国和祂的义要赐给他们，连他们一切的需用也都要加给他们。
footnotes.en: 6:33 1 righteousness The Father's kingdom is the reality of the kingdom of the heavens today, the reality of the church life today, and will be the manifestation of the kingdom of the heavens in the coming age. The Father's righteousness is the righteousness expressed by the keeping of the new law of the kingdom, as mentioned in 5:20. This righteousness is Christ, who is lived out by the kingdom people. Since the kingdom people seek first the kingdom and the righteousness of their heavenly Father, not only will His kingdom and His righteousness be given to them, but also all that they need will be added to them.

refs.text_gb: 灵里贫穷的人有福了，因为诸天的国是他们的。
refs.text_big5: 靈裏貧窮的人有福了，因為諸天的國是他們的。
refs.text_en: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 为义受逼迫的人有福了，因为诸天的国是他们的。
refs.text_big5: 為義受逼迫的人有福了，因為諸天的國是他們的。
refs.text_en: Blessed are those who are persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 我告诉你们，你们的义，若不超过经学家和法利赛人的义，绝不能进诸天的国。
refs.text_big5: 我告訴你們，你們的義，若不超過經學家和法利賽人的義，絕不能進諸天的國。
refs.text_en: For I say to you that unless your righteousness surpasses that of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall by no means enter into the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 愿你的国来临，愿你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。
refs.text_big5: 願你的國來臨，願你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。
refs.text_en: Your kingdom come; Your will be done, as in heaven, so also on earth.

refs.text_gb: 不是每一个对我说，主啊，主啊的人，都能进诸天的国，唯独实行我诸天之上父旨意的人，才能进去。
refs.text_big5: 不是每一個對我說，主阿，主阿的人，都能進諸天的國，惟獨實行我諸天之上父旨意的人，纔能進去。
refs.text_en: Not everyone who says to Me, Lord, Lord, will enter into the kingdom of the heavens, but he who does the will of My Father who is in the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要寻求祂的国，这些就都要加给你们了。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要尋求祂的國，這些就都要加給你們了。
refs.text_en: However, seek His kingdom, and these things shall be added to you.

refs.text_gb: 你们这小群，不要惧怕，因为你们的父乐意把国赐给你们。
refs.text_big5: 你們這小群，不要懼怕，因為你們的父樂意把國賜給你們。
refs.text_en: Do not be afraid, little flock, because your Father has been well pleased to give you the kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 坚固门徒的魂，劝勉他们恒守信仰，又说，我们进入神的国，必须经历许多患难。
refs.text_big5: 堅固門徒的魂，勸勉他們恆守信仰，又說，我們進入神的國，必須經歷許多患難。
refs.text_en: Establishing the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith and saying that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 因为神的国不在于吃喝，乃在于公义、和平、并圣灵中的喜乐。
refs.text_big5: 因為神的國不在於喫喝，乃在於公義、和平、並聖靈中的喜樂。
refs.text_en: For the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

refs.text_gb: 饥渴慕义的人有福了，因为他们必得饱足。
refs.text_big5: 飢渴慕義的人有福了，因為他們必得飽足。
refs.text_en: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be satisfied.

refs.text_gb: 为义受逼迫的人有福了，因为诸天的国是他们的。
refs.text_big5: 為義受逼迫的人有福了，因為諸天的國是他們的。
refs.text_en: Blessed are those who are persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 我告诉你们，你们的义，若不超过经学家和法利赛人的义，绝不能进诸天的国。
refs.text_big5: 我告訴你們，你們的義，若不超過經學家和法利賽人的義，絕不能進諸天的國。
refs.text_en: For I say to you that unless your righteousness surpasses that of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall by no means enter into the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 地上一切遵行耶和华典章的卑微人哪，你们都当寻求耶和华。当寻求公义，寻求卑微，或者在耶和华发怒的日子，可以隐藏起来。
refs.text_big5: 地上一切遵行耶和華典章的卑微人哪，你們都當尋求耶和華。當尋求公義，尋求卑微，或者在耶和華發怒的日子，可以隱藏起來。
refs.text_en: Seek Jehovah, / All you meek of the earth, / Who have performed His judgments. / Seek righteousness; / Seek meekness; / Perhaps you will be hidden / In the day of Jehovah's anger.

refs.text_gb: 又赐她得穿明亮洁净的细麻衣，这细麻衣就是圣徒所行的义。
refs.text_big5: 又賜她得穿明亮潔淨的細麻衣，這細麻衣就是聖徒所行的義。
refs.text_en: And it was given to her that she should be clothed in fine linen, bright and clean; for the fine linen is the righteousnesses of the saints.

verses.text_gb: 所以你们不要为明[Fn1][Cra]天忧[Crb]虑，因为明天自[Fn2]有明天的忧虑，一天的难[Fn3]处一天当就够了。
verses.text_big5: 所以你們不要為明[Fn1][Cra]天憂[Crb]慮，因為明天自[Fn2]有明天的憂慮，一天的難[Fn3]處一天當就彀了。
verses.text_en: Therefore do not be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself; sufficient for the day is its own evil.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以你们不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑，一天的难处一天当就够了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以你們不要為明天憂慮，因為明天自有明天的憂慮，一天的難處一天當就彀了。

footnotes.zh: 国度子民绝不该活在明天，只该活在今天。
footnotes.zh_big5: 國度子民絕不該活在明天，只該活在今天。
footnotes.en: 6:34 1 tomorrow The kingdom people should never live in tomorrow but always in today.

footnotes.zh: 直译，有明天自己的忧虑。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，有明天自己的憂慮。

footnotes.zh: 或，邪恶(原文与13注2之邪恶不同)。在此指烦扰、苦难。这指明国度的王已清楚指示国度子民，他们为着国度在地上所过的，将是烦扰、苦难的日子，而非安逸、舒适的日子。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，邪惡。（原文與13註2之邪惡不同。）在此指煩擾、苦難。這指明國度的王已清楚指示國度子民，他們為著國度在地上所過的，將是煩擾、苦難的日子，而非安逸、舒適的日子。
footnotes.en: 6:34 2 evil Not the same Greek word as for evil in note Matt. 6:13 2 . Evil here denotes trouble and affliction. This indicates that the King of the kingdom has made it clear to the kingdom people that their days on earth for the kingdom will be days of trouble and affliction, not of ease and comfort.

refs.text_gb: 嗐，你们说，今天或明天，我们要往某城去，在那里住一年，作买卖得利；
refs.text_big5: 嗐，你們說，今天或明天，我們要往某城去，在那裏住一年，作買賣得利；
refs.text_en: Come now, you who say, Today or tomorrow we will go into this or that city and spend a year there and do business and make a profit;

refs.text_gb: 其实明天的事你们并不知道。你们的生命是什么？你们原是一团雾气，出现少时，随后就不见了。
refs.text_big5: 其實明天的事你們並不知道。你們的生命是甚麼？你們原是一團霧氣，出現少時，隨後就不見了。
refs.text_en: Whereas you do not know the matter of tomorrow, what your life will be; for you are a vapor, which appears for a little while and then disappears.

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑，吃什么，喝什么；也不要为身体忧虑，穿什么。生命不胜于食物么？身体不胜于衣服么？
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮，喫甚麼，喝甚麼；也不要為身體憂慮，穿甚麼。生命不勝於食物麼？身體不勝於衣服麼？
refs.text_en: Because of this, I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you should eat or what you should drink; nor for your body, what you should put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than clothing?

verses.text_gb: 不[Fn1][Cra]要审[Fn2]判，免得你们受审判；
verses.text_big5: 不[Fn1][Cra]要審[Fn2]判，免得你們受審判；
verses.text_en: Do not judge, that you be not judged.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不要审判，免得你们受审判；
verses.text_big5_plain: 不要審判，免得你們受審判；

footnotes.zh: 1～12节，是王在山上所颁布国度宪法的第六段，论到国度子民待人的原则。
footnotes.zh_big5: 1～12節，是王在山上所頒佈國度憲法的第六段，論到國度子民待人的原則。
footnotes.en: 7:1 1 Do The sixth section of the new King's decree on the mountain, vv. 1-12, concerns the principles of the kingdom people in their dealings with others.

footnotes.zh: 或，论断。国度子民在国度属天的管治之下，活在谦卑的灵里，总是审判(论断)自己，不审判别人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，論斷。國度子民在國度屬天的管治之下，活在謙卑的靈裏，總是審判（論斷）自己，不審判別人。
footnotes.en: 7:1 2 not The kingdom people, living in a humble spirit under the heavenly ruling of the kingdom, always judge themselves, not others.

refs.text_gb: 你们不要审判，就绝不会受审判；你们不要定罪，就绝不会被定罪；你们要赦免人，就必蒙赦免。
refs.text_big5: 你們不要審判，就絕不會受審判；你們不要定罪，就絕不會被定罪；你們要赦免人，就必蒙赦免。
refs.text_en: And do not judge, and you shall by no means be judged; and do not condemn, and you shall by no means be condemned; release, and you will be released;

refs.text_gb: 你们要给人，就必有给你们的，用十足的量器，连摇带按，上尖下流地倒在你们怀里；因为你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。
refs.text_big5: 你們要給人，就必有給你們的，用十足的量器，連搖帶按，上尖下流的倒在你們懷裏；因為你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。
refs.text_en: Give, and it will be given to you; a good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, they will give into your bosom. For with what measure you measure, it shall be measured to you in return.

refs.text_gb: 吃的人不可轻视不吃的人，不吃的人也不可审判吃的人，因为神已经接纳他了。
refs.text_big5: 喫的人不可輕視不喫的人，不喫的人也不可審判喫的人，因為神已經接納他了。
refs.text_en: He who eats, let him not despise him who does not eat; and he who does not eat, let him not judge him who eats, for God has received him.

refs.text_gb: 你是谁，竟审判别人的家仆？他或站住或跌倒，自有他的主人在，而且他也必要站住，因为主能使他站住。
refs.text_big5: 你是誰，竟審判別人的家僕？他或站住或跌倒，自有他的主人在，而且他也必要站住，因為主能使他站住。
refs.text_en: Who are you who judge another's household servant? To his own master he stands or falls; and he will be made to stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.

refs.text_gb: 你为什么审判你的弟兄？又为什么轻视你的弟兄？我们都要站在神的审判台前，
refs.text_big5: 你為甚麼審判你的弟兄？又為甚麼輕視你的弟兄？我們都要站在神的審判臺前，
refs.text_en: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God,

refs.text_gb: 所以我们不可再彼此审判，宁可这样断定：不给弟兄放下绊脚石或跌人之物。
refs.text_big5: 所以我們不可再彼此審判，寧可這樣斷定：不給弟兄放下絆腳石或跌人之物。
refs.text_en: Therefore let us judge one another no longer, but rather judge this: not to put a stumbling block or cause of falling before your brother.

refs.text_gb: 所以在那时以前，什么都不要论断，直等主来，祂要照出暗中的隐情，也要显明人心的意图，那时各人要从神那里得着称赞。
refs.text_big5: 所以在那時以前，甚麼都不要論斷，直等主來，祂要照出暗中的隱情，也要顯明人心的意圖，那時各人要從神那裏得著稱讚。
refs.text_en: So then do not judge anything before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and make manifest the counsels of the hearts, and then there will be praise to each from God.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，你们不可彼此批评；那批评弟兄，或审判弟兄的，就是批评律法，审判律法。你若审判律法，就不是行律法者，乃是审判者。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，你們不可彼此批評；那批評弟兄，或審判弟兄的，就是批評律法，審判律法。你若審判律法，就不是行律法者，乃是審判者。
refs.text_en: Do not speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother or judges his brother speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

refs.text_gb: 设立律法者和审判者只有一位，就是那能救人，也能灭人的。你这审判邻舍的，你是谁？
refs.text_big5: 設立律法者和審判者只有一位，就是那能救人，也能滅人的。你這審判鄰舍的，你是誰？
refs.text_en: One is Lawgiver and Judge, who is able to save and destroy. But who are you who judge your neighbor?

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，你们不要彼此埋怨，免得受审判；看哪，那审判者站在门前了。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，你們不要彼此埋怨，免得受審判；看哪，那審判者站在門前了。
refs.text_en: Do not complain, brothers, against one another lest you be judged. Behold, the Judge stands before the doors.

refs.text_gb: 因为那不怜悯人的，也要受无怜悯的审判；怜悯原是向审判夸胜。
refs.text_big5: 因為那不憐憫人的，也要受無憐憫的審判；憐憫原是向審判誇勝。
refs.text_en: For the judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy; mercy triumphs over judgment.

verses.text_gb: 因为你[Fn1]们用什么审判审判人，也必受什么审判；你们用什么量[Cra]器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。
verses.text_big5: 因為你[Fn1]們用甚麼審判審判人，也必受甚麼審判；你們用甚麼量[Cra]器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。
verses.text_en: For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged; and with what measure you measure, it shall be measured to you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为你们用什么审判审判人，也必受什么审判；你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為你們用甚麼審判審判人，也必受甚麼審判；你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。

footnotes.zh: 在国度属天的管治之下，国度子民用什么审判人，也必受什么审判。他们若用公义审判别人，也要受主公义的审判；他们若用怜悯审判别人，也要受主怜悯的审判。怜悯原是向审判夸胜的(雅二13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在國度屬天的管治之下，國度子民用甚麼審判人，也必受甚麼審判。他們若用公義審判別人，也要受主公義的審判；他們若用憐憫審判別人，也要受主憐憫的審判。憐憫原是向審判誇勝的。（雅二13。）
footnotes.en: 7:2 1 with Under the heavenly ruling of the kingdom, the kingdom people will be judged with what they judge others. If they judge others with righteousness, they will be judged with righteousness by the Lord; if they judge others with mercy, they will be judged with mercy by the Lord. Mercy triumphs over judgment (James 2:13).

refs.text_gb: 又对他们说，你们要留心所听的。你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们，并且要加给你们。
refs.text_big5: 又對他們說，你們要留心所聽的。你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們，並且要加給你們。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Take heed what you hear. With what measure you measure, it shall be measured to you, and it shall be added to you.

verses.text_gb: 再者，为什么看见你弟兄眼中的刺[Cra]，却不想[Fn1]到自己眼中的梁木？
verses.text_big5: 再者，為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中的刺[Cra]，卻不想[Fn1]到自己眼中的梁木？
verses.text_en: And why do you look at the splinter which is in your brother's eye, but the beam in your eye you do not consider?
verses.text_gb_plain: 再者，为什么看见你弟兄眼中的刺，却不想到自己眼中的梁木？
verses.text_big5_plain: 再者，為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中的刺，卻不想到自己眼中的梁木？

footnotes.zh: 我们是国度的子民，在国度属天的管治之下，活在谦卑的灵里，每当我们看见弟兄眼中的刺，就必须想到自己眼中的梁木。我们弟兄眼中的刺，必须使我们想到自己眼中的梁木。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們是國度的子民，在國度屬天的管治之下，活在謙卑的靈裏，每當我們看見弟兄眼中的刺，就必須想到自己眼中的梁木。我們弟兄眼中的刺，必須使我們想到自己眼中的梁木。
footnotes.en: 7:3 1 consider As the kingdom people, living in a humble spirit under the heavenly ruling of the kingdom, we must consider the beam in our own eye whenever we look at the splinter in our brother's eye. The splinter in our brother's eye must remind us of the beam in our own eye.

refs.text_gb: 为什么看见你弟兄眼中的刺，却不想到自己眼中的梁木？
refs.text_big5: 為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中的刺，卻不想到自己眼中的梁木？
refs.text_en: And why do you look at the splinter which is in your brother's eye, but the beam which is in your own eye you do not consider?

refs.text_gb: 你看不见自己眼中的梁木，怎能对你弟兄说，弟兄，让我去掉你眼中的刺？你这假冒为善的人，先从你的眼中去掉梁木，然后你才看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
refs.text_big5: 你看不見自己眼中的梁木，怎能對你弟兄說，弟兄，讓我去掉你眼中的刺？你這假冒為善的人，先從你的眼中去掉梁木，然後你纔看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
refs.text_en: How can you say to your brother, Brother, let me remove the splinter which is in your eye, you yourself not seeing the beam which is in your eye? Hypocrite, first remove the beam from your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the splinter which is in your brother's eye.

refs.text_gb: 他们还是不住地问祂，耶稣就直起腰来，对他们说，你们中间谁是没有罪的，谁就先拿石头打她。
refs.text_big5: 他們還是不住的問祂，耶穌就直起腰來，對他們說，你們中間誰是沒有罪的，誰就先拿石頭打她。
refs.text_en: But when they persisted in questioning Him, He stood up and said to them, He who is without sin among you, let him be the first to throw a stone at her.

verses.text_gb: 或者，你怎能对你弟兄说，让我去掉你眼中的刺，而你自己眼中竟有梁木？
verses.text_big5: 或者，你怎能對你弟兄說，讓我去掉你眼中的刺，而你自己眼中竟有梁木？
verses.text_en: Or how can you say to your brother, Let me remove the splinter from your eye, and behold, the beam is in your eye?
verses.text_gb_plain: 或者，你怎能对你弟兄说，让我去掉你眼中的刺，而你自己眼中竟有梁木？
verses.text_big5_plain: 或者，你怎能對你弟兄說，讓我去掉你眼中的刺，而你自己眼中竟有梁木？

verses.text_gb: 你这假[Fn1][Cra]冒为善的人，先从你眼中去掉梁木，然后你才看[Fn2]得清楚，从你弟兄眼中去掉刺。
verses.text_big5: 你這假[Fn1][Cra]冒為善的人，先從你眼中去掉梁木，然後你纔看[Fn2]得清楚，從你弟兄眼中去掉刺。
verses.text_en: Hypocrite, first remove the beam from your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the splinter from your brother's eye.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你这假冒为善的人，先从你眼中去掉梁木，然后你才看得清楚，从你弟兄眼中去掉刺。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你這假冒為善的人，先從你眼中去掉梁木，然後你纔看得清楚，從你弟兄眼中去掉刺。

footnotes.zh: 见六2注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見六2註2。
footnotes.en: 7:5 1 Hypocrite See note Matt. 6:2 2 .

footnotes.zh: 只要梁木还留在我们眼中，我们的眼光就模糊，不能看得清楚。
footnotes.zh_big5: 只要梁木還留在我們眼中，我們的眼光就糢糊，不能看得清楚。
footnotes.en: 7:5 2 see As long as the beam remains in our eye, our vision is blurred and we cannot see clearly.

refs.text_gb: 所以你施舍的时候，不可在你前面吹号，像那假冒为善的人在会堂里和巷道上所行的，为要得人的荣耀。我实在告诉你们，他们已经充分的得了他们的赏赐。
refs.text_big5: 所以你施捨的時候，不可在你前面吹號，像那假冒為善的人在會堂裏和巷道上所行的，為要得人的榮耀。我實在告訴你們，他們已經充分的得了他們的賞賜。
refs.text_en: Therefore when you give alms, do not sound a trumpet before you as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may be glorified by men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward in full.

verses.text_gb: 不要把圣[Fn1][Cra]物给狗[Fn2][Crb]，也不要把你们的珍[Crc]珠丢在猪[Crd]前，免得它们用脚践踏珍珠，并且转过来撕裂你们。
verses.text_big5: 不要把聖[Fn1][Cra]物給狗[Fn2][Crb]，也不要把你們的珍[Crc]珠丟在豬[Crd]前，免得牠們用腳踐踏珍珠，並且轉過來撕裂你們。
verses.text_en: Do not give that which is holy to the dogs, neither cast your pearls before the hogs, lest they trample them with their feet, and turn and tear you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，免得它们用脚践踏珍珠，并且转过来撕裂你们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不要把聖物給狗，也不要把你們的珍珠丟在豬前，免得牠們用腳踐踏珍珠，並且轉過來撕裂你們。

footnotes.zh: 圣物，必是指客观的真理，那是属于神的；你们的珍珠，必是指主观的经历，这是我们的。
footnotes.en: 7:6 1 pearls That which is holy must refer to the objective truth, which belongs to God; your pearls must refer to the subjective experiences, which are ours.

footnotes.zh: 狗没有蹄，也不倒嚼；猪虽分蹄，却不倒嚼。因此，二者都是不洁净的(利十一27，7)。根据彼后二12、19～22，腓三2所启示的，这里的狗和猪是指那些信奉宗教，却不洁净的人。
footnotes.en: 7:6 2 hogs Dogs do not have hoofs, nor do they chew the cud; hogs have divided hoofs but do not chew the cud. Thus, both are unclean (7, Lev. 11:27). According to the revelation in 2 Pet. 2:12, 19-22, and Phil. 3:2, dogs and hogs here refer to people who are religious but not clean.

refs.text_gb: 你不要说话给愚昧人听，因他必藐视你言语中的智慧。
refs.text_big5: 你不要說話給愚昧人聽，因他必藐視你言語中的智慧。
refs.text_en: Do not speak in the hearing of a fool, / For he will despise the wisdom of your words.

refs.text_gb: 但犹太人看见群众，就充满嫉妒，硬驳保罗所说的话，并且毁谤。
refs.text_big5: 但猶太人看見群眾，就充滿嫉妒，硬駁保羅所說的話，並且毀謗。
refs.text_en: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and contradicted the things being spoken by Paul and blasphemed.

refs.text_gb: 保罗和巴拿巴放胆说，神的话先讲给你们听，原是应当的；只因你们弃绝这话，断定自己不配得永远的生命，看哪，我们就转向外邦人去。
refs.text_big5: 保羅和巴拿巴放膽說，神的話先講給你們聽，原是應當的；只因你們棄絕這話，斷定自己不配得永遠的生命，看哪，我們就轉向外邦人去。
refs.text_en: And Paul and Barnabas spoke boldly and said, It was necessary for the word of God to be spoken to you first. Since you thrust it away and do not judge yourselves worthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

refs.text_gb: 祂回答说，不好拿儿女的饼丢给小狗。
refs.text_big5: 祂回答說，不好拿兒女的餅丟給小狗。
refs.text_en: But He answered and said, It is not good to take the children's bread and throw it to the little dogs.

refs.text_gb: 你们要提防犬类，提防作恶的，提防妄自行割的。
refs.text_big5: 你們要提防犬類，提防作惡的，提防妄自行割的。
refs.text_en: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the concision.

refs.text_gb: 俗语说得真对，狗所吐的，它转过来又吃；猪洗净了，又到泥里去滚。这话在他们身上发生了。
refs.text_big5: 俗語說得真對，狗所吐的，牠轉過來又喫；豬洗淨了，又到泥裏去滾。這話在他們身上發生了。
refs.text_en: It has happened to them according to the true proverb: The dog has turned to its own vomit, and the washed sow to wallowing in the mud.

refs.text_gb: 以色列守望的人是瞎眼的，都没有知识，都是哑巴狗，不能吠叫；但知作梦、躺卧、贪睡。
refs.text_big5: 以色列守望的人是瞎眼的，都沒有知識，都是啞吧狗，不能吠叫；但知作夢、躺臥、貪睡。
refs.text_en: His watchmen are blind; / All of them know nothing; / All of them are dumb dogs, / They cannot bark; / Dreamers who lie down / And love to slumber.

refs.text_gb: 这些狗贪食，不知饱足。他们是缺少悟性的牧人，全都偏行己路，各求自己的利益，人人如此。
refs.text_big5: 這些狗貪食，不知飽足。他們是缺少悟性的牧人，全都偏行己路，各求自己的利益，人人如此。
refs.text_en: And these dogs are greedy; / They know no satisfaction. / And they are shepherds / Who lack understanding. / All of them have turned to their own way, / Each to his own gain, to the last of them.

refs.text_gb: 城外有那些犬类、行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的、和一切喜好并编造谎言的。
refs.text_big5: 城外有那些犬類、行邪術的、淫亂的、殺人的、拜偶像的、和一切喜好並編造謊言的。
refs.text_en: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the fornicators and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone who loves and makes a lie.

refs.text_gb: 寻到一颗珍贵的珠子，就去变卖他一切所有的，买了这珠子。
refs.text_big5: 尋到一顆珍貴的珠子，就去變賣他一切所有的，買了這珠子。
refs.text_en: And finding one pearl of great value, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

refs.text_gb: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每一个门各自是一颗珍珠造的，城内的街道是纯金，好像透明的玻璃。
refs.text_big5: 十二個門是十二顆珍珠，每一個門各自是一顆珍珠造的，城內的街道是純金，好像透明的玻璃。
refs.text_en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was, respectively, of one pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

refs.text_gb: 猪，因为分蹄，就是蹄裂两瓣，却不反刍，对你们就不洁净。
refs.text_big5: 豬，因為分蹄，就是蹄裂兩瓣，卻不反芻，對你們就不潔淨。
refs.text_en: And the pig, for though it has a divided hoof, that is, it has its hoof split in two, it does not chew the cud; it is unclean to you.

refs.text_gb: 俗语说得真对，狗所吐的，它转过来又吃；猪洗净了，又到泥里去滚。这话在他们身上发生了。
refs.text_big5: 俗語說得真對，狗所吐的，牠轉過來又喫；豬洗淨了，又到泥裏去滾。這話在他們身上發生了。
refs.text_en: It has happened to them according to the true proverb: The dog has turned to its own vomit, and the washed sow to wallowing in the mud.

verses.text_gb: 求[Fn1][Cra]，就给你们；寻[Crb]找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
verses.text_big5: 求[Fn1][Cra]，就給你們；尋[Crb]找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
verses.text_en: Ask and it shall be given to you; seek and you shall find; knock and it shall be opened to you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
verses.text_big5_plain: 求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。

footnotes.zh: 首先是求，然后是寻找，最后是叩门。求是普通的祷告，寻找是专一的恳求，叩门是最接近、最情迫的要求。
footnotes.zh_big5: 首先是求，然後是尋找，最後是叩門。求是普通的禱告，尋找是專一的懇求，叩門是最接近、最情迫的要求。
footnotes.en: 7:7 1 Ask First ask, then seek, and last knock. To ask is to pray in a common way, to seek is to supplicate in a specific way, and to knock is to demand in the most intimate and most earnest way.

refs.text_gb: 我又告诉你们，求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
refs.text_big5: 我又告訴你們，求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
refs.text_en: And I say to you, Ask and it shall be given to you; seek and you shall find; knock and it shall be opened to you.

refs.text_gb: 因为凡求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。
refs.text_big5: 因為凡求的，就得著；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
refs.text_en: For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it shall be opened.

refs.text_gb: 你们中间作父亲的，谁有儿子求鱼，反拿蛇当鱼给他？
refs.text_big5: 你們中間作父親的，誰有兒子求魚，反拿蛇當魚給他？
refs.text_en: But what father among you whose son shall ask for a fish will instead of a fish hand him a snake?

refs.text_gb: 或求鸡蛋，反给他蝎子？
refs.text_big5: 或求雞蛋，反給他蠍子？
refs.text_en: Or if he shall also ask for an egg will hand him a scorpion?

refs.text_gb: 你们虽然不好，尚且知道把好东西给儿女，何况天上的父，岂不更将圣灵给求祂的人么？
refs.text_big5: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道把好東西給兒女，何況天上的父，豈不更將聖靈給求祂的人麼？
refs.text_en: If you then being evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the Father who is from heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!

refs.text_gb: 我又实在告诉你们，你们中间若有两个人在地上，在他们所求的任何事上和谐一致，他们无论求什么，都必从我在诸天之上的父，得着成全。
refs.text_big5: 我又實在告訴你們，你們中間若有兩個人在地上，在他們所求的任何事上和諧一致，他們無論求甚麼，都必從我在諸天之上的父，得著成全。
refs.text_en: Again, truly I say to you that if two of you are in harmony on earth concerning any matter for which they ask, it will be done for them from My Father who is in the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 你们祷告，无论求什么，只要信，就必得着。
refs.text_big5: 你們禱告，無論求甚麼，只要信，就必得著。
refs.text_en: And all that you ask in prayer, if you believe, you will receive.

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，凡你们祷告祈求的，无论是什么，只要信已经得着了，就必得着。
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信已經得著了，就必得著。
refs.text_en: For this reason I say to you, All things that you pray and ask, believe that you have received them, and you will have them.

refs.text_gb: 你们在我的名里无论求什么，我必作成，叫父在子身上得荣耀。
refs.text_big5: 你們在我的名裏無論求甚麼，我必作成，叫父在子身上得榮耀。
refs.text_en: And whatever you ask in My name, that I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

refs.text_gb: 你们若住在我里面，我的话也住在你们里面，凡你们所愿意的，祈求就给你们成就。
refs.text_big5: 你們若住在我裏面，我的話也住在你們裏面，凡你們所願意的，祈求就給你們成就。
refs.text_en: If you abide in Me and My words abide in you, ask whatever you will, and it shall be done for you.

refs.text_gb: 不是你们拣选了我，乃是我拣选了你们，并且立了你们，要你们前去，并要你们结果子，且要你们的果子常存，使你们在我的名里，无论向父求什么，祂就赐给你们。
refs.text_big5: 不是你們揀選了我，乃是我揀選了你們，並且立了你們，要你們前去，並要你們結果子，且要你們的果子常存，使你們在我的名裏，無論向父求甚麼，祂就賜給你們。
refs.text_en: You did not choose Me, but I chose you, and I set you that you should go forth and bear fruit and that your fruit should remain, that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He may give you.

refs.text_gb: 到那日，你们就不问我什么了。我实实在在地告诉你们，你们在我的名里，无论向父求什么，祂必赐给你们。
refs.text_big5: 到那日，你們就不問我甚麼了。我實實在在的告訴你們，你們在我的名裏，無論向父求甚麼，祂必賜給你們。
refs.text_en: And in that day you will ask Me nothing. Truly, truly, I say to you, Whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give to you.

refs.text_gb: 向来你们没有在我的名里求什么，现在你们求，就必得着，叫你们的喜乐可以满足。
refs.text_big5: 向來你們沒有在我的名裏求甚麼，現在你們求，就必得著，叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
refs.text_en: Until now you have asked for nothing in My name; ask and you shall receive, that your joy may be made full.

refs.text_gb: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，就当求那厚赐众人，也不斥责人的神，就必有赐给他的。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間若有缺少智慧的，就當求那厚賜眾人，也不斥責人的神，就必有賜給他的。
refs.text_en: But if any one of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and does not reproach, and it will be given to him.

refs.text_gb: 只是要凭着信心求，一点不疑惑；因为那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被风吹动翻腾。
refs.text_big5: 只是要憑著信心求，一點不疑惑；因為那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被風吹動翻騰。
refs.text_en: But let him ask in faith, doubting nothing, for he who doubts is like the surge of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed about.

refs.text_gb: 并且我们不论求什么，就从祂得着；因为我们遵守祂的诫命，也行祂看为可喜悦的事。
refs.text_big5: 並且我們不論求甚麼，就從祂得著；因為我們遵守祂的誡命，也行祂看為可喜悅的事。
refs.text_en: And whatever we ask we receive from Him because we keep His commandments and do the things that are pleasing in His sight.

refs.text_gb: 我们若照祂的旨意求什么，祂就听我们；这是我们向着祂所存坦然无惧的心。
refs.text_big5: 我們若照祂的旨意求甚麼，祂就聽我們；這是我們向著祂所存坦然無懼的心。
refs.text_en: And this is the boldness which we have toward Him, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

refs.text_gb: 我们若知道祂听我们一切所求的，就知道我们所求于祂的无不得着。
refs.text_big5: 我們若知道祂聽我們一切所求的，就知道我們所求於祂的無不得著。
refs.text_en: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests which we have asked from Him.

refs.text_gb: 我儿所罗门哪，你当认识耶和华你父亲的神，全心乐意地事奉祂，因为耶和华鉴察众人的心，知道人的一切思想意念。你若寻求祂，祂必使你寻见；你若离弃祂，祂必永远丢弃你。
refs.text_big5: 我兒所羅門哪，你當認識耶和華你父親的神，全心樂意的事奉祂，因為耶和華鑒察眾人的心，知道人的一切思想意念。你若尋求祂，祂必使你尋見；你若離棄祂，祂必永遠丟棄你。
refs.text_en: And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve Him with your whole heart and with a willing soul, for Jehovah searches all the hearts and understands every imagination of the thoughts. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will cast you away forever.

refs.text_gb: 他出来迎接亚撒，对他说，亚撒和犹大、便雅悯众人哪，要听我说，你们若顺从耶和华，耶和华必与你们同在；你们若寻求祂，祂必被你们寻见；你们若离弃祂，祂必离弃你们。
refs.text_big5: 他出來迎接亞撒，對他說，亞撒和猶大、便雅憫眾人哪，要聽我說，你們若順從耶和華，耶和華必與你們同在；你們若尋求祂，祂必被你們尋見；你們若離棄祂，祂必離棄你們。
refs.text_en: And he went out to meet Asa and said to him, Hear me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: Jehovah is with you while you are with Him; and if you pursue Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.

refs.text_gb: 爱我的，我也爱他；殷切寻求我的，就必寻见。
refs.text_big5: 愛我的，我也愛他；殷切尋求我的，就必尋見。
refs.text_en: I love those who love me, / And those who seek me diligently will find me.

refs.text_gb: 你们寻求我，若全心寻求，就必寻见。
refs.text_big5: 你們尋求我，若全心尋求，就必尋見。
refs.text_en: And you will seek Me and find Me if you search for Me with all your heart;

verses.text_gb: 因为凡求[Fn1]的，就得着；寻[Fn2]找的，就寻见；叩[Fn3]门的，就给他开门。
verses.text_big5: 因為凡求[Fn1]的，就得著；尋[Fn2]找的，就尋見；叩[Fn3]門的，就給他開門。
verses.text_en: For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it shall be opened.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为凡求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為凡求的，就得著；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。

footnotes.zh: 在本节，王这部分的应许，适于国度子民为着遵守国度新律法而有的祷告。他们为此而求，就必得着。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在本節，王這部分的應許，適於國度子民為著遵守國度新律法而有的禱告。他們為此而求，就必得著。
footnotes.en: 7:8 1 asks This part of the King's promise in this verse is applicable to the prayer of the kingdom people concerning their keeping of the new law of the kingdom. They ask for this and will receive it.

footnotes.zh: 王这部分的应许，适于六33。国度子民寻求父的国和祂的义，就必寻见。
footnotes.zh_big5: 王這部分的應許，適於六33。國度子民尋求父的國和祂的義，就必尋見。
footnotes.en: 7:8 2 seeks This part of the King's promise is applicable to Matt. 6:33. The kingdom people seek the Father's kingdom and His righteousness and will find them.

footnotes.zh: 王这部分的应许，适于14节。国度子民叩门，窄门就要向他们开启。
footnotes.zh_big5: 王這部分的應許，適於14節。國度子民叩門，窄門就要向他們開啟。
footnotes.en: 7:8 3 knocks This part of the King's promise can be applied to v. 14. The narrow gate will be opened to the kingdom people as a result of their knocking.

verses.text_gb: 或者，你们中间有什么人，他的儿子向他求饼[Cra]，反给他石头？
verses.text_big5: 或者，你們中間有甚麼人，他的兒子向他求餅[Cra]，反給他石頭？
verses.text_en: Or what man is there among you who, when his son asks him for a loaf, will give him a stone?
verses.text_gb_plain: 或者，你们中间有什么人，他的儿子向他求饼，反给他石头？
verses.text_big5_plain: 或者，你們中間有甚麼人，他的兒子向他求餅，反給他石頭？

refs.text_gb: 他们就对祂说，我们这里除了五个饼两条鱼，再没有别的。
refs.text_big5: 他們就對祂說，我們這裏除了五個餅兩條魚，再沒有別的。
refs.text_en: And they said to Him, We do not have anything here except five loaves and two fish.

refs.text_gb: 于是吩咐群众坐在草地上，就拿着五个饼两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，门徒便递给群众。
refs.text_big5: 於是吩咐群眾坐在草地上，就拿著五個餅兩條魚，望著天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒便遞給群眾。
refs.text_en: And after commanding the crowds to recline on the grass, He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed them and broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples to the crowds.

verses.text_gb: 或求鱼[Cra]，反给他蛇？
verses.text_big5: 或求魚[Cra]，反給他蛇？
verses.text_en: Or also when he asks for a fish, will give him a serpent?
verses.text_gb_plain: 或求鱼，反给他蛇？
verses.text_big5_plain: 或求魚，反給他蛇？

refs.text_gb: 他们就对祂说，我们这里除了五个饼两条鱼，再没有别的。
refs.text_big5: 他們就對祂說，我們這裏除了五個餅兩條魚，再沒有別的。
refs.text_en: And they said to Him, We do not have anything here except five loaves and two fish.

refs.text_gb: 于是吩咐群众坐在草地上，就拿着五个饼两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，门徒便递给群众。
refs.text_big5: 於是吩咐群眾坐在草地上，就拿著五個餅兩條魚，望著天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒便遞給群眾。
refs.text_en: And after commanding the crowds to recline on the grass, He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed them and broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples to the crowds.

refs.text_gb: 他们便递给祂一片烧鱼。
refs.text_big5: 他們便遞給祂一片燒魚。
refs.text_en: And they handed Him a piece of broiled fish;

refs.text_gb: 他们上了岸，就看见那里放着炭火，上面放着鱼和饼。
refs.text_big5: 他們上了岸，就看見那裏放著炭火，上面放著魚和餅。
refs.text_en: Then when they got out onto the land, they saw a fire of coals laid there, and fish lying on it and bread.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就来拿饼给他们，也照样拿鱼给他们。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就來拿餅給他們，也照樣拿魚給他們。
refs.text_en: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

verses.text_gb: 你们虽然不[Fn1][Cra]好，尚且知道把好东[Fn2]西给儿女，何[Fn3]况你们在诸天之上的父，岂不更把好[Fn4][Crb]东西给求祂的人么？
verses.text_big5: 你們雖然不[Fn1][Cra]好，尚且知道把好東[Fn2]西給兒女，何[Fn3]況你們在諸天之上的父，豈不更把好[Fn4][Crb]東西給求祂的人麼？
verses.text_en: If you then being evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in the heavens give good things to those who ask Him!
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们虽然不好，尚且知道把好东西给儿女，何况你们在诸天之上的父，岂不更把好东西给求祂的人么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道把好東西給兒女，何況你們在諸天之上的父，豈不更把好東西給求祂的人麼？

footnotes.zh: 直译，邪恶。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，邪惡。
footnotes.en: 7:11 1 how This is a great promise. Such a promise affirms that the kingdom people are being cared for and supplied by their Father who is in the heavens. Thus, they are well able to fulfill the new law of the kingdom and live in the kingdom's reality that they may enter into its manifestation.

footnotes.zh: 直译，赠品。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，贈品。
footnotes.en: 7:11 2 good In the parallel verse, Luke 11:13, it is the Holy Spirit instead of good things, because Luke emphasizes the blessing of the gospel, the center of which is the Spirit (Gal. 3:8, 14). Since Matthew stresses the kingdom of the heavens, good things should refer to the blessings of the reality of the kingdom, as revealed in chs. 5—7, blessings to be given as gifts to the kingdom people.

footnotes.zh: 这是一个大的应许，确保国度子民是在他们诸天上之父的看顾和供应之下。因此，他们足能成全国度的新律法，并活在国度的实际里，使他们能进入国度的实现里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是一個大的應許，確保國度子民是在他們諸天上之父的看顧和供應之下。因此，他們足能成全國度的新律法，並活在國度的實際裏，使他們能進入國度的實現裏。

footnotes.zh: 在与本节平行的路十一13，不是说“好东西，”乃是说“圣灵，”因为路加所著重的是福音的福，其中心乃是那灵(加三8，14)。马太所强调的既是诸天的国，“好东西”就该是指国度实际的福，如五～七章所启示的，作赠品赠给国度的子民。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在與本節平行的路十一13，不是說“好東西，”乃是說“聖靈，”因為路加所著重的是福音的福，其中心乃是那靈。（加三8，14。）馬太所強調的既是諸天的國，“好東西”就該是指國度實際的福，如五～七章所啟示的，作贈品贈給國度的子民。

refs.text_gb: 毒蛇之种，你们既是恶的，怎能说出善来？因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。
refs.text_big5: 毒蛇之種，你們既是惡的，怎能說出善來？因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。
refs.text_en: Offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

refs.text_gb: 因为耶和华神是日头，是盾牌；耶和华赐下恩典和荣耀；祂未尝留下一样好处，不给那些行动正直的人。
refs.text_big5: 因為耶和華神是日頭，是盾牌；耶和華賜下恩典和榮耀；祂未嘗留下一樣好處，不給那些行動正直的人。
refs.text_en: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield; / Jehovah gives grace and glory; / He does not withhold anything good / From those who walk uprightly.

refs.text_gb: 一切美善的赐与、和各样完备的恩赐，都是从上头，从众光之父降下来的，在祂并没有变动，或转动的影儿。
refs.text_big5: 一切美善的賜與、和各樣完備的恩賜，都是從上頭，從眾光之父降下來的，在祂並沒有變動，或轉動的影兒。
refs.text_en: All good giving and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variation or shadow cast by turning.

verses.text_gb: 所以无论何事，你们愿意人怎样待[Cra]你们，你们也要怎样待人；因为这就是律[Fn1][Crb]法和申言者的总纲。
verses.text_big5: 所以無論何事，你們願意人怎樣待[Cra]你們，你們也要怎樣待人；因為這就是律[Fn1][Crb]法和申言者的總綱。
verses.text_en: Therefore all that you wish men would do to you, so also you do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以无论何事，你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人；因为这就是律法和申言者的总纲。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以無論何事，你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人；因為這就是律法和申言者的總綱。

footnotes.zh: 国度的新律法并不抵触律法和申言者，反倒成全，甚至补充。
footnotes.zh_big5: 國度的新律法並不牴觸律法和申言者，反倒成全，甚至補充。
footnotes.en: 7:12 1 law The new law of the kingdom does not contradict the law and the prophets; rather, it fulfills them and even complements them.

refs.text_gb: 你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人。
refs.text_big5: 你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人。
refs.text_en: And just as you want men to do to you, do to them likewise.

refs.text_gb: 凡事都不可亏欠人，唯有彼此相爱，要常以为亏欠，因为爱人的就完全了律法。
refs.text_big5: 凡事都不可虧欠人，惟有彼此相愛，要常以為虧欠，因為愛人的就完全了律法。
refs.text_en: Owe nothing to anyone except to love one another; for he who loves the other has fulfilled the law.

refs.text_gb: 因为“不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可贪心，”以及任何别的诫命，都总括在“要爱邻舍如同自己”这一句话里面了。
refs.text_big5: 因為“不可姦淫，不可殺人，不可偷盜，不可貪心，”以及任何別的誡命，都總括在“要愛鄰舍如同自己”這一句話裏面了。
refs.text_en: For, "You shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not covet," and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, namely, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

refs.text_gb: 爱是不加害与邻舍的，所以爱乃是律法的完满。
refs.text_big5: 愛是不加害與鄰舍的，所以愛乃是律法的完滿。
refs.text_en: Love does not work evil to his neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

refs.text_gb: 不要以为我来是要废除律法或申言者；我来不是要废除，乃是要成全。
refs.text_big5: 不要以為我來是要廢除律法或申言者；我來不是要廢除，乃是要成全。
refs.text_en: Do not think that I have come to abolish the law or the prophets; I have not come to abolish, but to fulfill.

refs.text_gb: 一切律法和申言者的教训都系于这两条诫命。
refs.text_big5: 一切律法和申言者的教訓都繫於這兩條誡命。
refs.text_en: On these two commandments hang all the Law and the Prophets.

refs.text_gb: 因为全律法都在“要爱邻舍如同自己”这一句话之内，得以完全了。
refs.text_big5: 因為全律法都在“要愛鄰舍如同自己”這一句話之內，得以完全了。
refs.text_en: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.text_gb: 你[Fn1]们要进窄[Cra]门；因为引[Fn2]到毁[Fn3][Crb]坏的，那门宽，那路阔，进去的人也多；
verses.text_big5: 你[Fn1]們要進窄[Cra]門；因為引[Fn2]到毀[Fn3][Crb]壞的，那門寬，那路闊，進去的人也多；
verses.text_en: Enter in through the narrow gate, for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter through it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要进窄门；因为引到毁坏的，那门宽，那路阔，进去的人也多；
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要進窄門；因為引到毀壞的，那門寬，那路闊，進去的人也多；

footnotes.zh: 13～29节，是王所颁布国度宪法的第七段，也是最后一段，论到国度子民生活和工作的根基。
footnotes.zh_big5: 13～29節，是王所頒佈國度憲法的第七段，也是最後一段，論到國度子民生活和工作的根基。
footnotes.en: 7:13 1 Enter The seventh and last section of the King's decree, vv. 13-29, concerns the ground of the kingdom people's living and work.

footnotes.zh: 引，直译，引开。下节者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 引，直譯，引開。下節者同。
footnotes.en: 7:13 2 leads Lit., leads away. So in the next verse.

footnotes.zh: 这里的毁坏，不是指人的沉沦，乃是指人行为和工作的毁坏(林前三15)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的毀壞，不是指人的沉淪，乃是指人行為和工作的毀壞。（林前三15。）
footnotes.en: 7:13 3 destruction Destruction here does not refer to the perishing of the person himself, but to the destruction of a person's deeds and work (1 Cor. 3:15).

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对众人说，你们要竭力进窄门，因为我告诉你们，将来有许多人想要进去，却是不能。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對眾人說，你們要竭力進窄門，因為我告訴你們，將來有許多人想要進去，卻是不能。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Struggle to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will seek to enter, yet will not be able.

refs.text_gb: 我们却不是退缩以致遭毁坏的人，乃是有信心以致得着魂的人。
refs.text_big5: 我們卻不是退縮以致遭毀壞的人，乃是有信心以致得著魂的人。
refs.text_en: But we are not of those who shrink back to ruin but of those who have faith to the gaining of the soul.

verses.text_gb: 引到生[Fn1]命的，那[Fn2]门[Cra]窄[Crb]，那路[Crc]狭，找着的人也少[Crd]。
verses.text_big5: 引到生[Fn1]命的，那[Fn2]門[Cra]窄[Crb]，那路[Crc]狹，找著的人也少[Crd]。
verses.text_en: Because narrow is the gate and constricted is the way that leads to life, and few are those who find it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 引到生命的，那门窄，那路狭，找着的人也少。
verses.text_big5_plain: 引到生命的，那門窄，那路狹，找著的人也少。

footnotes.zh: 这里的生命是指国度永远蒙福的光景，这国度充满了神永远的生命。这生命今天是在国度的实际里，来世要在国度的实现里(十九29，路十八30)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的生命是指國度永遠蒙福的光景，這國度充滿了神永遠的生命。這生命今天是在國度的實際裏，來世要在國度的實現裏。（十九29，路十八30。）
footnotes.en: 7:14 1 narrow The gate is narrow and the way is constricted because the new law of the kingdom is stricter and the demand of the kingdom higher than the law and the demand of the old covenant. The narrow gate deals not only with outward conduct but also with inward motive. The old man, the self, the flesh, the human concept, and the world with its glory are all excluded; only that which corresponds with God's will can enter in. The kingdom people need first to enter in through such a narrow gate, and then to walk on such a constricted way. It is not that they first walk the way and then enter in through the gate. To enter in through the gate is simply to begin walking on the way, a way that is lifelong.

footnotes.zh: 那门窄，那路狭，因为国度的新律法比旧约的律法更严格，而且国度的要求比旧约的要求更高。那窄门不仅对付外面的行为，也对付里面的动机。旧人、己、肉体、人的观念、世界同其荣耀，都被摒除在外；只有合乎神旨意的，才能进去。国度子民要先进这样一道窄门，然后再走一条狭路。不是先走路，再进门。进门不过是开始走路，这路乃是一生之久。
footnotes.zh_big5: 那門窄，那路狹，因為國度的新律法比舊約的律法更嚴格，而且國度的要求比舊約的要求更高。那窄門不僅對付外面的行為，也對付裏面的動機。舊人、己、肉體、人的觀念、世界同其榮耀，都被摒除在外；只有合乎神旨意的，纔能進去。國度子民要先進這樣一道窄門，然後再走一條狹路。不是先走路，再進門。進門不過是開始走路，這路乃是一生之久。
footnotes.en: 7:14 2 life Life here refers to the ever-blessed condition of the kingdom, which is filled with the eternal life of God. This life is in the reality of the kingdom today and will be in the manifestation of the kingdom in the coming age (Matt. 19:29; Luke 18:30).

refs.text_gb: 你们要给我敞开义门：我要进去，称谢耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 你們要給我敞開義門：我要進去，稱謝耶和華。
refs.text_en: Open to me the gates of righteousness: / I will enter in through them; I will give thanks to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 这是耶和华的门；义人要从这门进去。
refs.text_big5: 這是耶和華的門；義人要從這門進去。
refs.text_en: This is the gate of Jehovah; / The righteous shall enter in through it.

refs.text_gb: 我又告诉你们，骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进神的国还容易。
refs.text_big5: 我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過鍼的眼，比財主進神的國還容易。
refs.text_en: And again I say to you, It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 你必将生命的道路指示我；在你面前有满足的喜乐；在你右手中有永远的福乐。
refs.text_big5: 你必將生命的道路指示我；在你面前有滿足的喜樂；在你右手中有永遠的福樂。
refs.text_en: You will make known to me the path of life; / In Your presence is fullness of joy; / At Your right hand there are pleasures forever.

refs.text_gb: 你要对这百姓说，耶和华如此说，我将生命的路和死亡的路，摆在你们面前。
refs.text_big5: 你要對這百姓說，耶和華如此說，我將生命的路和死亡的路，擺在你們面前。
refs.text_en: And to this people you shall say, Thus says Jehovah, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，我就是道路、实际、生命；若不借着我，没有人能到父那里去。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，我就是道路、實際、生命；若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裏去。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to him, I am the way and the reality and the life; no one comes to the Father except through Me.

refs.text_gb: 向他求文书给大马色的各会堂，若是找着这道路上的人，无论男女，都可以捆绑带到耶路撒冷。
refs.text_big5: 向他求文書給大馬色的各會堂，若是找著這道路上的人，無論男女，都可以捆綁帶到耶路撒冷。
refs.text_en: And asked for letters from him to Damascus for the synagogues, so that if he found any who were of the Way, both men and women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

refs.text_gb: 后来有些人刚硬不受劝服，在许多人面前毁谤这道路，保罗就离开他们，也叫门徒与他们分离，便在推喇奴的讲堂里天天辩论。
refs.text_big5: 後來有些人剛硬不受勸服，在許多人面前毀謗這道路，保羅就離開他們，也叫門徒與他們分離，便在推喇奴的講堂裏天天辯論。
refs.text_en: But when some were hardened and would not be persuaded, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he withdrew from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

refs.text_big5: 那時，關於這道路，起了不小的擾亂。
refs.text_en: And about that time no small disturbance took place concerning the Way.

refs.text_gb: 腓力斯既更加详确的晓得关于这道路的事，就拖延他们，说，且等千夫长吕西亚下来，我要审断你们的事。
refs.text_big5: 腓力斯既更加詳確的曉得關於這道路的事，就拖延他們，說，且等千夫長呂西亞下來，我要審斷你們的事。
refs.text_en: But Felix, knowing more accurately the things concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, When Lysias the commander comes down, I will determine your affairs.

refs.text_gb: 因为被召的多，选上的少。
refs.text_big5: 因為被召的多，選上的少。
refs.text_en: For many are called but few are chosen.

verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要提防假申言者，他們到你們這裏來，外面披著綿羊的皮，裏面卻是貪食的狼。

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对我说，那些申言者托我的名说假预言；我并没有打发他们，没有吩咐他们，也没有对他们说话。他们向你们预言的，乃是虚假的异象、占卜、和虚无的事，以及自己心中的诡诈。

refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to me, The prophets prophesy falsehood in My name; I did not send them or command them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision and divination and a worthless thing and the deceit of their own heart.

refs.text_en: And many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

refs.text_gb: 因为假基督和假申言者将要起来，显大神迹和大奇事；若是可能，连选民也要迷惑了。
refs.text_big5: 因為假基督和假申言者將要起來，顯大神蹟和大奇事；若是可能，連選民也要迷惑了。

refs.text_big5: 因為假基督和假申言者將要起來，顯神蹟奇事，若是可能，連選民也要迷惑了。

refs.text_en: And when they had passed through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a certain man, a magician and Jewish false prophet, whose name was Bar-jesus,

footnotes.zh: 我们要进诸天的国，需要作两件事：呼求主，并实行天父的旨意。呼求主够叫我们得救(罗十13)，但要进诸天的国，还需要实行天父的旨意。因此，不是每一个说主啊，主啊的人，都能进诸天的国，惟独那些呼求主，且实行天父旨意的人，才能进去。 进诸天的国，既然还要实行天父的旨意，就显然与借着重生进神的国不同(约三3，5)。进神的国是借着神圣生命的出生，进诸天的国是借着神圣生命的生活。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們要進諸天的國，需要作兩件事：呼求主，並實行天父的旨意。呼求主彀叫我們得救，（羅十13，）但要進諸天的國，還需要實行天父的旨意。因此，不是每一個說主阿，主阿的人，都能進諸天的國，惟獨那些呼求主，且實行天父旨意的人，纔能進去。ˍ進諸天的國，既然還要實行天父的旨意，就顯然與藉著重生進神的國不同。（約三3，5。）進神的國是藉著神聖生命的出生，進諸天的國是藉著神聖生命的生活。
footnotes.en: 7:21 1 enter To enter into the kingdom of the heavens, we need to do two things: call on the Lord and do the will of the heavenly Father. To call on the Lord suffices for us to be saved (Rom. 10:13), but to enter into the kingdom of the heavens, we also need to do the will of the heavenly Father. Hence, not everyone who says, "Lord, Lord," will enter into the kingdom of the heavens; but those who call on the Lord and do the will of the heavenly Father will enter in. Since entering into the kingdom of the heavens requires doing the will of the heavenly Father, it is clearly different from entering into the kingdom of God through regeneration (John 3:3, 5). The latter entrance is gained through being born of the divine life; the former, through the living of that life.

footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的認識，意思是稱許。羅七15將同一字譯為認可。主從來不稱許那些在祂的名裏，卻不照著天父的旨意（21）豫言、趕鬼、並行許多異能的人。（22。）主不否認他們作了那些事，但祂認為那些事是不法的，因為不是照著天父的旨意作的，與神聖的旨意不一致。因此，他們即使在主的名裏作了那些事，也不能進諸天的國，卻要“離開”主，就是在來世被拒於國度的實現之外，不能得國度的賞賜。
footnotes.en: 7:23 1 knew Knew here means approved. The same word in Rom. 7:15 is translated acknowledge. The Lord never approved those who, in His name, prophesied, cast out demons, and did many works of power (v. 22), but did those things not according to the will of the heavenly Father (v. 21). The Lord did not deny that they did those things, but He considered those things lawlessness because they were not done according to the will of the heavenly Father; they were not done in line with the divine will. Thus, those who do such things, even in the Lord's name, will not enter into the kingdom of the heavens, but will depart from the Lord, that is, be excluded from the manifestation of the kingdom in the coming age.
