refs.text_gb: 人子要差遣祂的使者，从祂的国里薅集一切绊跌人的事，和行不法的人，
refs.text_big5: 人子要差遣祂的使者，從祂的國裏薅集一切絆跌人的事，和行不法的人，
refs.text_en: The Son of Man will send His angels, and they will collect out of His kingdom all the stumbling blocks and those who practice lawlessness,

refs.text_gb: 只因不法的事增多，许多人的爱心就渐渐冷淡了。
refs.text_big5: 只因不法的事增多，許多人的愛心就漸漸冷淡了。
refs.text_en: And because lawlessness will be multiplied, the love of the many will grow cold.

refs.text_gb: 你爱公义，恨恶不法；所以神，就是你的神，用欢乐的油膏你，胜过膏你的同伙。”
refs.text_big5: 你愛公義，恨惡不法；所以神，就是你的神，用歡樂的油膏你，勝過膏你的同夥。”
refs.text_en: You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of exultant joy above Your partners";

refs.text_gb: 祂要说，我告诉你们，我不晓得你们是哪里来的；你们这一切行不义的人，离开我去吧。
refs.text_big5: 祂要說，我告訴你們，我不曉得你們是那裏來的；你們這一切行不義的人，離開我去罷。
refs.text_en: And He will say, I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Go away from Me, all you workers of unrighteousness.

refs.text_gb: 然后祂又要对那左边的说，你们这被咒诅的，离开我，进入那为魔鬼和他的使者所预备的永火里去。
refs.text_big5: 然後祂又要對那左邊的說，你們這被咒詛的，離開我，進入那為魔鬼和他的使者所豫備的永火裏去。
refs.text_en: Then He will say also to those on the left, Go away from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

verses.text_gb: 所以，凡[Cra]听见我这些话就实[Crb]行的，好比一个精[Crc]明人，把他的房子盖在磐[Fn1][Crd]石上。
verses.text_big5: 所以，凡[Cra]聽見我這些話就實[Crb]行的，好比一個精[Crc]明人，把他的房子蓋在磐[Fn1][Crd]石上。
verses.text_en: Everyone therefore who hears these words of Mine and does them shall be likened to a prudent man who built his house upon the rock.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以，凡听见我这些话就实行的，好比一个精明人，把他的房子盖在磐石上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以，凡聽見我這些話就實行的，好比一個精明人，把他的房子蓋在磐石上。

footnotes.zh: 磐石不是指基督，乃是指基督智慧的话——那启示祂诸天之上父旨意的话。国度子民的生活和工作，必须建立在新王的话上，以成就天父的旨意。这就是进窄门，走那引到生命的狭路。
footnotes.zh_big5: 磐石不是指基督，乃是指基督智慧的話─那啟示祂諸天之上父旨意的話。國度子民的生活和工作，必須建立在新王的話上，以成就天父的旨意。這就是進窄門，走那引到生命的狹路。
footnotes.en: 7:24 1 rock Rock does not refer to Christ but to His wise word, the word that reveals the will of His Father who is in the heavens. The living and work of the kingdom people must be founded on the word of the new King for the accomplishing of the will of the heavenly Father. This is to enter in through the narrow gate and walk the constricted way that leads to life.

refs.text_gb: 凡到我这里来，听见我的话就实行的，我要指示你们，他像什么人。
refs.text_big5: 凡到我這裏來，聽見我的話就實行的，我要指示你們，他像甚麼人。
refs.text_en: Everyone who comes to Me and hears My words and does them, I will show you whom he is like.

refs.text_gb: 他像一个人盖造房子，开掘深挖，把根基安在磐石上。到了洪水泛滥的时候，河流冲击那房子，也不能摇动它，因为盖造得好。
refs.text_big5: 他像一個人蓋造房子，開掘深挖，把根基安在磐石上。到了洪水氾濫的時候，河流沖擊那房子，也不能搖動它，因為蓋造得好。
refs.text_en: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. And when a flood came, the river broke out against that house, yet it was not strong enough to shake it, because it had been built well.

refs.text_gb: 唯有听见不实行的，就像一个人在土地上盖造房子，没有根基，河流一冲，那房子立刻倒塌了，并且崩毁得很大。
refs.text_big5: 惟有聽見不實行的，就像一個人在土地上蓋造房子，沒有根基，河流一沖，那房子立刻倒塌了，並且崩毀得很大。
refs.text_en: But he who hears and does not do is like a man who built a house upon the earth without a foundation, against which the river broke out, and immediately it collapsed, and the crash of that house was great.

refs.text_gb: 只是你们要作行道者，不要单作听道者，自己欺哄自己。
refs.text_big5: 只是你們要作行道者，不要單作聽道者，自己欺哄自己。
refs.text_en: And become doers of the word and not hearers only, who delude themselves.

refs.text_gb: 因为人若是听道者，而不是行道者，就像人对着镜子看自己本来的面目；
refs.text_big5: 因為人若是聽道者，而不是行道者，就像人對著鏡子看自己本來的面目；
refs.text_en: Because if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, this one is like a man considering in a mirror the face he was born with;

refs.text_gb: 看过走开以后，随即忘了自己是什么样子。
refs.text_big5: 看過走開以後，隨即忘了自己是甚麼樣子。
refs.text_en: For he considers himself and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of person he is.

refs.text_gb: 唯有详细察看那完备自由的律法，并且时常如此的，他不是听了就忘，乃是实在行出来，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
refs.text_big5: 惟有詳細察看那完備自由的律法，並且時常如此的，他不是聽了就忘，乃是實在行出來，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
refs.text_en: But he who looks into the perfect law, the law of freedom, and continues in it, becoming not a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work, this one will be blessed in his doing.

refs.text_gb: 其中五个是愚拙的，五个是精明的。
refs.text_big5: 其中五個是愚拙的，五個是精明的。
refs.text_en: And five of them were foolish and five were prudent.

refs.text_gb: 房屋凭智慧建造，又靠聪明立稳；
refs.text_big5: 房屋憑智慧建造，又靠聰明立穩；
refs.text_en: Through wisdom a house is built, / And by understanding it is established,

refs.text_gb: 我还告诉你，你是彼得，我要把我的召会建造在这磐石上，阴间的门不能胜过她。
refs.text_big5: 我還告訴你，你是彼得，我要把我的召會建造在這磐石上，陰間的門不能勝過她。
refs.text_en: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.

verses.text_gb: 雨[Fn1]淋、河冲、风吹，撞着那房子，房子总不[Fn2]倒塌，因为是立基在磐石上。
verses.text_big5: 雨[Fn1]淋、河沖、風吹，撞著那房子，房子總不[Fn2]倒塌，因為是立基在磐石上。
verses.text_en: And the rain descended, and the rivers came, and the winds blew, and they beat against that house; and it did not fall, for it was founded on the rock.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雨淋、河冲、风吹，撞着那房子，房子总不倒塌，因为是立基在磐石上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 雨淋、河沖、風吹，撞著那房子，房子總不倒塌，因為是立基在磐石上。

footnotes.zh: 雨，来自神，从诸天降下；河，来自人，从地上冲来；风，来自撒但，从空中吹来。这一切都要试验国度子民的生活和工作。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雨，來自神，從諸天降下；河，來自人，從地上沖來；風，來自撒但，從空中吹來。這一切都要試驗國度子民的生活和工作。
footnotes.en: 7:25 1 rain The rain, which descends from the heavens, is of God; the rivers, which come from the earth, are of man; and the winds, which blow from the air, are of Satan. All these will test the living and work of the kingdom people.

footnotes.zh: 盖在磐石上不倒塌的房子，就像用金、银、宝石建造的工程，能经得起试验的火(林前三12～13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 蓋在磐石上不倒塌的房子，就像用金、銀、寶石建造的工程，能經得起試驗的火。（林前三12～13。）
footnotes.en: 7:25 2 not The house built on the rock, a house that does not fall, is like the work that is built with gold, silver, and precious stones, a work that can stand the testing fire (1 Cor. 3:12-13).

verses.text_gb: 凡听见我这些话不[Cra]实行的，好比一个愚拙人，把他的房子盖在沙[Fn1]土上。
verses.text_big5: 凡聽見我這些話不[Cra]實行的，好比一個愚拙人，把他的房子蓋在沙[Fn1]土上。
verses.text_en: And everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not do them shall be likened to a foolish man who built his house upon the sand.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡听见我这些话不实行的，好比一个愚拙人，把他的房子盖在沙土上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡聽見我這些話不實行的，好比一個愚拙人，把他的房子蓋在沙土上。

footnotes.zh: 这里的沙土，是指人的观念和天然的作法。我们若照着人的观念和天然的作法生活工作，我们的生活和工作就是盖在沉陷的沙土上。这就是进宽门，走那引到毁坏的阔路。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的沙土，是指人的觀念和天然的作法。我們若照著人的觀念和天然的作法生活工作，我們的生活和工作就是蓋在沉陷的沙土上。這就是進寬門，走那引到毀壞的闊路。
footnotes.en: 7:26 1 sand Sand refers to human concepts and natural ways. If we live and work according to our human concepts and natural ways, our living and work will be founded on sinking sand. This is to enter in through the wide gate and walk the broad way that leads to destruction.

refs.text_gb: 你对于他们，如同善于奏乐、声音幽雅之人所唱的情歌；他们听你的话却不去行。
refs.text_big5: 你對於他們，如同善於奏樂、聲音幽雅之人所唱的情歌；他們聽你的話卻不去行。
refs.text_en: And indeed you are to them like a very lovely song of one with a pleasant voice, who can play an instrument well; for they hear your words but do not do them.

verses.text_gb: 雨[Cra]淋、河冲、风吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒[Fn1]塌了，并且倒塌得很大。
verses.text_big5: 雨[Cra]淋、河沖、風吹，撞著那房子，房子就倒[Fn1]塌了，並且倒塌得很大。
verses.text_en: And the rain descended, and the rivers came, and the winds blew, and they dashed against that house; and it fell, and its fall was great.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雨淋、河冲、风吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很大。
verses.text_big5_plain: 雨淋、河沖、風吹，撞著那房子，房子就倒塌了，並且倒塌得很大。

footnotes.zh: 盖在沙土上而倒塌的房子，就像用木、草、禾秸建造的工程，要被试验的火烧毁。然而，盖造的人自己要得救(林前三12～15)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 蓋在沙土上而倒塌的房子，就像用木、草、禾秸建造的工程，要被試驗的火燒燬。然而，蓋造的人自己要得救。（林前三12～15。）
footnotes.en: 7:27 1 fell The house built on sand, a house that falls, is like the work that is built with wood, hay, and stubble, a work that will be burned by the testing fire. However, the builder himself will be saved (1 Cor. 3:12-15).

refs.text_gb: 因为他们使我的民走岔了，说，平安，其实没有平安；就像有人立起墙壁，他们倒抹上未泡透的灰。
refs.text_big5: 因為他們使我的民走岔了，說，平安，其實沒有平安；就像有人立起牆壁，他們倒抹上未泡透的灰。
refs.text_en: Because, indeed because, they have led My people astray, saying, Peace, when there is no peace; but it is as if someone builds up a wall, and immediately they plaster it over with untempered mortar.

refs.text_gb: 所以你要对那些抹上未泡透灰的人说，墙要倒塌。必有暴雨漫过；大冰雹啊，你们要降下；暴风也要吹裂这墙。
refs.text_big5: 所以你要對那些抹上未泡透灰的人說，牆要倒塌。必有暴雨漫過；大冰雹阿，你們要降下；暴風也要吹裂這牆。
refs.text_en: Tell those who plaster over with untempered mortar that it will fall. There will be a flooding rain; and you, O hailstones, will fall; and a tempestuous wind will break it down.

refs.text_gb: 这墙倒塌之后，人岂不问你们说，你们抹上未泡透的灰在哪里呢？
refs.text_big5: 這牆倒塌之後，人豈不問你們說，你們抹上未泡透的灰在那裏呢？
refs.text_en: Indeed when the wall has fallen, will it not be said to you, Where is the plaster with which you plastered it?

refs.text_gb: 所以主耶和华如此说，我要在忿怒中使暴风吹裂这墙，在我的怒气中必有暴雨漫过，并有大冰雹在忿怒中毁灭这墙。
refs.text_big5: 所以主耶和華如此說，我要在忿怒中使暴風吹裂這牆，在我的怒氣中必有暴雨漫過，並有大冰雹在忿怒中毀滅這牆。
refs.text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord Jehovah, I will cause a tempestuous wind to break forth in My wrath, and there will be a flooding rain in My anger, and hailstones to consume it in wrath.

refs.text_gb: 我要拆毁你们用未泡透灰所抹的墙，拆平到地，以致根基露出；墙必倒塌，你们也必在其中灭亡；你们就知道我是耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 我要拆毀你們用未泡透灰所抹的牆，拆平到地，以致根基露出；牆必倒塌，你們也必在其中滅亡；你們就知道我是耶和華。
refs.text_en: And I will tear down the wall that you plastered over with untempered mortar and will tear it down to the ground, so that its foundation is uncovered; and it will fall, and you will be consumed in the midst of it; and you will know that I am Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣讲完了这些话，群众都惊[Cra]讶祂的教训；
verses.text_big5: 耶穌講完了這些話，群眾都驚[Cra]訝祂的教訓；
verses.text_en: And when Jesus finished these words, the crowds were astounded at His teaching,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣讲完了这些话，群众都惊讶祂的教训；
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌講完了這些話，群眾都驚訝祂的教訓；

refs.text_gb: 来到自己的家乡，在他们的会堂里教训他们，以致他们都惊讶说，这人的智慧和异能，是从哪里来的？
refs.text_big5: 來到自己的家鄉，在他們的會堂裏教訓他們，以致他們都驚訝說，這人的智慧和異能，是從那裏來的？
refs.text_en: And He came into His own country and taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astounded and said, Where did this man get this wisdom and these works of power?

refs.text_gb: 群众听见了，就惊讶祂的教训。
refs.text_big5: 群眾聽見了，就驚訝祂的教訓。
refs.text_en: And when the crowds heard this, they were astounded at His teaching.

refs.text_gb: 众人都惊讶祂的教训，因为祂教训他们，像有权柄的人，不像经学家。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都驚訝祂的教訓，因為祂教訓他們，像有權柄的人，不像經學家。
refs.text_en: And they were astounded at His teaching, for He taught them as One having authority and not like the scribes.

refs.text_gb: 到了安息日，祂在会堂里施教；许多人听见，就甚惊讶，说，这人从哪里得来这些事？所赐给祂的是什么样的智慧！这样的异能竟然经祂的手行出来！
refs.text_big5: 到了安息日，祂在會堂裏施教；許多人聽見，就甚驚訝，說，這人從那裏得來這些事？所賜給祂的是甚麼樣的智慧！這樣的異能竟然經祂的手行出來！
refs.text_en: And when the Sabbath had come, He began to teach in the synagogue; and many hearing were astounded, saying, Where did this man get these things? And what is this wisdom given to this man, and how is it that such works of power take place through His hands?

refs.text_gb: 祭司长和经学家听见，就设法怎样除灭耶稣，却又怕祂，因为群众都惊讶祂的教训。
refs.text_big5: 祭司長和經學家聽見，就設法怎樣除滅耶穌，卻又怕祂，因為群眾都驚訝祂的教訓。
refs.text_en: And the chief priests and the scribes heard this, and they sought how they might destroy Him, for they feared Him, for all the crowd was astounded at His teaching.

refs.text_gb: 他们都惊讶祂的教训，因为祂的话带着权柄。
refs.text_big5: 他們都驚訝祂的教訓，因為祂的話帶著權柄。
refs.text_en: And they were astounded at His teaching, because His word was with authority.

verses.text_gb: 因为祂教训他们，像[Cra]有权[Fn1][Crb]柄的人，不像他们的经学家。
verses.text_big5: 因為祂教訓他們，像[Cra]有權[Fn1][Crb]柄的人，不像他們的經學家。
verses.text_en: For He taught them as One having authority and not like their scribes.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为祂教训他们，像有权柄的人，不像他们的经学家。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為祂教訓他們，像有權柄的人，不像他們的經學家。

footnotes.zh: 基督这诸天之国的新王，颁布国度的新律法时，话语带着权柄。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督這諸天之國的新王，頒佈國度的新律法時，話語帶著權柄。
footnotes.en: 7:29 1 authority Christ, as the new King of the kingdom of the heavens, spoke with authority in decreeing the new law of the kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 差役回答说，从来没有像祂这样说话的。
refs.text_big5: 差役回答說，從來沒有像祂這樣說話的。
refs.text_en: The attendants answered, Never has a man spoken as this man has.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进了殿，正施教的时候，祭司长和民间的长老到祂跟前来，说，你仗着什么权柄作这些事？给你这权柄的是谁？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進了殿，正施教的時候，祭司長和民間的長老到祂跟前來，說，你仗著甚麼權柄作這些事？給你這權柄的是誰？
refs.text_en: And when He came into the temple, the chief priests and elders of the people came to Him as He was teaching and said, By what authority do You do these things? And who gave You this authority?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，我也要问你们一句话，你们若告诉我，我就告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，我也要問你們一句話，你們若告訴我，我就告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
refs.text_en: And Jesus answered and said to them, I also will ask you one thing, which if you tell Me, I also will tell you by what authority I do these things.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进前来，对他们说，天上地上所有的权柄，都赐给我了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進前來，對他們說，天上地上所有的權柄，都賜給我了。
refs.text_en: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣下[Fn1]了山[Cra]，有好多群[Crb]众跟着祂。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌下[Fn1]了山[Cra]，有好多群[Crb]眾跟著祂。
verses.text_en: And when He came down from the mountain, great crowds followed Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣下了山，有好多群众跟着祂。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌下了山，有好多群眾跟著祂。

footnotes.zh: 新王颁布了国度的新律法，就下山继续祂君王的职事。祂作的头一件事，就是洁净污秽的人，医治有病的人，并把鬼附之人身上的鬼赶出去，使他们可以成为诸天之国的子民(2～17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 新王頒佈了國度的新律法，就下山繼續祂君王的職事。祂作的頭一件事，就是潔淨污穢的人，醫治有病的人，並把鬼附之人身上的鬼趕出去，使他們可以成為諸天之國的子民。（2～17。）
footnotes.en: 8:1 1 came After decreeing the new law of the kingdom, the new King came down from the mountain to carry on His kingly ministry. The first things He did were to cleanse the unclean, heal the sick, and cast the demons out of the possessed that they might become people of the kingdom of the heavens (vv. 2-17).

refs.text_gb: 但祂看见这些群众，就上了山；既已坐下，门徒到祂跟前来。
refs.text_big5: 但祂看見這些群眾，就上了山；既已坐下，門徒到祂跟前來。
refs.text_en: And when He saw the crowds, He went up to the mountain. And after He sat down, His disciples came to Him.

refs.text_gb: 并且有好多群众从加利利、低加波利、耶路撒冷、犹太和约但河外，来跟着祂。
refs.text_big5: 並且有好多群眾從加利利、低加波利、耶路撒冷、猶太和約但河外，來跟著祂。
refs.text_en: And great crowds followed Him from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judea and from beyond the Jordan.

refs.text_gb: 但祂看见这些群众，就上了山；既已坐下，门徒到祂跟前来。
refs.text_big5: 但祂看見這些群眾，就上了山；既已坐下，門徒到祂跟前來。
refs.text_en: And when He saw the crowds, He went up to the mountain. And after He sat down, His disciples came to Him.

verses.text_gb: 看[Cra]哪，有一个患[Fn1][Crb]麻风的人前来拜[Fn2][Crc]祂，说，主啊，你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。
verses.text_big5: 看[Cra]哪，有一個患[Fn1][Crb]痲瘋的人前來拜[Fn2][Crc]祂，說，主阿，你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。
verses.text_en: And behold, a leper, coming near, worshipped Him, saying, Lord, if You are willing, You can cleanse me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 看哪，有一个患麻风的人前来拜祂，说，主啊，你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 看哪，有一個患痲瘋的人前來拜祂，說，主阿，你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。

footnotes.zh: 蒙君尊的救主拯救，成为国度子民的头一班人，是以患麻风的人为代表。按照圣经的事例，麻风来自背叛与不服。米利暗成了患麻风的，是由于她背叛神的代表权柄(民十二1～10)。乃缦的麻风得了洁净，是由于他的顺从(王下五1，9～14)。堕落的人类由于对神的背叛，在神眼中都成了患麻风的。现在君尊的救主来了，拯救人脱离他们的背叛，并洁净他们的麻风，使他们能成为祂国度的子民。
footnotes.zh_big5: 蒙君尊的救主拯救，成為國度子民的頭一班人，是以患痲瘋的人為代表。按照聖經的事例，痲瘋來自背叛與不服。米利暗成了患痲瘋的，是由於她背叛神的代表權柄。（民十二1～10。）乃縵的痲瘋得了潔淨，是由於他的順從。（王下五1，9～14。）墮落的人類由於對神的背叛，在神眼中都成了患痲瘋的。現在君尊的救主來了，拯救人脫離他們的背叛，並潔淨他們的痲瘋，使他們能成為祂國度的子民。
footnotes.en: 8:2 1 leper The first class of people saved by the kingly Savior to be the people of the kingdom is represented by a leper. According to the examples in the Scriptures, leprosy results from rebellion and disobedience. Miriam became leprous because of her rebellion against God's deputy authority (Num. 12:1-10). Naaman's leprosy was cleansed because of his obedience (2 Kings 5:1, 9-14). All fallen human beings have become leprous in the eyes of God because of their rebellion. The kingly Savior came to save men from their rebellion and to cleanse them from their leprosy that they might become His kingdom people.

footnotes.zh: 患麻风的人来拜新王，称祂为主，承认祂是主神。实际上，新王就是耶和华救主，耶稣(见一21注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 患痲瘋的人來拜新王，稱祂為主，承認祂是主神。實際上，新王就是耶和華救主，耶穌。（見一21註1。）
footnotes.en: 8:2 2 worshipped The leper worshipped the new King and called Him "Lord," recognizing that He is the Lord God. In reality the new King is Jehovah the Savior — Jesus. (See note Matt. 1:21 1 .)

refs.text_gb: 有一个患麻风的来到耶稣跟前，恳求祂，跪下向祂说，你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 有一個患痲瘋的來到耶穌跟前，懇求祂，跪下向祂說，你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And a leper came to Him, entreating Him and falling on his knees and saying to Him, If You are willing, You can cleanse me.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就动了慈心，伸手摸他，说，我肯，你洁净了吧。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就動了慈心，伸手摸他，說，我肯，你潔淨了罷。
refs.text_en: And He was moved with compassion, and stretching out His hand, He touched him and said to him, I am willing; be cleansed!

refs.text_gb: 麻风立即离开他，他就洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 痲瘋立即離開他，他就潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣严严地嘱咐他，即刻打发他走，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌嚴嚴的囑咐他，即刻打發他走，
refs.text_en: And sternly charging him, immediately He thrust him out,

refs.text_gb: 又对他说，你要当心，什么都不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，又要为你得了洁净，献上摩西所规定的礼物，对他们作证据。
refs.text_big5: 又對他說，你要當心，甚麼都不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又要為你得了潔淨，獻上摩西所規定的禮物，對他們作證據。
refs.text_en: And said to him, See that you say nothing to anyone; but go, show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

refs.text_gb: 有一次，耶稣在一个城里，看哪，有一个满身患麻风的人看见耶稣，就面伏于地，求祂说，主啊，你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 有一次，耶穌在一個城裏，看哪，有一個滿身患痲瘋的人看見耶穌，就面伏於地，求祂說，主阿，你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And while He was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. And when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged Him, saying, Lord, if You are willing, You can cleanse me.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣伸手摸他，说，我肯，你洁净了吧。麻风就立刻离开了他。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌伸手摸他，說，我肯，你潔淨了罷。痲瘋就立刻離開了他。
refs.text_en: And stretching out His hand, He touched him, saying, I am willing; be cleansed! And immediately the leprosy left him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣嘱咐他说，你不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，又要为你得了洁净，照摩西所规定的，献上礼物，对他们作证据。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌囑咐他說，你不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又要為你得了潔淨，照摩西所規定的，獻上禮物，對他們作證據。
refs.text_en: And He charged him to tell no one: But go away, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift for your cleansing, even as Moses directed, for a testimony to them.

refs.text_gb: 人的肉皮上若长了肿块，或长了癣，或长了火斑，在他肉皮上成了麻风的灾病，就要带他到祭司亚伦或亚伦作祭司的一个子孙面前。
refs.text_big5: 人的肉皮上若長了腫塊，或長了癬，或長了火斑，在他肉皮上成了痲瘋的災病，就要帶他到祭司亞倫或亞倫作祭司的一個子孫面前。
refs.text_en: When a man has a swelling or an eruption or a bright spot on the skin of his body, and it becomes an infection of leprosy on the skin of his body, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests.

refs.text_gb: 那人就是患麻风，是不洁净的；祭司要确定他为不洁净，他的灾病是在头上。
refs.text_big5: 那人就是患痲瘋，是不潔淨的；祭司要確定他為不潔淨，他的災病是在頭上。
refs.text_en: He is a leprous man; he is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his infection is on his head.

refs.text_gb: 患麻风灾病的人，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬头散发，蒙着上唇，喊叫说，不洁净！不洁净！
refs.text_big5: 患痲瘋災病的人，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬頭散髮，蒙著上脣，喊叫說，不潔淨！不潔淨！
refs.text_en: And as for the leper in whom the infection is, his clothes shall be torn, and the hair of his head shall be let loose, and he shall cover his upper lip and cry, Unclean, unclean!

refs.text_gb: 灾病在他身上的日子，他就是不洁净的；他既是不洁净，就要独居营外。
refs.text_big5: 災病在他身上的日子，他就是不潔淨的；他既是不潔淨，就要獨居營外。
refs.text_en: He shall be unclean all the days during which the infection is in him; he is unclean. He shall live alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.

refs.text_gb: 云彩从会幕上挪开了，不料，米利暗患了麻风，像雪那样白。亚伦转向米利暗，见她患了麻风，
refs.text_big5: 雲彩從會幕上挪開了，不料，米利暗患了痲瘋，像雪那樣白。亞倫轉向米利暗，見她患了痲瘋，
refs.text_en: And when the cloud had departed from over the tent; there Miriam was, leprous, as white as snow. And Aaron turned toward Miriam, and there she was, leprous.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，她父亲若吐唾沫在她脸上，她岂不蒙羞七天么？现在要把她在营外隔离七天，然后才可以领她进来。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，她父親若吐唾沫在她臉上，她豈不蒙羞七天麼？現在要把她在營外隔離七天，然後纔可以領她進來。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, If her father had just spat in her face, would she not bear her shame seven days? Let her be shut up outside the camp seven days, and after that she may be brought in again.

refs.text_gb: 于是米利暗被隔离在营外七天。百姓没有往前行，直到把米利暗领进来。
refs.text_big5: 於是米利暗被隔離在營外七天。百姓沒有往前行，直到把米利暗領進來。
refs.text_en: So Miriam was shut up outside the camp seven days, and the people did not set out until Miriam had been brought in again.

refs.text_gb: 乌西雅王患麻风直到死日；他身患麻风，住在别的宫里，因他从耶和华的殿被隔离了。他儿子约坦管理王家的事，治理那地的民。
refs.text_big5: 烏西雅王患痲瘋直到死日；他身患痲瘋，住在別的宮裏，因他從耶和華的殿被隔離了。他兒子約坦管理王家的事，治理那地的民。
refs.text_en: So Uzziah the king was a leper until the day of his death; and he dwelt in a separate house as a leper, for he was cut off from the house of Jehovah. And Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

refs.text_gb: 进了屋子，看见那孩子和祂母亲马利亚，就俯伏拜祂，揭开宝盒，向祂献上黄金、乳香和没药为礼物。
refs.text_big5: 進了屋子，看見那孩子和祂母親馬利亞，就俯伏拜祂，揭開寶盒，向祂獻上黃金、乳香和沒藥為禮物。
refs.text_en: And they came into the house and saw the child with Mary His mother. And falling down, they worshipped Him; and opening their treasures, they offered gifts to Him, gold and frankincense and myrrh.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣正对他们讲这些事的时候，看哪，有一个管会堂的来拜祂，说，我的女儿刚死了，但你去按手在她身上，她就要活了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌正對他們講這些事的時候，看哪，有一個管會堂的來拜祂，說，我的女兒剛死了，但你去按手在她身上，她就要活了。
refs.text_en: As He was speaking these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshipped Him, saying, My daughter has just died, but come and lay Your hand on her, and she will live.

refs.text_gb: 那妇人来拜祂，说，主啊，帮助我！
refs.text_big5: 那婦人來拜祂，說，主阿，幫助我！
refs.text_en: But she came and worshipped Him, saying, Lord, help me!

refs.text_gb: 那时，西庇太儿子的母亲，同她儿子们进前来拜耶稣，求祂一件事。
refs.text_big5: 那時，西庇太兒子的母親，同她兒子們進前來拜耶穌，求祂一件事。
refs.text_en: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to Him with her sons, worshipping and asking something of Him.

refs.text_gb: 他说，主啊，我信，就拜耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 他說，主阿，我信，就拜耶穌。
refs.text_en: And he said, Lord, I believe; and he worshipped Him.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣伸手摸[Fn1][Cra]他，说，我肯，你洁净了吧。他的麻风立刻洁净了。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌伸手摸[Fn1][Cra]他，說，我肯，你潔淨了罷。他的痲瘋立刻潔淨了。

verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣伸手摸他，说，我肯，你洁净了吧。他的麻风立刻洁净了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌伸手摸他，說，我肯，你潔淨了罷。他的痲瘋立刻潔淨了。

footnotes.zh: 按照律法，患麻风的人因着他的不洁，应当从民中隔离，人不能摸他(利十三45～46)。但这位是人，又是君尊救主的新王，却摸了他。何等的怜悯和同情！祂一摸，患麻风的人立刻就洁净了。何等奇妙的洁净！
footnotes.zh_big5: 按照律法，患痲瘋的人因著他的不潔，應當從民中隔離，人不能摸他。（利十三45～46。）但這位是人，又是君尊救主的新王，卻摸了他。何等的憐憫和同情！祂一摸，患痲瘋的人立刻就潔淨了。何等奇妙的潔淨！
footnotes.en: 8:3 1 touched According to the law, a leper was to be isolated from the people because of his uncleanness. No one was allowed to touch him (Lev. 13:45-46). But the new King, as a man and as the kingly Savior, touched this leper. What mercy and sympathy! By His one touch, his leprosy was immediately cleansed. What wonderful cleansing!

refs.text_gb: 耶稣摸她的手，烧就退了；她便起来服事耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌摸她的手，燒就退了；她便起來服事耶穌。
refs.text_en: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her. And she arose and served Him.

refs.text_big5: 耶穌就摸他們的眼睛，說，照著你們的信，給你們成就了罷！
refs.text_en: Then He touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith, let it be done to you.

verses.text_en: And Jesus said to him, See that you tell no one; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

footnotes.zh: 新王告诉得了洁净的麻风病人，为着自己的洁净，仍要按照旧律法的规条行事，因为那时仍在过渡时期，旧律法还没有借祂救赎的死得着成全。
footnotes.zh_big5: 新王告訴得了潔淨的痲瘋病人，為著自己的潔淨，仍要按照舊律法的規條行事，因為那時仍在過渡時期，舊律法還沒有藉祂救贖的死得著成全。
footnotes.en: 8:4 1 show The new King told the cleansed leper that for his cleansing he should continue to do things according to the regulations of the old law, because the transitional period still remained, the old law having not yet been fulfilled by His redeeming death.

footnotes.zh: 直译，自己。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，自己。

refs.text_gb: 他们的眼睛就开了。耶稣严严地嘱咐他们说，当心，不可让人知道。
refs.text_big5: 他們的眼睛就開了。耶穌嚴嚴的囑咐他們說，當心，不可讓人知道。
refs.text_en: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus sternly charged them saying, See that no one knows!

refs.text_gb: 耶稣嘱咐他们，不要告诉人。但祂越发嘱咐他们，他们越发大大地传扬开了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌囑咐他們，不要告訴人。但祂越發囑咐他們，他們越發大大的傳揚開了。
refs.text_en: And He charged them not to tell anyone. But the more He charged them, so much the more they proclaimed it.

refs.text_gb: 这灾病在衣服上或皮子上，经上或纬上，或在皮子作的什么物件上，若是发绿或发红，那就是麻风的灾病，要给祭司察看。
refs.text_big5: 這災病在衣服上或皮子上，經上或緯上，或在皮子作的甚麼物件上，若是發綠或發紅，那就是痲瘋的災病，要給祭司察看。
refs.text_en: If the infection is greenish or reddish in the garment or in the skin, or in the warp or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is the infection of leprosy and shall be shown to the priest.

refs.text_gb: 患麻风的人得洁净的日子，其条例乃是这样：要带他去见祭司；
refs.text_big5: 患痲瘋的人得潔淨的日子，其條例乃是這樣：要帶他去見祭司；
refs.text_en: This shall be the law of the leper on the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,

refs.text_gb: 祭司要出到营外察看，若见他身上麻风的灾病痊愈了，
refs.text_big5: 祭司要出到營外察看，若見他身上痲瘋的災病痊愈了，
refs.text_en: And the priest shall go forth outside the camp. Then the priest shall look, and if the infection of leprosy has been healed in the leper,

refs.text_gb: 就要吩咐人为那求洁净的，拿两只洁净的活鸟、香柏木、朱红色线和牛膝草来。
refs.text_big5: 就要吩咐人為那求潔淨的，拿兩隻潔淨的活鳥、香柏木、朱紅色線和牛膝草來。
refs.text_en: Then the priest shall command that two living clean birds and cedar wood and scarlet strands and hyssop be taken for the one who is to be cleansed.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要吩咐人用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要吩咐人用瓦器盛活水，把一隻鳥宰在上面。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be slaughtered in an earthen vessel over running water.

refs.text_gb: 至于那只活鸟，祭司要把它和香柏木、朱红色线并牛膝草，一同蘸于宰在活水上之鸟的血中，
refs.text_big5: 至於那隻活鳥，祭司要把牠和香柏木、朱紅色線並牛膝草，一同蘸於宰在活水上之鳥的血中，
refs.text_en: As for the living bird, he shall take it and the cedar wood and the scarlet strands and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the running water.

refs.text_gb: 用以在那患麻风求洁净的人身上洒七次，就定他为洁净，又把那只活鸟放到田野里。
refs.text_big5: 用以在那患痲瘋求潔淨的人身上灑七次，就定他為潔淨，又把那隻活鳥放到田野裏。
refs.text_en: And he shall sprinkle it on the one who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times and shall pronounce him clean. Then he shall let the living bird go into the open field.

refs.text_gb: 那求洁净的人当洗衣服，剃去所有的毛发，用水洗澡，就洁净了；然后可以进营，只是要在自己的帐棚外居住七天。
refs.text_big5: 那求潔淨的人當洗衣服，剃去所有的毛髮，用水洗澡，就潔淨了；然後可以進營，只是要在自己的帳棚外居住七天。
refs.text_en: And the one who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes and shave off all his hair and bathe in water, and he shall be clean. And after that he may come into the camp, but he shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

refs.text_gb: 第七天，他要再剃去所有的毛发，把头发、胡须、眉毛、并全身的毛都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 第七天，他要再剃去所有的毛髮，把頭髮、鬍鬚、眉毛、並全身的毛都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And on the seventh day he shall shave off all his hair; he shall shave his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair. Then he shall wash his clothes and bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣看见，就对他们说，你们去，把身体给祭司察看。他们去的时候，就洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌看見，就對他們說，你們去，把身體給祭司察看。他們去的時候，就潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And when He saw them, He said to them, Go and show yourselves to the priests. And as they went, they were cleansed.

refs.text_gb: 第八天，他要取两只没有残疾的公羊羔和一只没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔，又要把调油的细面一伊法的十分之三为素祭，并油一罗革，一同取来。
refs.text_big5: 第八天，他要取兩隻沒有殘疾的公羊羔和一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔，又要把調油的細麵一伊法的十分之三為素祭，並油一羅革，一同取來。
refs.text_en: And on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish and three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mingled with oil and one log of oil.

refs.text_gb: 行洁净之礼的祭司，要将那求洁净的人和这些东西安置在会幕门口、耶和华面前。
refs.text_big5: 行潔淨之禮的祭司，要將那求潔淨的人和這些東西安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前。
refs.text_en: And the priest who makes him clean shall set the man to be cleansed and those things before Jehovah at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要取一只公羊羔献为赎愆祭，和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要取一隻公羊羔獻為贖愆祭，和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall take one of the male lambs and present it as a trespass offering and the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 他要在宰赎罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地，就是在圣处，宰那只公羊羔；赎愆祭要归祭司，与赎罪祭一样；这是至圣的。
refs.text_big5: 他要在宰贖罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地，就是在聖處，宰那隻公羊羔；贖愆祭要歸祭司，與贖罪祭一樣；這是至聖的。
refs.text_en: Then he shall slaughter the male lamb in the place where they slaughter the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for the trespass offering, like the sin offering, is the priest's; it is most holy.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在求洁净之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在求潔淨之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要从那一罗革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌里，
refs.text_big5: 祭司要從那一羅革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌裏，
refs.text_en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour it into the palm of the priest's left hand,

refs.text_gb: 把右手的一个指头蘸在左手掌的油里，在耶和华面前用指头弹油七次；
refs.text_big5: 把右手的一個指頭蘸在左手掌的油裏，在耶和華面前用指頭彈油七次；
refs.text_en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in the palm of his left hand and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 将手掌里所剩的油抹些在那求洁净之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，就是抹在赎愆祭牲的血上。
refs.text_big5: 將手掌裏所剩的油抹些在那求潔淨之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹在贖愆祭牲的血上。
refs.text_en: And from the rest of the oil that is in the palm of his hand the priest shall put some on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is to be cleansed and some on the thumb of his right hand and some on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

refs.text_gb: 祭司手掌里所剩的油，要抹在那求洁净之人的头上。然后祭司要在耶和华面前为他遮罪。
refs.text_big5: 祭司手掌裏所剩的油，要抹在那求潔淨之人的頭上。然後祭司要在耶和華面前為他遮罪。
refs.text_en: And the rest of the oil that is in the palm of the priest's hand he shall put on the head of the one who is to be cleansed. Then the priest shall make expiation for him before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要献赎罪祭，为那因不洁净而求洁净的人遮罪；然后要宰燔祭牲，
refs.text_big5: 祭司要獻贖罪祭，為那因不潔淨而求潔淨的人遮罪；然後要宰燔祭牲，
refs.text_en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering and make expiation for the one who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness, and afterward he shall slaughter the burnt offering.

refs.text_gb: 把燔祭和素祭献在坛上。祭司这样为他遮罪，他就洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 把燔祭和素祭獻在壇上。祭司這樣為他遮罪，他就潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. Thus the priest shall make expiation for him, and he shall be clean.

refs.text_gb: 他若贫穷，力量不够献那么多，就要取一只公羊羔作赎愆祭，摇一摇，为他遮罪；也要把调油的细面一伊法的十分之一为素祭，和油一罗革一同取来；
refs.text_big5: 他若貧窮，力量不彀獻那麼多，就要取一隻公羊羔作贖愆祭，搖一搖，為他遮罪；也要把調油的細麵一伊法的十分之一為素祭，和油一羅革一同取來；
refs.text_en: But if he is poor and cannot afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved to make expiation for him, and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil,

refs.text_gb: 又照他力量所及的，取两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
refs.text_big5: 又照他力量所及的，取兩隻斑鳩或兩隻雛鴿，一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭。
refs.text_en: And two turtledoves or two young pigeons, such as he can afford; and the one shall be a sin offering and the other a burnt offering.

refs.text_gb: 第八天，他为了得洁净，要把这些带到会幕门口、耶和华面前，交给祭司。
refs.text_big5: 第八天，他為了得潔淨，要把這些帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司。
refs.text_en: And on the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要取赎愆祭的羊羔，和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；
refs.text_big5: 祭司要取贖愆祭的羊羔，和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；
refs.text_en: Then the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before Jehovah;

refs.text_gb: 要宰了赎愆祭的羊羔，取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在那求洁净之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
refs.text_big5: 要宰了贖愆祭的羊羔，取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在那求潔淨之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
refs.text_en: And he shall slaughter the lamb of the trespass offering. Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌里，
refs.text_big5: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌裏，
refs.text_en: And the priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of the priest's left hand,

refs.text_gb: 用右手的一个指头，把左手掌里的油，在耶和华面前弹七次，
refs.text_big5: 用右手的一個指頭，把左手掌裏的油，在耶和華面前彈七次，
refs.text_en: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in the palm of his left hand seven times before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 又把手掌里的油抹些在那求洁净之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，就是抹在赎愆祭牲之血的地方。
refs.text_big5: 又把手掌裏的油抹些在那求潔淨之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹在贖愆祭牲之血的地方。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall put some of the oil that is in the palm of his hand on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

refs.text_gb: 祭司手掌里所剩的油，要抹在那求洁净之人的头上，在耶和华面前为他遮罪。
refs.text_big5: 祭司手掌裏所剩的油，要抹在那求潔淨之人的頭上，在耶和華面前為他遮罪。
refs.text_en: And the rest of the oil that is in the palm of the priest's hand he shall put on the head of the one who is to be cleansed, to make expiation for him before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 那人又要照他力量所及的，献上一只斑鸠或一只雏鸽，
refs.text_big5: 那人又要照他力量所及的，獻上一隻斑鳩或一隻雛鴿，
refs.text_en: And he shall offer one of the turtledoves or young pigeons, such as he can afford,

refs.text_gb: 就是照他力量所及的，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，与素祭一同献上；祭司要在耶和华面前为那求洁净的人遮罪。
refs.text_big5: 就是照他力量所及的，一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，與素祭一同獻上；祭司要在耶和華面前為那求潔淨的人遮罪。
refs.text_en: Even such as he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering; and the priest shall make expiation for the one who is to be cleansed before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 这是那有麻风灾病的人，要得洁净而力量不够时的条例。
refs.text_big5: 這是那有痲瘋災病的人，要得潔淨而力量不彀時的條例。
refs.text_en: This is the law for the one in whom there is the infection of leprosy, who cannot afford what is prescribed for his cleansing.

verses.text_gb: 耶[Cra]稣进了迦[Crb]百农，有一个百[Fn1][Crc]夫长到祂跟前来，恳求祂说，
verses.text_big5: 耶[Cra]穌進了迦[Crb]百農，有一個百[Fn1][Crc]夫長到祂跟前來，懇求祂說，
verses.text_en: And when He entered into Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, beseeching Him
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣进了迦百农，有一个百夫长到祂跟前来，恳求祂说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌進了迦百農，有一個百夫長到祂跟前來，懇求祂說，

footnotes.zh: 罗马军队中管理一百名士兵的军官。2～4节患麻风的人，代表犹太人；5～13节的百夫长，代表外邦人。在神面前，犹太人因着他们的背叛、不服，成了患麻风、不洁净的；外邦人因着他们的罪，成了瘫痪、死了功能的。君尊的救主先临到犹太人，后临到外邦人(徒三26，十三46，罗一16，十一11)。相信的犹太人是因着祂直接的摸而得救(3)，相信的外邦人是借着信祂的话而得救(8，10，13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 羅馬軍隊中管理一百名士兵的軍官。2～4節患痲瘋的人，代表猶太人；5～13節的百夫長，代表外邦人。在神面前，猶太人因著他們的背叛、不服，成了患痲瘋、不潔淨的；外邦人因著他們的罪，成了癱瘓、死了功能的。君尊的救主先臨到猶太人，後臨到外邦人。（徒三26，十三46，羅一16，十一11。）相信的猶太人是因著祂直接的摸而得救，（3，）相信的外邦人是藉著信祂的話而得救。（8，10，13。）
footnotes.en: 8:5 1 centurion An officer over one hundred soldiers in the Roman army. The leper in vv. 2-4 represents the Jews, whereas the centurion in vv. 5-13 represents the Gentiles. Before God, the Jews had become leprous, unclean, because of their rebellion and disobedience, whereas the Gentiles had become paralyzed, dead in function, because of their sinfulness. The kingly Savior came first to the Jews and then to the Gentiles (Acts 3:26; 13:46; Rom. 1:16; 11:11). The believing Jews were saved by His direct touch (v. 3), whereas the believing Gentiles are saved through faith in His word (vv. 8, 10, 13).

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对百姓讲完了这一切的话，就进了迦百农。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對百姓講完了這一切的話，就進了迦百農。
refs.text_en: After He completed all His words in the hearing of the people, He entered into Capernaum.

refs.text_gb: 有一个百夫长所宝贵的奴仆，患病快要死了。
refs.text_big5: 有一個百夫長所寶貴的奴僕，患病快要死了。
refs.text_en: And a certain centurion's slave, who was highly valued by him, was ill and about to die.

refs.text_gb: 百夫长听见耶稣的事，就打发犹太人的几个长老到耶稣那里，求耶稣来全然拯救他的奴仆。
refs.text_big5: 百夫長聽見耶穌的事，就打發猶太人的幾個長老到耶穌那裏，求耶穌來全然拯救他的奴僕。
refs.text_en: And when he heard about Jesus, he sent to Him some elders of the Jews, requesting that He would come and completely heal his slave.

refs.text_gb: 他们到了耶稣那里，就切切地求祂说，你给他行这事，是他所配的；
refs.text_big5: 他們到了耶穌那裏，就切切的求祂說，你給他行這事，是他所配的；
refs.text_en: And when they came to Jesus, they entreated Him earnestly, saying, He is worthy of Your granting this to him,

refs.text_gb: 因为他爱我们的人民，给我们建造会堂。
refs.text_big5: 因為他愛我們的人民，給我們建造會堂。
refs.text_en: For he loves our nation, and he himself built the synagogue for us.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就和他们同去。离那家不远，百夫长差了几个朋友去对耶稣说，主啊，不用烦扰了，因为我不配你到舍下来。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就和他們同去。離那家不遠，百夫長差了幾個朋友去對耶穌說，主阿，不用煩擾了，因為我不配你到舍下來。
refs.text_en: And Jesus went with them. But already, when He was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends, saying to Him, Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not fit for You to enter under my roof;

refs.text_gb: 我也自以为不配去见你，只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必得医治。
refs.text_big5: 我也自以為不配去見你，只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必得醫治。
refs.text_en: Therefore, I did not count even myself worthy to come to You. But speak a word, and let my servant be healed.

refs.text_gb: 因为我也是一个被派在权柄之下的人，有兵在我以下；我对这个说，去，他就去；对那个说，来，他就来；对我的奴仆说，作这事，他就作。

footnotes.zh: 在14～15节，彼得的岳母代表这世代末了的犹太人，他们要因接受君尊的救主而得救(罗十一25～26)。那时，在大灾难期间，犹太人在神的眼中是“发烧”的(14)，热中于神以外的事物。君尊的救主在外邦人得救的数目添满以后，要回到犹太遗民那里，使他们得救(罗十一25～26，亚十二10)。彼得的岳母是在彼得家里得医治的。在这世代的末了，所有的犹太遗民都要在以色列家中得救。他们也要借着君尊救主直接的摸而得救(15)，如同那患麻风的犹太人(3)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在14～15節，彼得的岳母代表這世代末了的猶太人，他們要因接受君尊的救主而得救。（羅十一25～26。）那時，在大災難期間，猶太人在神的眼中是“發燒”的，（14，）熱中於神以外的事物。君尊的救主在外邦人得救的數目添滿以後，要回到猶太遺民那裏，使他們得救。（羅十一25～26，亞十二10。）彼得的岳母是在彼得家裏得醫治的。在這世代的末了，所有的猶太遺民都要在以色列家中得救。他們也要藉著君尊救主直接的摸而得救，（15，）如同那患痲瘋的猶太人。（3。）
footnotes.en: 8:14 1 his Peter's mother-in-law in vv. 14-15 represents the Jews living at the end of this age, who will be saved by receiving the kingly Savior (Rom. 11:25-26). At that time, during the great tribulation, the Jews in the eyes of God will be "in a fever" (v. 14), "hot" in things other than God. After the fullness of the salvation of the Gentiles, the kingly Savior will come back to this remnant of the Jews that they may be saved (Rom. 11:25-26; Zech. 12:10). Peter's mother-in-law was healed in Peter's house. At the end of this age all the remnant of the Jews will be saved in the house of Israel. Furthermore, they will be saved by the kingly Savior's direct touch (v. 15), as was the Jewish leper (v. 3).

refs.text_gb: 他们一出会堂，就同着雅各、约翰，进了西门和安得烈的家。
refs.text_big5: 他們一出會堂，就同著雅各、約翰，進了西門和安得烈的家。
refs.text_en: And immediately, going out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew with James and John.

refs.text_gb: 西门的岳母正发烧躺着，有人立刻向耶稣说到她。
refs.text_big5: 西門的岳母正發燒躺著，有人立刻向耶穌說到她。
refs.text_en: And Simon's mother-in-law was lying down with a fever, and immediately they told Him about her.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣上前拉着她的手，扶她起来，烧就退了，她就服事他们。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌上前拉著她的手，扶她起來，燒就退了，她就服事他們。
refs.text_en: And He came to her and raised her up, holding her hand, and the fever left her, and she served them.

refs.text_big5: 到了黃昏，日落的時候，有人帶著一切患病的和被鬼附的，到耶穌跟前；
refs.text_en: And when evening fell and the sun had set, they brought to Him all those who were ill and those who were demon-possessed.

refs.text_big5: 合城的人都聚集在門前。
refs.text_en: And the whole city was gathered together at the door.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣治好了许多患各样疾病的人，又赶出许多鬼，且不许鬼说话，因为鬼认识祂。

refs.text_en: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases, and He cast out many demons and did not allow the demons to speak, because they knew Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣起身离开会堂，进了西门的家，西门的岳母正患热病甚重，有人为她求耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌起身離開會堂，進了西門的家，西門的岳母正患熱病甚重，有人為她求耶穌。
refs.text_en: And He rose up and went from the synagogue and entered into the house of Simon. And Simon's mother-in-law was suffering with a high fever, and they asked Him concerning her.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣站在她旁边，斥责那热病，热就退了，她立刻起来服事他们。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌站在她旁邊，斥責那熱病，熱就退了，她立刻起來服事他們。
refs.text_en: And standing over her, He rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she instantly rose up and served them.

refs.text_gb: 日落的时候，凡有病人的，不论患什么病，都带到耶稣跟前；耶稣按手在他们各人身上，治好了他们。

refs.text_en: And when the sun was setting, all those who had any that were sick with various diseases brought them to Him; and He laid His hands on each one of them and healed them.

refs.text_gb: 又有鬼从好些人身上出来，喊着说，你是神的儿子。耶稣斥责它们，不许它们说话，因为它们知道祂是基督。

refs.text_en: And demons also came out from many, crying out and saying, You are the Son of God! And He rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that He was the Christ.

refs.text_gb: 难道我们没有权利带着为妻子的姊妹往来，仿佛其余的使徒，和主的兄弟，并矶法一样么？
refs.text_big5: 難道我們沒有權利帶著為妻子的姊妹往來，彷彿其餘的使徒，和主的兄弟，並磯法一樣麼？
refs.text_en: Do we not have a right to take along a sister as a wife, even as the rest of the apostles and the brothers of the Lord and Cephas?

verses.text_big5: 耶穌摸[Cra]她的手，燒就退了；她便起來服事耶穌。
verses.text_en: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her. And she arose and served Him.

verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌摸她的手，燒就退了；她便起來服事耶穌。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣伸手摸他，说，我肯，你洁净了吧。他的麻风立刻洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌伸手摸他，說，我肯，你潔淨了罷。他的痲瘋立刻潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And stretching out His hand, He touched him, saying, I am willing; be cleansed! And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

verses.text_gb: 到了黄昏，有人带着许[Fn1]多鬼附的到祂跟前，祂用一句话[Cra]赶出那些灵，并且治好了一切患病的人。
verses.text_big5: 到了黃昏，有人帶著許[Fn1]多鬼附的到祂跟前，祂用一句話[Cra]趕出那些靈，並且治好了一切患病的人。
verses.text_en: And when evening fell, they brought to Him many who were demon-possessed, and He cast out the spirits with a word, and all those who were ill He healed,
verses.text_gb_plain: 到了黄昏，有人带着许多鬼附的到祂跟前，祂用一句话赶出那些灵，并且治好了一切患病的人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 到了黃昏，有人帶著許多鬼附的到祂跟前，祂用一句話趕出那些靈，並且治好了一切患病的人。

footnotes.zh: “许多鬼附的”和“一切患病的，”代表千年国里地上的万民。千年国是旧天旧地最后的一个时代，因此被视为旧天旧地的“黄昏。”在千年国里，赶鬼、医病的能力要达到极点。因此，一切鬼附的和患病的，都要得着医治。这种广泛的能力就是来世的能力(来六5)。今世的赶鬼和医病，不过是预尝来世广泛的能力。2～17节所记载的神迹，具有时代的意义，是来世国度的小影。 2～16节所记载四件事例的次序，不同于可一29～二1，以及路四38～41，五12～14，七1～10中的次序。马可的记载，表明耶稣是神的奴仆，其次序是按照历史。马太的记载，证明基督是诸天之国的王，其次序是按照道理，就是将某些事例摆在一起，以陈明一个道理。路加的记载，启示耶稣是正确的人，来作人类的救主，其次序是按照道德。约翰的记载，见证基督是神的儿子，就是神自己，其次序多少也是按照历史。
footnotes.en: 8:16 1 many; all Many who were demon possessed and all those who were ill represent all the people on earth in the millennium. The millennium is the last dispensation of the old heaven and old earth; thus, it is considered the "evening" of the old heaven and old earth. In the millennium the power to cast out demons and heal illnesses will be manifested to the uttermost. Hence, all the demon possessed and all the sick will be healed. Such extensive power is the power of the coming age (Heb. 6:5). The casting out of demons and the healing of the sick in this age are only a foretaste of the extensive power of the coming age. The signs recorded in vv. 2-17 bear a dispensational significance and show the coming kingdom in miniature. The order of the four incidents recorded in vv. 2-16 differs from that in Mark 1:29-45; 2:1 and Luke 4:38-41; 5:12-14; 7:1-10. In Mark's record, which shows that Jesus is the Servant of God, the order is according to history. In Matthew's record, which proves that Christ is the King of the kingdom of the heavens, the order is according to doctrine; i.e., Matthew puts certain incidents together to present a doctrine. In Luke's record, which reveals that Jesus is the proper man to be man's Savior, the order is according to morality. In John's record, which testifies that Christ is the Son of God and even God Himself, the order is somewhat according to history.

refs.text_gb: 百夫长回答说，主啊，我不配你到舍下来，只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必得医治。
refs.text_big5: 百夫長回答說，主阿，我不配你到舍下來，只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必得醫治。
refs.text_en: But the centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not fit for You to enter under my roof; but only speak a word, and my servant will be healed.

verses.text_gb: 这是要应[Cra]验那借着申言者以赛亚所说的，说，“祂[Fn1][Crb]亲自取去了我们的软弱，担[Crc]当了我们的疾病。”
verses.text_big5: 這是要應[Cra]驗那藉著申言者以賽亞所說的，說，“祂[Fn1][Crb]親自取去了我們的軟弱，擔[Crc]當了我們的疾病。”
verses.text_en: So that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, saying, "He Himself took away our infirmities and bore our diseases."
verses.text_gb_plain: 这是要应验那借着申言者以赛亚所说的，说，“祂亲自取去了我们的软弱，担当了我们的疾病。”
verses.text_big5_plain: 這是要應驗那藉著申言者以賽亞所說的，說，“祂親自取去了我們的軟弱，擔當了我們的疾病。”

footnotes.zh: 一切成就在堕落之人身上的医治，都是由于主的救赎。祂在十字架上取去了我们的软弱，担当了我们的疾病，就在那里为我们成就了完全的医治。不过，我们应用这神圣医治的能力，在今世只能是预尝，到来世才得全享。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一切成就在墮落之人身上的醫治，都是由於主的救贖。祂在十字架上取去了我們的軟弱，擔當了我們的疾病，就在那裏為我們成就了完全的醫治。不過，我們應用這神聖醫治的能力，在今世只能是豫嘗，到來世纔得全享。
footnotes.en: 8:17 1 He All healings accomplished on fallen people are a result of the Lord's redemption. On the cross He took away our infirmities, bore our diseases, and accomplished full healing for us. However, in this age the application of this divine healing power can be only a foretaste to us; in the coming age we will experience the full taste.

refs.text_gb: 这一切成就了，为要应验主借着申言者所说的，说，
refs.text_big5: 這一切成就了，為要應驗主藉著申言者所說的，說，
refs.text_en: Now all this has happened so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet might be fulfilled, saying,

refs.text_gb: 祂诚然担当了我们的忧患，背负了我们的痛苦；我们却以为祂受责罚，被神击打苦待了。
refs.text_big5: 祂誠然擔當了我們的憂患，背負了我們的痛苦；我們卻以為祂受責罰，被神擊打苦待了。
refs.text_en: Surely He has borne our sicknesses, / And carried our sorrows; / Yet we ourselves esteemed Him stricken, / Smitten of God and afflicted.

refs.text_gb: 祂在木头上，在祂的身体里，亲自担当了我们的罪，使我们既然向罪死了，就得以向义活着；因祂受的鞭伤，你们便得了医治。
refs.text_big5: 祂在木頭上，在祂的身體裏，親自擔當了我們的罪，使我們既然向罪死了，就得以向義活著；因祂受的鞭傷，你們便得了醫治。
refs.text_en: Who Himself bore up our sins in His body on the tree, in order that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose bruise you were healed.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣看见群众围着祂，就吩咐离[Fn1]开到对岸去。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌看見群眾圍著祂，就吩咐離[Fn1]開到對岸去。
verses.text_en: Now when Jesus saw a crowd around Him, He gave orders to depart to the other side.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣看见群众围着祂，就吩咐离开到对岸去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌看見群眾圍著祂，就吩咐離開到對岸去。

footnotes.zh: 照四福音的记载，主在尽职时总是离开群众，不愿好奇的人同祂在一起。祂不在意群众，只顾念诚心寻求祂的人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 照四福音的記載，主在盡職時總是離開群眾，不願好奇的人同祂在一起。祂不在意群眾，只顧念誠心尋求祂的人。
footnotes.en: 8:18 1 depart In His ministry as recorded in the four Gospels, the Lord always withdrew from the crowds; He did not want the curious ones to be with Him. He did not care for crowds but cared only for those who sought Him sincerely.

verses.text_gb: 有[Cra]一个经学家进前来，对祂说，夫子，你无论往[Fn1]哪里去，我都要跟[Fn2]从你。
verses.text_big5: 有[Cra]一個經學家進前來，對祂說，夫子，你無論往[Fn1]那裏去，我都要跟[Fn2]從你。
verses.text_en: And a scribe came near and said to Him, Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有一个经学家进前来，对祂说，夫子，你无论往哪里去，我都要跟从你。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有一個經學家進前來，對祂說，夫子，你無論往那裏去，我都要跟從你。

footnotes.zh: 直译，离开那里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，離開那裏。
footnotes.en: 8:19 1 follow In saying this he did not consider the cost. Hence, the King answered in v. 20 in a way that caused him to consider the cost.

footnotes.zh: 他说这话，并没有考虑到代价。因此，王在20节的答复里，引他考虑到代价的问题。
footnotes.zh_big5: 他說這話，並沒有考慮到代價。因此，王在20節的答覆裏，引他考慮到代價的問題。

refs.text_gb: 他们行路的时候，有一个人对耶稣说，你无论往哪里去，我都要跟从你。
refs.text_big5: 他們行路的時候，有一個人對耶穌說，你無論往那裏去，我都要跟從你。
refs.text_en: And as they went along the road, someone said to Him, I will follow You wherever You go.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有枕头的地方。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of heaven have roosts, but the Son of Man does not have a place where He may lay His head.

refs.text_gb: 又对另一个人说，跟从我。那人说，主啊，准我先去埋葬我的父亲。

refs.text_en: And He said to another, Follow Me. But he said, Lord, permit me to go first and bury my father.

refs.text_en: But He said to him, Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and announce the kingdom of God everywhere.

verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌對他說，狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。

footnotes.zh: 十六13～17以前，新王在尽祂君王的职事时，一直是站在人子的立场上。
footnotes.zh_big5: 十六13～17以前，新王在盡祂君王的職事時，一直是站在人子的立場上。
footnotes.en: 8:20 1 Son In His kingly ministry the new King continually took the standing of the Son of Man, until Matt. 16:13-17.

footnotes.zh: 狐狸和飞鸟都有安歇之处，但国度的王，连安歇的地方也没有。这证明祂所建立的国，不是物质的，没有属地的性质；乃是属灵的，具有属天的性质。
footnotes.zh_big5: 狐狸和飛鳥都有安歇之處，但國度的王，連安歇的地方也沒有。這證明祂所建立的國，不是物質的，沒有屬地的性質；乃是屬靈的，具有屬天的性質。
footnotes.en: 8:20 2 nowhere Even the foxes and the birds have a resting place, but the King of the kingdom did not have a resting place. This proves that the kingdom He was establishing was not material, not of an earthly nature, but was spiritual, of a heavenly nature.
