refs.text_big5: 因為人子是安息日的主。
refs.text_en: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

refs.text_gb: 并且无论谁说话抵挡人子，他都能得赦免；但无论谁说话抵挡圣灵，无论在今世，或是在来世，他都不能得赦免。
refs.text_big5: 並且無論誰說話抵擋人子，他都能得赦免；但無論誰說話抵擋聖靈，無論在今世，或是在來世，他都不能得赦免。
refs.text_en: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age nor in the one to come.

refs.text_gb: 因为约拿怎样三日三夜在大鱼腹中，人子也必照样三日三夜在地心里。
refs.text_big5: 因為約拿怎樣三日三夜在大魚腹中，人子也必照樣三日三夜在地心裏。
refs.text_en: For just as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish three days and three nights, so will the Son of Man be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.

refs.text_gb: 祂就回答说，那撒好种的就是人子，
refs.text_big5: 祂就回答說，那撒好種的就是人子，
refs.text_en: And He answered and said, He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man;

refs.text_gb: 人子要差遣祂的使者，从祂的国里薅集一切绊跌人的事，和行不法的人，
refs.text_big5: 人子要差遣祂的使者，從祂的國裏薅集一切絆跌人的事，和行不法的人，
refs.text_en: The Son of Man will send His angels, and they will collect out of His kingdom all the stumbling blocks and those who practice lawlessness,

refs.text_gb: 耶稣到了该撒利亚腓立比的境内，就问祂的门徒说，人说人子是谁？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌到了該撒利亞腓立比的境內，就問祂的門徒說，人說人子是誰？
refs.text_en: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, He asked His disciples, saying, Who do men say that the Son of Man is?

refs.text_gb: 因为人子要在祂父的荣耀里，同着众天使来临，那时祂要照各人的行为报应各人。
refs.text_big5: 因為人子要在祂父的榮耀裏，同著眾天使來臨，那時祂要照各人的行為報應各人。
refs.text_en: For the Son of Man is to come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He will repay each man according to his doings.

refs.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人还没有尝到死味，必看见人子在祂的国里来临。
refs.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人還沒有嘗到死味，必看見人子在祂的國裏來臨。
refs.text_en: Truly I say to you, There are some of those standing here who shall by no means taste death until they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，你说的对了。然而我还要告诉你们，从此以后你们要看见人子，坐在那大能者的右边，驾着天上的云而来。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，你說的對了。然而我還要告訴你們，從此以後你們要看見人子，坐在那大能者的右邊，駕著天上的雲而來。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to him, You have said rightly. Nevertheless I say to you, From now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.

verses.text_gb: 门徒中另有一个对祂说，主啊，准[Cra]我先去[Fn1]埋葬我的父亲。
verses.text_big5: 門徒中另有一個對祂說，主阿，准[Cra]我先去[Fn1]埋葬我的父親。
verses.text_en: And another of the disciples said to Him, Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father.
verses.text_gb_plain: 门徒中另有一个对祂说，主啊，准我先去埋葬我的父亲。
verses.text_big5_plain: 門徒中另有一個對祂說，主阿，准我先去埋葬我的父親。

footnotes.zh: 这门徒不是经学家。他这样说，是过度考虑跟从属天国度之王所要出的代价。因此，王答复时鼓励他来跟从，放下代价的考虑，把埋葬他父亲的事留给别人去作。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這門徒不是經學家。他這樣說，是過度考慮跟從屬天國度之王所要出的代價。因此，王答覆時鼓勵他來跟從，放下代價的考慮，把埋葬他父親的事留給別人去作。
footnotes.en: 8:21 1 go In so saying, this disciple, who was not a scribe, overly considered the cost of following the King of the heavenly kingdom. Hence, the King answered him by encouraging him to follow Him, to drop his consideration of the cost, and to leave the burial of his father to others.

refs.text_gb: 以利沙就撇下牛，跑去跟随以利亚，说，求你让我先与父母亲嘴，然后我便跟随你。以利亚对他说，你回去吧，我向你作了什么呢？
refs.text_big5: 以利沙就撇下牛，跑去跟隨以利亞，說，求你讓我先與父母親嘴，然後我便跟隨你。以利亞對他說，你回去罷，我向你作了甚麼呢？
refs.text_en: And he left the oxen and ran after Elijah and said, Let me kiss my father and my mother, and I will follow you. And he said to him, Go back again; for what have I done to you?

verses.text_gb: 耶稣说，让死[Fn1][Cra]人埋葬他们的死[Crb]人，你跟[Crc]从我吧。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌說，讓死[Fn1][Cra]人埋葬他們的死[Crb]人，你跟[Crc]從我罷。
verses.text_en: But Jesus said to him, Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣说，让死人埋葬他们的死人，你跟从我吧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌說，讓死人埋葬他們的死人，你跟從我罷。

footnotes.zh: 头一个死人是指在灵里死了的人，如弗二1、5所说的；第二个死人是指那门徒在肉身里死了的父亲。
footnotes.en: 8:22 1 dead The first dead refers to those who are dead spiritually, as mentioned in Eph. 2:1, 5 the second dead refers to the disciple's father, who was dead physically.

refs.text_gb: 而你们原是死在过犯并罪之中，
refs.text_big5: 而你們原是死在過犯並罪之中，
refs.text_en: And you, though dead in your offenses and sins,

refs.text_gb: 竟然在我们因过犯死了的时候，便叫我们一同与基督活过来，（你们得救是靠着恩典，）
refs.text_big5: 竟然在我們因過犯死了的時候，便叫我們一同與基督活過來，（你們得救是靠著恩典，）
refs.text_en: Even when we were dead in offenses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved)

refs.text_gb: 你们从前在过犯，和未受割礼的肉体中死了，神赦免了你们一切的过犯，叫你们一同与基督活过来；
refs.text_big5: 你們從前在過犯，和未受割禮的肉體中死了，神赦免了你們一切的過犯，叫你們一同與基督活過來；
refs.text_en: And you, though dead in your offenses and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, He made alive together with Him, having forgiven us all our offenses;

refs.text_gb: 我实实在在地告诉你们，时候将到，如今就是了，死人要听见神儿子的声音，听见的人就要活了。
refs.text_big5: 我實實在在的告訴你們，時候將到，如今就是了，死人要聽見神兒子的聲音，聽見的人就要活了。
refs.text_en: Truly, truly, I say to you, An hour is coming, and it is now, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.

refs.text_gb: 你们不要把这事看作希奇，因为时候将到，凡在坟墓里的，都要听见祂的声音，就出来；
refs.text_big5: 你們不要把這事看作希奇，因為時候將到，凡在墳墓裏的，都要聽見祂的聲音，就出來；
refs.text_en: Do not marvel at this, for an hour is coming in which all in the tombs will hear His voice

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，来跟从我，我要使你们作得人的渔夫。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，來跟從我，我要使你們作得人的漁夫。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Come after Me, and I will make you fishers of men.

refs.text_gb: 他们就立刻撇下网，跟从了祂。
refs.text_big5: 他們就立刻撇下網，跟從了祂。
refs.text_en: And immediately leaving the nets, they followed Him.

refs.text_gb: 他们立刻撇下船和他们的父亲，跟从了祂。
refs.text_big5: 他們立刻撇下船和他們的父親，跟從了祂。
refs.text_en: And immediately leaving the boat and their father, they followed Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马太，坐在税关上，就对他说，跟从我。他就起来，跟从了耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌從那裏往前走，看見一個人名叫馬太，坐在稅關上，就對他說，跟從我。他就起來，跟從了耶穌。
refs.text_en: And as Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man sitting at the tax office, called Matthew, and He said to him, Follow Me. And he rose and followed Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说这话，是指明彼得要怎样死荣耀神。说了这话，就对他说，你跟从我吧。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說這話，是指明彼得要怎樣死榮耀神。說了這話，就對他說，你跟從我罷。
refs.text_en: Now this He said, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. And when He had said this, He said to him, Follow Me.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，我若要留他直到我来的时候，与你何干？你跟从我吧。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，我若要留他直到我來的時候，與你何干？你跟從我罷。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to him, If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow Me.

verses.text_gb: 耶[Cra]稣上了船，门徒跟着祂。
verses.text_big5: 耶[Cra]穌上了船，門徒跟著祂。
verses.text_en: And when He stepped into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣上了船，门徒跟着祂。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌上了船，門徒跟著祂。

refs.text_gb: 门徒离开群众，耶稣仍在船上，他们就把祂带去，也有别的船和祂同行。
refs.text_big5: 門徒離開群眾，耶穌仍在船上，他們就把祂帶去，也有別的船和祂同行。
refs.text_en: And leaving the crowd, they took Him along, just as He was, in the boat; and other boats were with Him.

refs.text_gb: 忽然起了大风暴，波浪打入船内，甚至船要满了水。
refs.text_big5: 忽然起了大風暴，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。
refs.text_en: And there arose a great windstorm, and the waves beat into the boat, so that the boat was already beginning to fill up.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣竟在船尾靠着枕头睡着。门徒叫醒了祂，对祂说，夫子，我们丧命，你不顾么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌竟在船尾靠著枕頭睡著。門徒叫醒了祂，對祂說，夫子，我們喪命，你不顧麼？
refs.text_en: And He was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. And they woke Him and said to Him, Teacher, does it not matter to You that we are perishing?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣醒来，斥责风，又向海说，安静吧！不要发声！风就止住，大大地平静了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌醒來，斥責風，又向海說，安靜罷！不要發聲！風就止住，大大的平靜了。
refs.text_en: And having awoken, He rebuked the wind and said to the sea, Be silent! Be still! And the wind ceased and there was a great calm.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，为什么这样胆怯？你们怎么没有信心？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，為甚麼這樣膽怯？你們怎麼沒有信心？
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Why are you cowardly in this way? How is it that you do not have faith?

refs.text_gb: 他们就大大地惧怕，彼此说，这人到底是谁，连风和海也听从了祂？
refs.text_big5: 他們就大大的懼怕，彼此說，這人到底是誰，連風和海也聽從了祂？
refs.text_en: And they became greatly frightened and said to one another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?

refs.text_gb: 有一天，耶稣和门徒上了船，祂对他们说，我们渡到湖的对岸去吧。他们就开了船。
refs.text_big5: 有一天，耶穌和門徒上了船，祂對他們說，我們渡到湖的對岸去罷。他們就開了船。
refs.text_en: And on one of the days He and His disciples got into a boat. And He said to them, Let us go over to the other side of the lake. And they launched out.

refs.text_gb: 正航行的时候，耶稣睡着了。湖上起了风暴，船就要满了水，甚是危险。
refs.text_big5: 正航行的時候，耶穌睡著了。湖上起了風暴，船就要滿了水，甚是危險。
refs.text_en: And while they were sailing, He fell asleep. And a windstorm came down upon the lake, and they began to fill with water and were in danger.

refs.text_gb: 门徒进前来，叫醒了祂，说，夫子，夫子，我们丧命啦！耶稣醒来，斥责风和水上的大浪，风浪就止住，平静了。
refs.text_big5: 門徒進前來，叫醒了祂，說，夫子，夫子，我們喪命啦！耶穌醒來，斥責風和水上的大浪，風浪就止住，平靜了。
refs.text_en: And they came to Him and woke Him, saying, Master, Master, we are perishing! And being awakened, He rebuked the wind and the surging of the water, and they ceased, and there was a calm.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，你们的信心在哪里？他们既惧怕，又希奇，彼此说，这人到底是谁？祂竟吩咐风和水，连风和水也听从了祂。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，你們的信心在那裏？他們既懼怕，又希奇，彼此說，這人到底是誰？祂竟吩咐風和水，連風和水也聽從了祂。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Where is your faith? And they became frightened and marveled, saying to one another, Who then is this, that He orders even the winds and the water, and they obey Him?

verses.text_gb: 看哪，海里起了大风[Fn1][Cra]暴，以致船被波浪掩盖，耶稣却睡着。
verses.text_big5: 看哪，海裏起了大風[Fn1][Cra]暴，以致船被波浪掩蓋，耶穌卻睡著。
verses.text_en: And behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, so that the boat was covered by the waves; but He was sleeping.
verses.text_gb_plain: 看哪，海里起了大风暴，以致船被波浪掩盖，耶稣却睡着。
verses.text_big5_plain: 看哪，海裏起了大風暴，以致船被波浪掩蓋，耶穌卻睡著。

footnotes.zh: 直译，震动，或，摇摆。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，震動，或，搖擺。
footnotes.en: 8:24 1 tempest Lit., quaking, or, shaking.

refs.text_gb: 因为起了大风，海就翻腾起来。
refs.text_big5: 因為起了大風，海就翻騰起來。
refs.text_en: And because a strong wind was blowing, the sea was churning.

verses.text_gb: 门徒进前来叫醒了祂，说，主啊，救[Cra]我们，我们丧命啦！
verses.text_big5: 門徒進前來叫醒了祂，說，主阿，救[Cra]我們，我們喪命啦！
verses.text_en: And they came near and roused Him, saying, Lord, save us; we are perishing!
verses.text_gb_plain: 门徒进前来叫醒了祂，说，主啊，救我们，我们丧命啦！
verses.text_big5_plain: 門徒進前來叫醒了祂，說，主阿，救我們，我們喪命啦！

refs.text_gb: 只因见风甚大，就害怕，将要沉下去，便喊着说，主啊，救我！
refs.text_big5: 只因見風甚大，就害怕，將要沉下去，便喊著說，主阿，救我！
refs.text_en: But seeing the strong wind, he became frightened; and as he began to sink, he cried out, saying, Lord, save me!

verses.text_gb: 祂对他们说，小[Cra]信[Fn1]的人哪，你们为什么胆[Crb]怯？于是起来，斥[Fn2][Crc]责风和海，风和海就大[Fn3]大地平[Crd]静了。
verses.text_big5: 祂對他們說，小[Cra]信[Fn1]的人哪，你們為甚麼膽[Crb]怯？於是起來，斥[Fn2][Crc]責風和海，風和海就大[Fn3]大的平[Crd]靜了。
verses.text_en: And He said to them, Why are you cowardly, you of little faith? Then He arose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂对他们说，小信的人哪，你们为什么胆怯？于是起来，斥责风和海，风和海就大大地平静了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂對他們說，小信的人哪，你們為甚麼膽怯？於是起來，斥責風和海，風和海就大大的平靜了。

footnotes.zh: “信”来自主的话，并在于主的话(罗十17)。主在18节吩咐他们离开到对岸去。他们若信这话，就不需要像25节那样祷告了。他们对主的话领会得不够，因此他们的信心小。
footnotes.zh_big5: “信”來自主的話，並在於主的話。（羅十17。）主在18節吩咐他們離開到對岸去。他們若信這話，就不需要像25節那樣禱告了。他們對主的話領會得不彀，因此他們的信心小。
footnotes.en: 8:26 1 faith Faith comes from and depends on the word of the Lord (Rom. 10:17). In v. 18 the Lord gave them a word, telling them to depart to the other side. If they had believed that word, they would not have needed to pray as they did in v. 25. They did not have a full realization concerning the Lord's word; thus, their faith was little.

footnotes.zh: 斥责不是对无生命之物，乃是对有位格之物而发的。王斥责风和海，因为风里有撒但的堕落天使(弗六12)，海里有鬼(32)。空中堕落的天使和水中的鬼，合力阻止王渡到对岸，因为他们晓得祂要去赶出那边的鬼(28～32)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 斥責不是對無生命之物，乃是對有位格之物而發的。王斥責風和海，因為風裏有撒但的墮落天使，（弗六12，）海裏有鬼。（32。）空中墮落的天使和水中的鬼，合力阻止王渡到對岸，因為他們曉得祂要去趕出那邊的鬼。（28～32。）
footnotes.en: 8:26 2 rebuked A rebuke is not given to lifeless things but to things with personality. The King rebuked the winds and the sea because in the winds were the fallen angels of Satan (Eph. 6:12) and in the sea were the demons (v. 32). The fallen angels in the air and the demons in the water collaborated to frustrate the King from going to the other side of the sea because they knew He would cast out the demons there (vv. 28-32).

footnotes.zh: “大”与本节上半的“小”相对。
footnotes.zh_big5: “大”與本節上半的“小”相對。
footnotes.en: 8:26 3 great Great is in contrast to little in the first part of this verse.

refs.text_gb: 小信的人哪，野地里的草，今天存在，明天就丢在炉里，神尚且这样给它穿戴，何况你们？
refs.text_big5: 小信的人哪，野地裏的草，今天存在，明天就丟在爐裏，神尚且這樣給它穿戴，何況你們？
refs.text_en: And if God so arrays the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is cast into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, you of little faith?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣赶紧伸手拉住他，对他说，小信的人哪，为什么疑惑？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，對他說，小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑？
refs.text_en: And immediately Jesus stretched out His hand and took hold of him and said to him, You of little faith, why did you doubt?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道了，就说，小信的人哪，为什么因为没有饼就彼此议论？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道了，就說，小信的人哪，為甚麼因為沒有餅就彼此議論？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, knowing it, said, Why are you reasoning among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have no bread?

refs.text_gb: 我留下平安给你们，我将我的平安赐给你们；我所赐给你们的，不像世人所赐的。你们心里不要受搅扰，也不要胆怯。
refs.text_big5: 我留下平安給你們，我將我的平安賜給你們；我所賜給你們的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裏不要受攪擾，也不要膽怯。
refs.text_en: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Do not let your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

refs.text_gb: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃；你的雷声一发，水便奔流，
refs.text_big5: 你的斥責一發，水便奔逃；你的雷聲一發，水便奔流，
refs.text_en: At Your rebuke they fled; / At the voice of Your thunder they rushed away -

refs.text_gb: 祂使狂风止息，海浪就平静。
refs.text_big5: 祂使狂風止息，海浪就平靜。
refs.text_en: He made the storm be still, / And the waves of the sea were calm;

verses.text_gb: 众人都希奇说，这是什么样的人，连风和海也听[Fn1]从了祂？
verses.text_big5: 眾人都希奇說，這是甚麼樣的人，連風和海也聽[Fn1]從了祂？
verses.text_en: And the men marveled, saying, What kind of Man is this that even the winds and the sea obey Him?
verses.text_gb_plain: 众人都希奇说，这是什么样的人，连风和海也听从了祂？
verses.text_big5_plain: 眾人都希奇說，這是甚麼樣的人，連風和海也聽從了祂？

footnotes.zh: 实际上，听从王权柄的不是风和海，乃是风上面的堕落天使，和海底下的鬼。
footnotes.zh_big5: 實際上，聽從王權柄的不是風和海，乃是風上面的墮落天使，和海底下的鬼。
footnotes.en: 8:27 1 obey Actually, it was not the winds and the sea that obeyed the King's authority but the fallen angels above the winds and the demons under the sea.

verses.text_gb: 耶[Cra]稣来到对岸，到了加大拉人的地方，有两个鬼附的人从坟茔里出来迎着祂，极其凶猛，以致没有人能从那条路上经过。
verses.text_big5: 耶[Cra]穌來到對岸，到了加大拉人的地方，有兩個鬼附的人從墳塋裏出來迎著祂，極其兇猛，以致沒有人能從那條路上經過。
verses.text_en: And when He came to the other side, into the region of the Gadarenes, two possessed by demons met Him, as they were coming out of the tombs, so exceedingly fierce that no one was able to pass by on that road.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣来到对岸，到了加大拉人的地方，有两个鬼附的人从坟茔里出来迎着祂，极其凶猛，以致没有人能从那条路上经过。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌來到對岸，到了加大拉人的地方，有兩個鬼附的人從墳塋裏出來迎著祂，極其兇猛，以致沒有人能從那條路上經過。

refs.text_gb: 他们来到海的对岸，格拉森人的地方。
refs.text_big5: 他們來到海的對岸，格拉森人的地方。
refs.text_en: And they came to the other side of the sea, into the region of the Gerasenes.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣一下船，立即有一个污灵附着的人，从坟茔里出来迎着祂。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌一下船，立即有一個污靈附著的人，從墳塋裏出來迎著祂。
refs.text_en: And when He came out of the boat, immediately, from out of the tombs, a man with an unclean spirit met Him,

refs.text_gb: 那人经常以坟茔为住处；再没有人能捆住他，就是用铁链也不能；
refs.text_big5: 那人經常以墳塋為住處；再沒有人能捆住他，就是用鐵鍊也不能；
refs.text_en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs. And no one could bind him any longer, not even with a chain,

refs.text_gb: 因为人屡次用脚镣和铁链捆锁他，铁链竟被他挣断，脚镣也被他弄碎，总没有人能制伏他。
refs.text_big5: 因為人屢次用腳鐐和鐵鍊捆鎖他，鐵鍊竟被他掙斷，腳鐐也被他弄碎，總沒有人能制伏他。
refs.text_en: Because he had often been bound with shackles and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the shackles smashed, and no one was strong enough to subdue him.

refs.text_gb: 他昼夜常在坟茔和山中喊叫，又用石头砍自己。
refs.text_big5: 他晝夜常在墳塋和山中喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。
refs.text_en: And continually night and day, among the tombs and in the mountains, he cried out and gashed himself with stones.

refs.text_gb: 他远远地看见耶稣，就跑过去拜祂，
refs.text_big5: 他遠遠的看見耶穌，就跑過去拜祂，
refs.text_en: And when he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and worshipped Him,

refs.text_gb: 大声喊叫说，至高神的儿子耶稣，我与你何干？我指着神切求你，不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_big5: 大聲喊叫說，至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你何干？我指著神切求你，不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_en: And crying out with a loud voice, he said, What do I have to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I adjure You by God, do not torment me!

refs.text_gb: 因耶稣曾对他说，污灵，从这人身上出来。
refs.text_big5: 因耶穌曾對他說，污靈，從這人身上出來。
refs.text_en: For He had said to him, Come out of the man, unclean spirit.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣问他说，你名叫什么？他说，我名叫群，因为我们众多。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌問他說，你名叫甚麼？他說，我名叫群，因為我們眾多。
refs.text_en: And He questioned him, What is your name? And he said to Him, Legion is my name, because we are many.

refs.text_gb: 他就再三地央求耶稣，不要打发它们离开那地方。
refs.text_big5: 他就再三的央求耶穌，不要打發牠們離開那地方。
refs.text_en: And he entreated Him much not to send them out of the region.

refs.text_gb: 在那里山坡上，有一大群猪正在吃食。
refs.text_big5: 在那裏山坡上，有一大群豬正在喫食。
refs.text_en: Now there on the mountainside was a great herd of hogs feeding.

refs.text_gb: 它们就央求耶稣说，打发我们到猪群去，我们好进入它们里面。
refs.text_big5: 牠們就央求耶穌說，打發我們到豬群去，我們好進入牠們裏面。
refs.text_en: And they entreated Him, saying, Send us to the hogs, so that we may enter into them.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就准了它们；污灵便出来，进入猪里去；于是那群猪闯下山崖，投入海里，约有二千，都淹死在海中。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就准了牠們；污靈便出來，進入豬裏去；於是那群豬闖下山崖，投入海裏，約有二千，都淹死在海中。
refs.text_en: And He gave them permission. And the unclean spirits came out and entered into the hogs, and the herd, about two thousand, rushed down the steep slope into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

refs.text_gb: 放猪的就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。众人就来，要看所发生的是什么事。
refs.text_big5: 放豬的就逃跑了，去告訴城裏和鄉下的人。眾人就來，要看所發生的是甚麼事。
refs.text_en: And those who were feeding them fled and reported it in the city and in the countryside. And they came to see what had happened.

refs.text_gb: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那鬼附的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，身穿衣服，神志清醒，他们就害怕。
refs.text_big5: 他們來到耶穌那裏，看見那鬼附的人，就是從前被群鬼所附的，坐著，身穿衣服，神志清醒，他們就害怕。
refs.text_en: And they came to Jesus and saw the demon-possessed man sitting down, clothed, and sane, the man who had had the legion, and they became frightened.

refs.text_gb: 看见这事的，便将鬼附之人所遇见的，和那群猪的事，都对人述说。
refs.text_big5: 看見這事的，便將鬼附之人所遇見的，和那群豬的事，都對人述說。
refs.text_en: And those who had seen it related to them how it had happened to the demon-possessed man and concerning the hogs.

refs.text_gb: 他们就恳求耶稣离开他们的境界。
refs.text_big5: 他們就懇求耶穌離開他們的境界。
refs.text_en: And they began to entreat Him to depart from their borders.

refs.text_gb: 他们到了格拉森人的地方，就是加利利的对面。
refs.text_big5: 他們到了格拉森人的地方，就是加利利的對面。
refs.text_en: And they sailed down to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across from Galilee.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣一上岸，就有一个鬼附的人，从城里出来迎着祂。这人已经许久不穿衣服，不住房子，只住在坟茔间。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌一上岸，就有一個鬼附的人，從城裏出來迎著祂。這人已經許久不穿衣服，不住房子，只住在墳塋間。
refs.text_en: And when He went out onto the land, a certain man out of the city, who had demons, met Him, and for a considerable time he had not put on clothes and did not remain in a house but among the tombs.

refs.text_gb: 他看见耶稣，就喊叫起来，俯伏在祂面前，大声说，至高神的儿子耶稣，我与你何干？求你不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_big5: 他看見耶穌，就喊叫起來，俯伏在祂面前，大聲說，至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你何干？求你不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_en: And when he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell before Him and said in a loud voice, What do I have to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beseech You, do not torment me.

refs.text_gb: 因耶稣曾吩咐污灵从那人身上出来；原来这鬼屡次抓住他，他常被人看守，又被铁链和脚镣捆锁，他竟把锁链挣断，被鬼催逼到旷野去。
refs.text_big5: 因耶穌曾吩咐污靈從那人身上出來；原來這鬼屢次抓住他，他常被人看守，又被鐵鍊和腳鐐捆鎖，他竟把鎖鍊掙斷，被鬼催逼到曠野去。
refs.text_en: For He had charged the unclean spirit to come out from the man; for many times it had seized him and he had been bound with chains and shackles and was kept under watch, yet every time he tore the bonds apart and was driven by the demon into the wilderness.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣问他说，你名叫什么？他说，我名叫群，因为有许多鬼进入他里面。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌問他說，你名叫甚麼？他說，我名叫群，因為有許多鬼進入他裏面。
refs.text_en: And Jesus questioned him, What is your name? And he said, Legion, because many demons had entered into him.

refs.text_gb: 鬼就央求耶稣，不要吩咐它们到无底坑里去。
refs.text_big5: 鬼就央求耶穌，不要吩咐牠們到無底坑裏去。
refs.text_en: And they entreated Him not to order them to depart into the abyss.

refs.text_gb: 那里有一大群猪正在山上吃食。鬼就央求耶稣，准它们进入猪群，祂便准了它们。
refs.text_big5: 那裏有一大群豬正在山上喫食。鬼就央求耶穌，准牠們進入豬群，祂便准了牠們。
refs.text_en: Now there was a herd of many hogs feeding there on the mountain. And they entreated Him to permit them to enter into them, and He gave them permission.

refs.text_gb: 鬼就从那人出来，进入猪里去；于是那群猪闯下山崖，投入湖里淹死了。
refs.text_big5: 鬼就從那人出來，進入豬裏去；於是那群豬闖下山崖，投入湖裏淹死了。
refs.text_en: And the demons came out from the man and entered into the hogs, and the herd rushed down the steep slope into the lake and was drowned.

refs.text_gb: 放猪的看见所发生的事，就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。
refs.text_big5: 放豬的看見所發生的事，就逃跑了，去告訴城裏和鄉下的人。
refs.text_en: And when those who were feeding them saw what had happened, they fled and reported it in the city and in the countryside.

refs.text_gb: 众人出来，要看所发生的事。到了耶稣那里，看见鬼所离开的那人，坐在耶稣脚前，身穿衣服，神志清醒，他们就害怕。
refs.text_big5: 眾人出來，要看所發生的事。到了耶穌那裏，看見鬼所離開的那人，坐在耶穌腳前，身穿衣服，神志清醒，他們就害怕。
refs.text_en: And the people went out to see what had happened. And they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had come out, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and sane, and they became frightened.

refs.text_gb: 看见这事的，便将鬼附的人怎样得了拯救，都报告他们。
refs.text_big5: 看見這事的，便將鬼附的人怎樣得了拯救，都報告他們。
refs.text_en: And those who had seen it reported to them how the demon-possessed man had been healed.

refs.text_gb: 格拉森四周全境的人，因为极其害怕，都求耶稣离开他们，耶稣就上船回去了。
refs.text_big5: 格拉森四周全境的人，因為極其害怕，都求耶穌離開他們，耶穌就上船回去了。
refs.text_en: And all the multitude from the surrounding region of the Gerasenes asked Him to depart from them, for they were seized with great fear; and He got into a boat and returned.

verses.text_gb: 他们喊着说，神[Fn1][Cra]的儿子，我[Fn2][Crb]们与你何干？时[Fn3][Crc]候还没有到，你就来这里叫我们受苦么？
verses.text_big5: 他們喊著說，神[Fn1][Cra]的兒子，我[Fn2][Crb]們與你何干？時[Fn3][Crc]候還沒有到，你就來這裏叫我們受苦麼？
verses.text_en: And behold, they cried out, saying, What do we have to do with You, Son of God? Have You come here before the time to torment us?
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们喊着说，神的儿子，我们与你何干？时候还没有到，你就来这里叫我们受苦么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們喊著說，神的兒子，我們與你何干？時候還沒有到，你就來這裏叫我們受苦麼？

footnotes.zh: 王自称人子(20)，但鬼称祂神的儿子，试诱祂离开人子的地位(见四3注2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 王自稱人子，（20，）但鬼稱祂神的兒子，試誘祂離開人子的地位。（見四3註2。）
footnotes.en: 8:29 1 What Lit., What to us and to You? (a Hebrew idiom).

footnotes.zh: 直译，这与我们与你何干？(希伯来成语。)
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，這與我們與你何干？（希伯來成語。）
footnotes.en: 8:29 2 Son The King called Himself the Son of Man (v. 20), but the demons called Him the Son of God, tempting Him to deviate from His standing as the Son of Man. (See note Matt. 4:3 2 .)

footnotes.zh: 含示神已经定了时候，叫鬼受苦。鬼也知道那时候，就是千年国以后，直到永远(见启二十13注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 含示神已經定了時候，叫鬼受苦。鬼也知道那時候，就是千年國以後，直到永遠。（見啟二十13註1。）
footnotes.en: 8:29 3 before Before the time implies that God has appointed a time for the demons to be tormented and that the demons know that time, which will be after the millennium and for eternity. (See note Rev. 20:13 1 .)

refs.text_gb: 那试诱者进前来，对祂说，你若是神的儿子，就叫这些石头变成饼吧。
refs.text_big5: 那試誘者進前來，對祂說，你若是神的兒子，就叫這些石頭變成餅罷。
refs.text_en: And the tempter came and said to Him, If You are the Son of God, speak that these stones may become loaves of bread.

refs.text_gb: 对祂说，你若是神的儿子，就跳下去吧；因为经上记着，“主要为你吩咐祂的使者，用手托着你，免得你的脚碰在石头上。”
refs.text_big5: 對祂說，你若是神的兒子，就跳下去罷；因為經上記著，“主要為你吩咐祂的使者，用手托著你，免得你的腳碰在石頭上。”
refs.text_en: And said to Him, If You are the Son of God, cast Yourself down; for it is written, "To His angels He shall give charge concerning You, and on their hands they shall bear You up, lest You strike Your foot against a stone."

refs.text_gb: 拿撒勒人耶稣，我们与你何干？你来除灭我们么？我知道你是谁，乃是神的圣者。
refs.text_big5: 拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你何干？你來除滅我們麼？我知道你是誰，乃是神的聖者。
refs.text_en: What have we to do with You, Jesus, Nazarene? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are-the Holy One of God.

refs.text_gb: 唉，拿撒勒人耶稣，我们与你何干？你来除灭我们么？我知道你是谁，乃是神的圣者。
refs.text_big5: 唉，拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你何干？你來除滅我們麼？我知道你是誰，乃是神的聖者。
refs.text_en: Ah! What do we have to do with You, Jesus, Nazarene? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are-the Holy One of God.

refs.text_gb: 于是海交出其中的死者，死亡和阴间也交出其中的死者，他们都各自照所行的受审判。
refs.text_big5: 於是海交出其中的死者，死亡和陰間也交出其中的死者，他們都各自照所行的受審判。
refs.text_en: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it, and death and Hades gave up the dead which were in them; and they were judged, each of them, according to their works.

verses.text_gb: 离他们很远，有一大群猪正在吃食。
verses.text_big5: 離他們很遠，有一大群豬正在喫食。
verses.text_en: Now there was, a good way off from them, a herd of many hogs feeding.
verses.text_gb_plain: 离他们很远，有一大群猪正在吃食。
verses.text_big5_plain: 離他們很遠，有一大群豬正在喫食。

verses.text_gb: 鬼央[Fn1]求耶稣说，你若赶我们，就打发我们进入猪群吧。
verses.text_big5: 鬼央[Fn1]求耶穌說，你若趕我們，就打發我們進入豬群罷。
verses.text_en: And the demons entreated Him, saying, If You cast us out, send us into the herd of hogs.
verses.text_gb_plain: 鬼央求耶稣说，你若赶我们，就打发我们进入猪群吧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 鬼央求耶穌說，你若趕我們，就打發我們進入豬群罷。

footnotes.zh: 这指明鬼是在王的能力和权柄之下。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明鬼是在王的能力和權柄之下。
footnotes.en: 8:31 1 entreated This indicates that the demons were under the power and authority of the King.

verses.text_gb: 祂对它们说，去[Fn1]吧！鬼就出来，进入猪群；全群骤然闯下山崖，投[Fn2]入海里，死在水中。
verses.text_big5: 祂對牠們說，去[Fn1]罷！鬼就出來，進入豬群；全群驟然闖下山崖，投[Fn2]入海裏，死在水中。
verses.text_en: And He said to them, Go! And they came out and went into the hogs. And behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep slope into the sea, and they died in the waters.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂对它们说，去吧！鬼就出来，进入猪群；全群骤然闯下山崖，投入海里，死在水中。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂對牠們說，去罷！鬼就出來，進入豬群；全群驟然闖下山崖，投入海裏，死在水中。

footnotes.zh: 这是王带着权柄的命令，鬼就听从了。王答应鬼的央求，让它们进入猪群，因为在神眼中，猪是不洁净的(利十一7)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是王帶著權柄的命令，鬼就聽從了。王答應鬼的央求，讓牠們進入豬群，因為在神眼中，豬是不潔淨的。（利十一7。）
footnotes.en: 8:32 1 Go This was the King's authoritative order, and the demons obeyed it. The King complied with the demons' entreaty and allowed them to enter into the hogs because hogs are unclean in the eyes of God (Lev. 11:7).

footnotes.zh: 猪群受不了鬼附，就投入海里。鬼同意，因为水是它们的住处。 (十二43～44，见创世记生命读经第二篇。)
footnotes.zh_big5: 豬群受不了鬼附，就投入海裏。鬼同意，因為水是牠們的住處。（十二43～44，見創世記生命讀經第二篇。）
footnotes.en: 8:32 2 rushed The hogs would not tolerate being possessed by the demons,and they rushed into the sea.The demons consented because the water is their lodging place (Matt. 12:43-44 see Life-study of Genesis, Message Two).

verses.text_gb: 放猪的就逃跑进城，将一切事，和鬼附之人的事，都报告出来。
verses.text_big5: 放豬的就逃跑進城，將一切事，和鬼附之人的事，都報告出來。
verses.text_en: And those who were feeding them fled and went away into the city and reported everything, including what had happened to those possessed by demons.
verses.text_gb_plain: 放猪的就逃跑进城，将一切事，和鬼附之人的事，都报告出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 放豬的就逃跑進城，將一切事，和鬼附之人的事，都報告出來。

verses.text_gb: 全城的人都出来，要迎见耶稣；既看见了，就恳求祂离[Fn1][Cra]开他们的境界。
verses.text_big5: 全城的人都出來，要迎見耶穌；既看見了，就懇求祂離[Fn1][Cra]開他們的境界。
verses.text_en: And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus; and when they saw Him, they entreated Him to depart from their borders.
verses.text_gb_plain: 全城的人都出来，要迎见耶稣；既看见了，就恳求祂离开他们的境界。
verses.text_big5_plain: 全城的人都出來，要迎見耶穌；既看見了，就懇求祂離開他們的境界。

footnotes.zh: 城里的人失去猪，就弃绝王。他们要不洁净的猪，却不要属天国度的王。他们也许是外邦人(加大拉在加利利海边，在外邦人的加利利——四15——对岸)。他们因着自己不洁的谋生方法，弃绝了属天的王。
footnotes.zh_big5: 城裏的人失去豬，就棄絕王。他們要不潔淨的豬，卻不要屬天國度的王。他們也許是外邦人。（加大拉在加利利海邊，在外邦人的加利利─四15─對岸。）他們因著自己不潔的謀生方法，棄絕了屬天的王。
footnotes.en: 8:34 1 depart The people of the city, having lost their hogs, rejected the King. They wanted their unclean hogs but did not want the King of the heavenly kingdom. They probably were Gentiles. (Gadara was on the shore of the Sea of Galilee, across from Galilee of the Gentiles — Matt. 4:15.) They rejected the heavenly King because of their unclean way of making a living.

refs.text_gb: 于是来劝他们，领他们出来，请他们离开那城。
refs.text_big5: 於是來勸他們，領他們出來，請他們離開那城。
refs.text_en: And they came and entreated them. And when they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣上了船，渡过去，来到自[Fn1][Cra]己的城里。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌上了船，渡過去，來到自[Fn1][Cra]己的城裏。
verses.text_en: And stepping into a boat, He crossed over and came to His own city.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣上了船，渡过去，来到自己的城里。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌上了船，渡過去，來到自己的城裏。

footnotes.zh: 这是迦百农，主当时住在这里(四13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是迦百農，主當時住在這裏。（四13。）
footnotes.en: 9:1 1 own Capernaum, where the Lord now dwelt (Matt. 4:13).

refs.text_gb: 又离开拿撒勒，来住在西布伦和拿弗他利境内，靠海的迦百农。
refs.text_big5: 又離開拿撒勒，來住在西布倫和拿弗他利境內，靠海的迦百農。
refs.text_en: And leaving Nazareth, He came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is beside the sea in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali,

verses.text_gb: 看[Cra]哪，有人用卧榻抬着一个瘫子到祂跟前来。耶稣见[Fn1]他们的信[Crb]心，就对瘫子说，孩子，放[Fn2][Crc]心吧，你的罪[Fn3]赦[Crd]了。
verses.text_big5: 看[Cra]哪，有人用臥榻抬著一個癱子到祂跟前來。耶穌見[Fn1]他們的信[Crb]心，就對癱子說，孩子，放[Fn2][Crc]心罷，你的罪[Fn3]赦[Crd]了。
verses.text_en: And behold, they brought to Him a paralytic, lying on a bed. And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Take courage, child; your sins are forgiven.
verses.text_gb_plain: 看哪，有人用卧榻抬着一个瘫子到祂跟前来。耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说，孩子，放心吧，你的罪赦了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 看哪，有人用臥榻抬著一個癱子到祂跟前來。耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說，孩子，放心罷，你的罪赦了。

footnotes.zh: 他们拆通了主所在房子的屋顶(可二4)。主由此看出他们的信心。
footnotes.zh_big5: 他們拆通了主所在房子的屋頂。（可二4。）主由此看出他們的信心。
footnotes.en: 9:2 1 seeing They dug through the roof of the house where the Lord was (Mark 2:4). By this the Lord saw their faith.

footnotes.zh: 直译，放胆。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，放膽。
footnotes.en: 9:2 2 sins This indicates that the paralytic was sick because of his sins.

footnotes.zh: 原文，复数。这指明瘫子患病，是因自己的罪。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文，複數。這指明癱子患病，是因自己的罪。

refs.text_gb: 有人带着一个瘫子来就耶稣，是由四个人抬来的。
refs.text_big5: 有人帶著一個癱子來就耶穌，是由四個人抬來的。
refs.text_en: And they came, bringing to Him a paralytic carried by four men.

refs.text_gb: 因为人多，不能带到祂跟前，就把耶稣所在的地方，拆了屋顶，既拆通了，就把瘫子所躺卧的褥子缒下去。
refs.text_big5: 因為人多，不能帶到祂跟前，就把耶穌所在的地方，拆了屋頂，既拆通了，就把癱子所躺臥的褥子縋下去。
refs.text_en: And being unable to bring him to Him because of the crowd, they removed the roof where He was. And when they had dug through, they lowered the mat on which the paralytic was lying.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说，孩子，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說，孩子，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_en: And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Child, your sins are forgiven.

refs.text_gb: 但有几个经学家坐在那里，心里议论说，
refs.text_big5: 但有幾個經學家坐在那裏，心裏議論說，
refs.text_en: But some of the scribes were sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

refs.text_gb: 这个人为什么这样说？祂说僭妄的话了。除了神一位以外，谁能赦罪？
refs.text_big5: 這個人為甚麼這樣說？祂說僭妄的話了。除了神一位以外，誰能赦罪？
refs.text_en: Why is this man speaking this way? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins except One, God?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣灵里即刻知道他们心里这样议论，就对他们说，你们心里为什么议论这些事？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌靈裏即刻知道他們心裏這樣議論，就對他們說，你們心裏為甚麼議論這些事？
refs.text_en: And immediately Jesus, knowing fully in His spirit that they were reasoning this way within themselves, said to them, Why are you reasoning about these things in your hearts?

refs.text_gb: 对瘫子说，你的罪赦了，或说，起来，拿你的褥子行走，哪一样更容易？
refs.text_big5: 對癱子說，你的罪赦了，或說，起來，拿你的褥子行走，那一樣更容易？
refs.text_en: Which is easier: to say to the paralytic, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Rise and take up your mat and walk?

refs.text_gb: 但要叫你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄─就对瘫子说，
refs.text_big5: 但要叫你們知道人子在地上有赦罪的權柄─就對癱子說，
refs.text_en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority to forgive sins on earth-He said to the paralytic,

refs.text_gb: 我吩咐你，起来，拿你的褥子回家去吧！
refs.text_big5: 我吩咐你，起來，拿你的褥子回家去罷！
refs.text_en: To you I say, Rise, take up your mat and go to your house.

refs.text_gb: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当着众人面前出去了，以致众人都惊奇，荣耀神说，我们从来没有见过这样的事。
refs.text_big5: 那人就起來，立刻拿著褥子，當著眾人面前出去了，以致眾人都驚奇，榮耀神說，我們從來沒有見過這樣的事。
refs.text_en: And he rose and immediately took up the mat and went out before them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, We have never seen anything like this!

refs.text_gb: 看哪，人用卧榻抬着一个瘫痪的人，想要抬进去，放在耶稣面前。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，人用臥榻抬著一個癱瘓的人，想要抬進去，放在耶穌面前。
refs.text_en: And behold, some men brought on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they sought a way to carry him in and lay him before Him.

refs.text_gb: 因为人多，找不到办法抬进去，就上了房顶，从瓦间把他连卧榻缒到当中，正在耶稣面前。
refs.text_big5: 因為人多，找不到辦法抬進去，就上了房頂，從瓦間把他連臥榻縋到當中，正在耶穌面前。
refs.text_en: And since they could not find by what way they might carry him in because of the crowd, they went up onto the housetop and let him down with the cot through the tiles into the midst, in front of Jesus.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣见他们的信心，就说，人哪，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌見他們的信心，就說，人哪，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_en: And seeing their faith, He said, Man, your sins are forgiven you.

refs.text_gb: 经学家和法利赛人就议论说，这说僭妄话的是谁？除了神一位以外，谁能赦罪？
refs.text_big5: 經學家和法利賽人就議論說，這說僭妄話的是誰？除了神一位以外，誰能赦罪？
refs.text_en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins except God alone?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣深知他们所议论的，就对他们说，你们心里为什么议论？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌深知他們所議論的，就對他們說，你們心裏為甚麼議論？
refs.text_en: But Jesus, knowing fully their reasonings, answered and said to them, Why are you reasoning in your hearts?

refs.text_gb: 说，你的罪赦了，或说，你起来行走，哪一样更容易？
refs.text_big5: 說，你的罪赦了，或說，你起來行走，那一樣更容易？
refs.text_en: Which is easier: to say, Your sins are forgiven you, or to say, Rise and walk?

refs.text_gb: 但要叫你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄─就对瘫子说，我吩咐你起来，拿你的小卧榻回家去吧！
refs.text_big5: 但要叫你們知道人子在地上有赦罪的權柄─就對癱子說，我吩咐你起來，拿你的小臥榻回家去罷！
refs.text_en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive Sins-he said to the one paralyzed, To you I say, Rise and take up your cot and go to your house.

refs.text_gb: 那人当着众人面前立刻起来，拿着所躺卧的卧榻回家去，荣耀神。
refs.text_big5: 那人當著眾人面前立刻起來，拿著所躺臥的臥榻回家去，榮耀神。
refs.text_en: And he rose up at once before them and took up that upon which he was lying and went away to his house, glorifying God.

refs.text_gb: 众人都惊奇，并荣耀神，且满了敬畏，说，我们今天看见非常的事了。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都驚奇，並榮耀神，且滿了敬畏，說，我們今天看見非常的事了。
refs.text_en: And astonishment took hold of all, and they glorified God and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen extraordinary things today.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣听见，就希奇，对跟从的人说，我实在告诉你们，这样大的信心，我在以色列中，没有遇见人有过。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌聽見，就希奇，對跟從的人說，我實在告訴你們，這樣大的信心，我在以色列中，沒有遇見人有過。
refs.text_en: Now when Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those who followed, Truly I say to you, With no one in Israel have I found such great faith.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣转过来，看见她，就说，女儿，放心，你的信救了你。从那时候，那女人就得了拯救。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌轉過來，看見她，就說，女兒，放心，你的信救了你。從那時候，那女人就得了拯救。
refs.text_en: And Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, Take courage, daughter; your faith has healed you. And the woman was healed from that hour.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就摸他们的眼睛，说，照着你们的信，给你们成就了吧！
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就摸他們的眼睛，說，照著你們的信，給你們成就了罷！
refs.text_en: Then He touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith, let it be done to you.

refs.text_gb: 于是耶稣回答她说，妇人，你的信心真大！照你所愿的给你成全吧。从那时候，她的女儿就得了医治。
refs.text_big5: 於是耶穌回答她說，婦人，你的信心真大！照你所願的給你成全罷。從那時候，她的女兒就得了醫治。
refs.text_en: Then Jesus answered and said to her, O woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you as you wish. And her daughter was healed from that hour.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，去吧，你的信救了你。他立刻看见了，就在路上跟随耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，去罷，你的信救了你。他立刻看見了，就在路上跟隨耶穌。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to him, Go; your faith has healed you. And immediately he received his sight and followed Him on the road.

refs.text_gb: 但耶稣对那女人说，你的信救了你，平平安安地走吧！
refs.text_big5: 但耶穌對那女人說，你的信救了你，平平安安的走罷！
refs.text_en: But He said to the woman, Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.

refs.text_gb: 就对那人说，起来，走吧，你的信救了你。
refs.text_big5: 就對那人說，起來，走罷，你的信救了你。
refs.text_en: And He said to him, Rise up and go; your faith has healed you.

refs.text_gb: 他听保罗讲论；保罗定睛看他，见他有信心，可以得救，
refs.text_big5: 他聽保羅講論；保羅定睛看他，見他有信心，可以得救，
refs.text_en: This man heard Paul speaking, who, looking intently at him and seeing that he had faith to be healed,

refs.text_gb: 耶稣转过来，看见她，就说，女儿，放心，你的信救了你。从那时候，那女人就得了拯救。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌轉過來，看見她，就說，女兒，放心，你的信救了你。從那時候，那女人就得了拯救。
refs.text_en: And Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, Take courage, daughter; your faith has healed you. And the woman was healed from that hour.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣连忙对他们说，放心，是我，不要怕。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌連忙對他們說，放心，是我，不要怕。
refs.text_en: But immediately Jesus talked to them, saying, Take courage. It is I. Do not be afraid.

refs.text_gb: 因为他们都看见了祂，且甚惊慌。耶稣立即同他们讲话，对他们说，放心，是我，不要怕。
refs.text_big5: 因為他們都看見了祂，且甚驚慌。耶穌立即同他們講話，對他們說，放心，是我，不要怕。
refs.text_en: For they all saw Him and were startled. But immediately He spoke with them and said to them, Take courage. It is I. Do not be afraid.

refs.text_gb: 我将这些事对你们说了，是要叫你们在我里面有平安。在世上你们有苦难，但你们可以放心，我已经胜了世界。
refs.text_big5: 我將這些事對你們說了，是要叫你們在我裏面有平安。在世上你們有苦難，但你們可以放心，我已經勝了世界。
refs.text_en: These things I have spoken to you that in Me you may have peace. In the world you have affliction, but take courage; I have overcome the world.

refs.text_gb: 于是对那女人说，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_big5: 於是對那女人說，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_en: And He said to her, Your sins are forgiven.

verses.text_gb: 竟有几个经[Fn1]学家心里说，这个人说[Fn2][Cra]僭妄的话了。
verses.text_big5: 竟有幾個經[Fn1]學家心裏說，這個人說[Fn2][Cra]僭妄的話了。
verses.text_en: And behold, some of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemes.
verses.text_gb_plain: 竟有几个经学家心里说，这个人说僭妄的话了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 竟有幾個經學家心裏說，這個人說僭妄的話了。

footnotes.zh: 见二4注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見二4註1。
footnotes.en: 9:3 1 scribes See note Matt. 2:4 1 .

footnotes.zh: 经学家自以为认识圣经，认为只有神有权柄赦免罪；在他们眼中，耶稣不过是个人，所以听见祂说，你的罪赦了，就认为祂亵渎神。这指明他们不认识主就是神。他们说这样的话，就弃绝了属天国度的王。这是犹太宗教首领第一次的弃绝。
footnotes.zh_big5: 經學家自以為認識聖經，認為只有神有權柄赦免罪；在他們眼中，耶穌不過是個人，所以聽見祂說，你的罪赦了，就認為祂褻瀆神。這指明他們不認識主就是神。他們說這樣的話，就棄絕了屬天國度的王。這是猶太宗教首領第一次的棄絕。
footnotes.en: 9:3 2 blasphemes The scribes, confident that they knew the Scriptures, thought that only God had authority to forgive sins and that Jesus, who in their eyes was only a man, had blasphemed God when He said, "Your sins are forgiven." This indicates that they did not realize that the Lord was God. By uttering such a word they rejected the King of the heavenly kingdom. This was the first rejection by the leaders of the Jewish religion.

refs.text_gb: 大祭司就撕开衣服，说，祂说了僭妄的话，我们还需要什么证人？你看，这僭妄的话现在你们都听见了，
refs.text_big5: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說，祂說了僭妄的話，我們還需要甚麼證人？你看，這僭妄的話現在你們都聽見了，
refs.text_en: Then the high priest tore his garments, saying, He has blasphemed! What further need do we have of witnesses? Behold, now you have heard the blasphemy.

refs.text_gb: 那么父所分别为圣，又差到世上来的，因祂说，我是神的儿子，你们就说，你说僭妄的话么？
refs.text_big5: 那麼父所分別為聖，又差到世上來的，因祂說，我是神的兒子，你們就說，你說僭妄的話麼？
refs.text_en: Do you say of Him whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world, You are blaspheming, because I said, I am the Son of God?

verses.text_gb: 耶稣知[Fn1][Cra]道他们的心[Fn2]意，就说，你们为什么心里思[Crb]念恶事？
verses.text_big5: 耶穌知[Fn1][Cra]道他們的心[Fn2]意，就說，你們為甚麼心裏思[Crb]念惡事？
verses.text_en: And Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, Why are you thinking evil things in your hearts?
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就说，你们为什么心里思念恶事？
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就說，你們為甚麼心裏思念惡事？

footnotes.zh: 有古卷作，看出。这是主在祂灵里的感悟(可二8)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有古卷作，看出。這是主在祂靈裏的感悟。（可二8。）
footnotes.en: 9:4 1 knowing Some ancient MSS read, seeing. This was the Lord's perception in His spirit (Mark 2:8).

footnotes.zh: 或，思考，思想。带强烈感觉或邪情，恶意的臆测。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，思考，思想。帶強烈感覺或邪情，惡意的臆測。
footnotes.en: 9:4 2 thoughts Or, cogitations, inward reasonings. Evil surmisings with strong feeling or passion.

crossrefs.label: a
crossrefs.raw: 太十二25，可十二15，路六8，约二25

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就对他们说，凡国自相分争，必至荒凉；凡城或家自相分争，也难站住。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就對他們說，凡國自相分爭，必至荒涼；凡城或家自相分爭，也難站住。
refs.text_en: But knowing their thoughts, He said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself becomes desolate, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的假意，就对他们说，你们为什么试诱我？拿一个银币给我看。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的假意，就對他們說，你們為甚麼試誘我？拿一個銀幣給我看。
refs.text_en: But He, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, Why do you tempt Me? Bring Me a denarius that I may look at it.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对那枯干手的人说，起来，站在当中。那人就起来站着。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對那枯乾手的人說，起來，站在當中。那人就起來站著。
refs.text_en: But He knew their reasonings and said to the man who had the withered hand, Rise and stand in the midst. And he rose up and stood.

refs.text_gb: 也用不着谁见证人怎样，因祂知道在人里面的是什么。
refs.text_big5: 也用不著誰見證人怎樣，因祂知道在人裏面的是甚麼。
refs.text_en: And because He did not need anyone to testify concerning man, for He Himself knew what was in man.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华见人在地上罪恶甚大，心中终日所思念的尽都是恶；
refs.text_big5: 耶和華見人在地上罪惡甚大，心中終日所思念的盡都是惡；
refs.text_en: And Jehovah saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

verses.text_gb: 说，你的罪[Fn1]赦了，或说，你起[Fn2]来行走，哪一样更[Fn3]容易？
verses.text_big5: 說，你的罪[Fn1]赦了，或說，你起[Fn2]來行走，那一樣更[Fn3]容易？
verses.text_en: For which is easier, to say, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Rise and walk?
verses.text_gb_plain: 说，你的罪赦了，或说，你起来行走，哪一样更容易？
verses.text_big5_plain: 說，你的罪赦了，或說，你起來行走，那一樣更容易？

footnotes.zh: 原文，复数。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文，複數。
footnotes.en: 9:5 1 easier The Lord did not ask, "Which is more difficult?" because to Him nothing is difficult. For Him to say, "Your sins are forgiven," was easier than to say, "Rise and walk."

footnotes.zh: 主的救恩不仅赦免我们的罪，也使我们起来行走。不是先起来行走，然后罪得赦免，那是靠行为；乃是罪先得赦免，然后起来行走，这是靠恩典。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主的救恩不僅赦免我們的罪，也使我們起來行走。不是先起來行走，然後罪得赦免，那是靠行為；乃是罪先得赦免，然後起來行走，這是靠恩典。
footnotes.en: 9:5 2 Rise In the Lord's salvation He not only forgives our sins but also causes us to rise and walk. It is not that we first rise and walk and then are forgiven of our sins; such a salvation would be by works. Rather, we first are forgiven of our sins and then rise and walk; such a salvation is by grace.

footnotes.zh: 主没有说那一样更难，因为在祂没有一事是难的。在祂说你的罪赦了，比说你起来行走更容易。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主沒有說那一樣更難，因為在祂沒有一事是難的。在祂說你的罪赦了，比說你起來行走更容易。

verses.text_gb: 但要叫你们知道人[Cra]子在地上有赦[Crb]罪[Fn1]的权[Fn2]柄─于是对瘫子说，起来，拿[Fn3][Crc]你的卧榻回[Fn4]家去吧！
verses.text_big5: 但要叫你們知道人[Cra]子在地上有赦[Crb]罪[Fn1]的權[Fn2]柄─於是對癱子說，起來，拿[Fn3][Crc]你的臥榻回[Fn4]家去罷！
verses.text_en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins-then He said to the paralytic, Rise, take up your bed and go to your house.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但要叫你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄─于是对瘫子说，起来，拿你的卧榻回家去吧！
verses.text_big5_plain: 但要叫你們知道人子在地上有赦罪的權柄─於是對癱子說，起來，拿你的臥榻回家去罷！

footnotes.zh: 原文，复数。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文，複數。
footnotes.en: 9:6 1 authority To forgive sins is a matter of having authority on earth. Only this kingly Savior, who had been authorized by God and who would die to redeem sinners, had such authority (Acts 5:31; 10:43; 13:38). This authority was for the establishing of the kingdom of the heavens (Matt. 16:19).

footnotes.zh: 赦罪乃是一件在地上有关权柄的事。惟有这位为神授权，并要受死救赎罪人的君尊救主，才有这样的权柄(徒五31，十43，十三38)。这权柄乃是为着建立诸天的国(十六19)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 赦罪乃是一件在地上有關權柄的事。惟有這位為神授權，並要受死救贖罪人的君尊救主，纔有這樣的權柄。（徒五31，十43，十三38。）這權柄乃是為著建立諸天的國。（十六19。）
footnotes.en: 9:6 2 take The Lord enabled the paralytic not only to walk but also to take up his bed and walk. Formerly, the bed had borne him; now he bore it. This is the power of the Lord's salvation.

footnotes.zh: 主不仅叫瘫子能行走，且叫他能拿卧榻行走。原先卧榻托着他，现在他拿着卧榻。这是主救恩的大能。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主不僅叫癱子能行走，且叫他能拿臥榻行走。原先臥榻托著他，現在他拿著臥榻。這是主救恩的大能。
footnotes.en: 9:6 3 go This paralytic was brought to the Lord by others, but he went home by himself. This indicates that it is not that the sinner can go to the Lord, but that the sinner can go from the Lord by the Lord's salvation.

footnotes.zh: 这瘫子被人抬到主跟前，却自己走回家。这指明不是罪人能走到主跟前，乃是罪人因着主的救恩，能从主那里走回去。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這癱子被人抬到主跟前，卻自己走回家。這指明不是罪人能走到主跟前，乃是罪人因著主的救恩，能從主那裏走回去。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有枕头的地方。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of heaven have roosts, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head.

refs.text_gb: 同席的人心里说，这人是谁，竟然赦罪？
refs.text_big5: 同席的人心裏說，這人是誰，竟然赦罪？
refs.text_en: And those who were reclining at table with Him began to say within themselves, Who is this who even forgives sins?

refs.text_gb: 这一位，神已将祂高举在自己的右边，作元首，作救主，将悔改和赦罪赐给以色列人。
refs.text_big5: 這一位，神已將祂高舉在自己的右邊，作元首，作救主，將悔改和赦罪賜給以色列人。
refs.text_en: This One God has exalted to His right hand as Leader and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，起来，拿你的褥子走吧。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，起來，拿你的褥子走罷。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to him, Rise, take up your mat and walk.

verses.text_gb: 那人就起[Fn1]来，回家去了。
verses.text_big5: 那人就起[Fn1]來，回家去了。
verses.text_en: And he rose and went away to his house.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那人就起来，回家去了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那人就起來，回家去了。

footnotes.zh: 瘫子起来行走，证明他得了医治；他得了医治，证明他的罪得了赦免。
footnotes.zh_big5: 癱子起來行走，證明他得了醫治；他得了醫治，證明他的罪得了赦免。
footnotes.en: 9:7 1 rose The paralytic's rising and going proved that he was healed, and his being healed proved that his sins were forgiven.

verses.text_gb: 群众看见，就起了敬[Cra]畏，荣[Crb]耀那赐这样权柄给人的神。
verses.text_big5: 群眾看見，就起了敬[Cra]畏，榮[Crb]耀那賜這樣權柄給人的神。
verses.text_en: And when the crowds saw this, they feared and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
verses.text_gb_plain: 群众看见，就起了敬畏，荣耀那赐这样权柄给人的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 群眾看見，就起了敬畏，榮耀那賜這樣權柄給人的神。

refs.text_gb: 众人都起了敬畏，荣耀神说，有大申言者在我们中间兴起来了，又说，神眷顾祂的百姓了。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都起了敬畏，榮耀神說，有大申言者在我們中間興起來了，又說，神眷顧祂的百姓了。
refs.text_en: And fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, A great prophet has been raised up among us, and, God has visited His people!

refs.text_gb: 以致群众都希奇，因看见哑巴说话，残废的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看见；他们就荣耀以色列的神。
refs.text_big5: 以致群眾都希奇，因看見啞吧說話，殘廢的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看見；他們就榮耀以色列的神。
refs.text_en: So that the crowd marveled, because they saw the dumb speaking, the crippled healthy and the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.

verses.text_gb: 耶[Cra]稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马[Fn1][Crb]太，坐在税关上，就对他说，跟[Fn2][Crc]从我。他就起来，跟[Fn3]从了耶稣。
verses.text_big5: 耶[Cra]穌從那裏往前走，看見一個人名叫馬[Fn1][Crb]太，坐在稅關上，就對他說，跟[Fn2][Crc]從我。他就起來，跟[Fn3]從了耶穌。
verses.text_en: And as Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man sitting at the tax office, called Matthew, and He said to him, Follow Me. And he rose and followed Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马太，坐在税关上，就对他说，跟从我。他就起来，跟从了耶稣。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌從那裏往前走，看見一個人名叫馬太，坐在稅關上，就對他說，跟從我。他就起來，跟從了耶穌。

footnotes.zh: 马太又名利未(可二14，路五27)。他是个税吏(十3)，得救后因神的恩典，成了一个使徒(十2～3，徒一13)。他是本福音的作者。
footnotes.zh_big5: 馬太又名利未。（可二14，路五27。）他是個稅吏，（十3，）得救後因神的恩典，成了一個使徒。（十2～3，徒一13。）他是本福音的作者。
footnotes.en: 9:9 1 Matthew Matthew was also called Levi (Mark 2:14; Luke 5:27). He was a tax collector (10:3) who, after being saved, became an apostle by God's grace (Matt. 10:2-3; Acts 1:13). He was the writer of this Gospel.

footnotes.zh: 跟从主包括相信主。人若不相信祂，就不会跟从祂。相信主是得救(徒十六31)，跟从主是进窄门、走狭路、有分于诸天的国(七13～14)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 跟從主包括相信主。人若不相信祂，就不會跟從祂。相信主是得救，（徒十六31，）跟從主是進窄門、走狹路、有分於諸天的國。（七13～14。）
footnotes.en: 9:9 2 Follow Following the Lord includes believing in Him. No one follows Him unless he believes in Him. To believe in the Lord is to be saved (Acts 16:31), and to follow Him is to enter in through the narrow gate and walk the constricted way to participate in the kingdom of the heavens (Matt. 7:13-14).

footnotes.zh: 根据本节的记载，这似乎是主第一次遇见马太。主在祂的话语或外表上，必定有某种吸引力，叫马太跟从祂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 根據本節的記載，這似乎是主第一次遇見馬太。主在祂的話語或外表上，必定有某種吸引力，叫馬太跟從祂。
footnotes.en: 9:9 3 followed According to the record in this verse, it seems that this was the first time the Lord met Matthew. There must have been some attracting power, either in the Lord's word or in His appearance, that caused Matthew to follow Him.

refs.text_gb: 祂经过的时候，看见亚勒腓的儿子利未，坐在税关上，就对他说，跟从我。他就起来，跟从了耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 祂經過的時候，看見亞勒腓的兒子利未，坐在稅關上，就對他說，跟從我。他就起來，跟從了耶穌。
refs.text_en: And as He passed by, He saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office, and He said to him, Follow Me. And he rose and followed Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣在利未家里坐席，有好些税吏和罪人，与耶稣和祂的门徒一同坐席；因为这样的人多，他们也跟随耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌在利未家裏坐席，有好些稅吏和罪人，與耶穌和祂的門徒一同坐席；因為這樣的人多，他們也跟隨耶穌。
refs.text_en: And as He reclined at table in his house, many tax collectors and sinners were reclining together with Jesus and His disciples, for there were many, and they were following Him.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人中的经学家，看见祂和罪人并税吏一同吃饭，就对祂的门徒说，祂和税吏并罪人一同吃饭么？
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人中的經學家，看見祂和罪人並稅吏一同喫飯，就對祂的門徒說，祂和稅吏並罪人一同喫飯麼？
refs.text_en: And the scribes of the Pharisees, seeing that He ate with sinners and tax collectors, said to His disciples, Why does He eat with tax collectors and sinners?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣听见，就对他们说，强健的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着；我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌聽見，就對他們說，強健的人用不著醫生，有病的人纔用得著；我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。
refs.text_en: And when Jesus heard this, He said to them, Those who are strong have no need of a physician, but those who are ill; I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.

refs.text_gb: 这事以后，耶稣出去，看见一个税吏，名叫利未，坐在税关上，就对他说，跟从我。
refs.text_big5: 這事以後，耶穌出去，看見一個稅吏，名叫利未，坐在稅關上，就對他說，跟從我。
refs.text_en: And after these things He went out and beheld a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and He said to him, Follow Me.

refs.text_gb: 他就撇下一切，起来跟从了耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 他就撇下一切，起來跟從了耶穌。
refs.text_en: And leaving all, he rose up and followed Him.

refs.text_gb: 利未在自己家里，为耶稣大摆筵席，有许多税吏和别人，与他们一同坐席。
refs.text_big5: 利未在自己家裏，為耶穌大擺筵席，有許多稅吏和別人，與他們一同坐席。
refs.text_en: And Levi gave a great reception for Him in his house; and there was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining at table with them.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人和他们的经学家就向耶稣的门徒发怨言，说，你们为什么和税吏并罪人一同吃喝？
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人和他們的經學家就向耶穌的門徒發怨言，說，你們為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同喫喝？
refs.text_en: And the Pharisees and their scribes murmured at His disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，健康的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着；
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，健康的人用不著醫生，有病的人纔用得著；
refs.text_en: And Jesus answered and said to them, Those who are healthy have no need of a physician, but those who are ill;

refs.text_gb: 我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人悔改。
refs.text_big5: 我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人悔改。
refs.text_en: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

refs.text_gb: 腓力和巴多罗买；多马和税吏马太；亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太；
refs.text_big5: 腓力和巴多羅買；多馬和稅吏馬太；亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太；
refs.text_en: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，来跟从我，我要使你们作得人的渔夫。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，來跟從我，我要使你們作得人的漁夫。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Come after Me, and I will make you fishers of men.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣在屋[Fn1]里坐席，看哪，有好些税[Fn2][Cra]吏和罪[Crb]人来，与耶稣和祂的门徒一同坐席。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌在屋[Fn1]裏坐席，看哪，有好些稅[Fn2][Cra]吏和罪[Crb]人來，與耶穌和祂的門徒一同坐席。
verses.text_en: And as He was reclining at table in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and reclined together with Jesus and His disciples.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣在屋里坐席，看哪，有好些税吏和罪人来，与耶稣和祂的门徒一同坐席。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌在屋裏坐席，看哪，有好些稅吏和罪人來，與耶穌和祂的門徒一同坐席。

footnotes.zh: 这是马太的家(路五29，可二15)。身为本福音的作者，马太特意不说这是他的家，也不说是他为主大摆筵席。这是他的谦卑。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是馬太的家。（路五29，可二15。）身為本福音的作者，馬太特意不說這是他的家，也不說是他為主大擺筵席。這是他的謙卑。

refs.text_gb: 人子来了，也吃也喝，人又说，看哪，一个贪食好酒的人，一个税吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧从她的行为得称为义。
refs.text_big5: 人子來了，也喫也喝，人又說，看哪，一個貪食好酒的人，一個稅吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧從她的行為得稱為義。
refs.text_en: The Son of Man came eating and drinking; and they say, Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners. Yet wisdom is justified by her works.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人和经学家纷纷地唧咕议论说，这个人接待罪人，又同他们吃饭。

refs.text_en: And both the Pharisees and the scribes murmured among themselves, saying, This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.

verses.text_gb: 法[Fn1]利赛人看见，就对耶稣的门徒说，你[Fn2]们的老师为什么和税吏并罪人一同吃饭？

verses.text_big5_plain: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌的門徒說，你們的老師為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同喫飯？

footnotes.zh: 这问题指明，自义的法利赛人不认识神的恩典。他们以为神只按公义对待人。他们这样问，暴露他们对属天的王有异议，因而弃绝了祂。这是对属天君王之弃绝的继续。犹太宗教的首领，从3节起，已经开始弃绝祂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這問題指明，自義的法利賽人不認識神的恩典。他們以為神只按公義對待人。他們這樣問，暴露他們對屬天的王有異議，因而棄絕了祂。這是對屬天君王之棄絕的繼續。猶太宗教的首領，從3節起，已經開始棄絕祂。
footnotes.en: 9:11 2 Why This question indicates that the self-righteous Pharisees did not know the grace of God. They thought that God deals with man only according to righteousness. By asking this, they were exposed as dissenting from the heavenly King, and thus as those who had rejected Him. This was a continuation of the rejection of the heavenly King, begun in v. 3, by the leaders of the Jewish religion.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣听见，就说，强健的人用不着医[Fn1]生，有[Fn2]病的人才用得着。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌聽見，就說，強健的人用不著醫[Fn1]生，有[Fn2]病的人纔用得著。
verses.text_en: Now when He heard this, He said, Those who are strong have no need of a physician, but those who are ill.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣听见，就说，强健的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌聽見，就說，強健的人用不著醫生，有病的人纔用得著。

footnotes.zh: 属天国度的王，在祂尽职为着国度呼召人跟从祂的事上，是作医生，不是作审判官。审判官的审判是按着公义，医生的医治是按着怜悯和恩典。那些被祂作成属天国度子民的人，乃是患麻风(八2～4)、瘫痪(八5～13，九2～8)、发烧(八14～15)、鬼附(八16，28～32)、患各样疾病的(八16)以及受人藐视的税吏并罪人(9～11)。若是祂作审判官，临到这些可怜的人，他们就都会被定罪、被弃绝，没有一个够资格、被选上并蒙呼召，成为属天国度的子民。然而祂来尽职是作医生，医治、恢复、点活并拯救他们，使他们能重新构成祂属天的新公民，给祂用以在这败坏的地上，建立祂属天的国。
footnotes.zh_big5: 屬天國度的王，在祂盡職為著國度呼召人跟從祂的事上，是作醫生，不是作審判官。審判官的審判是按著公義，醫生的醫治是按著憐憫和恩典。那些被祂作成屬天國度子民的人，乃是患痲瘋、（八2～4、）癱瘓、（八5～13，九2～8、）發燒、（八14～15、）鬼附、（八16，28～32、）患各樣疾病的、（八16、）以及受人藐視的稅吏並罪人。（9～11。）若是祂作審判官，臨到這些可憐的人，他們就都會被定罪、被棄絕，沒有一個彀資格、被選上並蒙呼召，成為屬天國度的子民。然而祂來盡職是作醫生，醫治、恢復、點活並拯救他們，使他們能重新構成祂屬天的新公民，給祂用以在這敗壞的地上，建立祂屬天的國。
footnotes.en: 9:12 1 physician In calling people to follow Him for the kingdom, the King of the heavenly kingdom ministered as a Physician, not as a Judge. A judge's judgment is according to righteousness, whereas a physician's healing is according to mercy and grace. Those whom He made people of His heavenly kingdom were lepers (Matt. 8:2-4), paralytics (Matt. 8:5-13; 9:2-8), the fever-ridden (Matt. 8:14-15), the demon possessed (Matt. 8:16, 28-32), those ill with all kinds of diseases (Matt. 8:16), despised tax collectors, and sinners (vv. 9-11). If He had visited these pitiful people as a Judge, all would have been condemned and rejected, and none would have been qualified, selected, and called to be the people of His heavenly kingdom. However, He came to minister as a Physician, to heal, recover, enliven, and save them that they might be reconstituted to be His new and heavenly citizens, with whom He could establish His heavenly kingdom on this corrupted earth.

footnotes.zh: 主这里的话，含示自义的法利赛人，不领会他们需要主作医生。他们认为自己很强健，因此被自义蒙蔽，不晓得自己是有病的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主這裏的話，含示自義的法利賽人，不領會他們需要主作醫生。他們認為自己很強健，因此被自義蒙蔽，不曉得自己是有病的。
footnotes.en: 9:12 2 ill The Lord's word here implies that the self-righteous Pharisees did not realize that they needed Him as a Physician. They considered themselves strong; hence, blinded by their self-righteousness, they did not know that they were ill.

verses.text_gb: 你们去研[Fn1]究，“我[Cra]要的是怜[Fn2]悯，不是祭[Crb]祀，”是什么意思；我来本不是召义[Fn3][Crc]人，乃是召罪[Crd]人。
verses.text_big5: 你們去研[Fn1]究，“我[Cra]要的是憐[Fn2]憫，不是祭[Crb]祀，”是甚麼意思；我來本不是召義[Fn3][Crc]人，乃是召罪[Crd]人。
verses.text_en: But go and learn what this means, "I desire mercy and not sacrifice," for I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们去研究，“我要的是怜悯，不是祭祀，”是什么意思；我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們去研究，“我要的是憐憫，不是祭祀，”是甚麼意思；我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。

footnotes.zh: 自义的法利赛人，自以为知道一切关于神的事。为着使他们谦卑，主告诉他们要多研究。
footnotes.zh_big5: 自義的法利賽人，自以為知道一切關於神的事。為著使他們謙卑，主告訴他們要多研究。
footnotes.en: 9:13 1 learn The self-righteous Pharisees were confident that they knew all things concerning God. In order to humble them, the Lord told them to learn more.

footnotes.zh: 怜悯乃是人从神所领受之恩典的一部分(见来四16注2)。但自义的人宁愿献东西给神，却不肯从神领受怜悯或恩典。这违反了神经纶的法则。神愿意向可怜的罪人施怜悯，照样，祂也要我们凭爱向人施怜悯(弥六6～8，可十二33)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 憐憫乃是人從神所領受之恩典的一部分。（見來四16註2。）但自義的人寧願獻東西給神，卻不肯從神領受憐憫或恩典。這違反了神經綸的法則。神願意向可憐的罪人施憐憫，照樣，祂也要我們憑愛向人施憐憫。（彌六6～8，可十二33。）
footnotes.en: 9:13 2 mercy Mercy is part of the grace that man receives from God. (See note Heb. 4:16 2 .) But self-righteous men do not like to receive mercy or grace from God; they prefer to give something to God. This is contrary to God's way in His economy. Just as God desires to show mercy to pitiful sinners, so He wants us to show mercy in love to others (Micah 6:6-8; Mark 12:33).

footnotes.zh: 没有义人，连一个也没有(罗三10)。所有的义人，都和法利赛人一样，是自以为义的(路十八9)。君尊的救主来，不是召他们，乃是召罪人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 沒有義人，連一個也沒有。（羅三10。）所有的義人，都和法利賽人一樣，是自以為義的。（路十八9。）君尊的救主來，不是召他們，乃是召罪人。
footnotes.en: 9:13 3 righteous There is none righteous, not even one (Rom. 3:10). All the righteous" are self-righteous, as were the Pharisees (Luke 18:9). The kingly Savior did not come to call these, but sinners. "

footnotes.zh: 10～13节，记载主对付老旧宗教里法利赛人的问题。现今，在14～17节，主对付新宗教里约翰门徒的问题。施浸者约翰抛弃旧宗教，在宗教之外的旷野开始他的职事(见三1注2，4注1)。可是过了不久，他的门徒形成了一个新的宗教，阻挠人享受基督，正如老旧宗教的法利赛人所作的。施浸者约翰的职事是把人引到基督，使基督成为他们的救赎主、生命和一切。然而，约翰的门徒中，有些人漂离了他的目标，就是基督，转到一些作法上，使这些作法成了宗教。搞宗教，就是为神作事，却没有基督。即使作合乎圣经，也合乎基要道理的事，若缺少基督的同在，还是宗教。约翰的门徒，新宗教徒，和法利赛人，旧宗教徒，都常常禁食，却没有基督。但他们所定罪基督的门徒，虽然不禁食，却有基督与他们同在，并且活在祂面前。
footnotes.zh_big5: 10～13節，記載主對付老舊宗教裏法利賽人的問題。現今，在14～17節，主對付新宗教裏約翰門徒的問題。施浸者約翰拋棄舊宗教，在宗教之外的曠野開始他的職事。（見三1註2，4註1。）可是過了不久，他的門徒形成了一個新的宗教，阻撓人享受基督，正如老舊宗教的法利賽人所作的。施浸者約翰的職事是把人引到基督，使基督成為他們的救贖主、生命和一切。然而，約翰的門徒中，有些人漂離了他的目標，就是基督，轉到一些作法上，使這些作法成了宗教。搞宗教，就是為神作事，卻沒有基督。即使作合乎聖經，也合乎基要道理的事，若缺少基督的同在，還是宗教。約翰的門徒，新宗教徒，和法利賽人，舊宗教徒，都常常禁食，卻沒有基督。但他們所定罪基督的門徒，雖然不禁食，卻有基督與他們同在，並且活在祂面前。
footnotes.en: 9:14 1 Why Verses Matt. 9:10-13 record the Lord's dealing with the question from the Pharisees, who were of the old religion. Here in vv. 14-17 the Lord dealt with the problem of John's disciples, who were of the new religion. John the Baptist had dropped the old religion and had begun his ministry in the wilderness, outside religion. (See note Matt. 3:1 2 and note Matt. 3:4 1 .) However, after a short time his disciples formed a new religion that frustrated people from enjoying Christ, just as the Pharisees of the old religion had done. John the Baptist's ministry was to introduce people to Christ that Christ might become their Redeemer, their life, and their all. However, some of John's disciples drifted away from his goal, Christ, to some of his practices, and made those practices a religion. To be religious is to do something for God, without Christ. To do anything, even if it is scriptural and fundamental, without the presence of Christ is to be religious. Both John's disciples, who were of the new religion, and the Pharisees, who were of the old religion, fasted much, but without Christ. Meanwhile, they condemned the disciples of Christ, who did not fast but had Christ with them and lived in His presence.

footnotes.zh: 君尊的救主在对付旧宗教里自义并持异议的法利赛人时，指明祂是医生，要医治有病的人(12)。祂在对付新宗教里禁食并持异议的约翰门徒时，启示自己是新郎，要娶新妇。施浸者约翰曾告诉他的门徒说，基督是新郎，要娶新妇(约三25～29)。现在基督，君尊的救主，将这事提醒他们中间的一些人。医生和新郎都是令人喜悦的人。君尊的救主首先医治跟从祂的人，然后使他们成为伴友，至终要使他们成为祂的新妇。他们不仅应当把祂当作医生，好恢复他们的生命，也应当把祂当作新郎，好享受与祂同在的生活。他们乃是与祂同在喜乐的婚礼中，并不是参加没有祂的悲哀葬礼。既是这样，他们怎能在君尊的救主面前禁食而不宴乐？这异议的问题指明，约翰的一些门徒已经落到新宗教里，并且也弃绝了君尊的救主。 约翰的门徒所问的，似乎是道理的问题，但主不以道理，却以一个最令人喜悦的人，新郎，来答复。宗教的人总是注意道理，在道理上问“为什么，”但基督只在意祂自己。跟从主之人的生活、行动，不该由任何道理，只该由主自己和主的同在，来规范并指引。
footnotes.zh_big5: 君尊的救主在對付舊宗教裏自義並持異議的法利賽人時，指明祂是醫生，要醫治有病的人。（12。）祂在對付新宗教裏禁食並持異議的約翰門徒時，啟示自己是新郎，要娶新婦。施浸者約翰曾告訴他的門徒說，基督是新郎，要娶新婦。（約三25～29。）現在基督，君尊的救主，將這事題醒他們中間的一些人。醫生和新郎都是令人喜悅的人。君尊的救主首先醫治跟從祂的人，然後使他們成為伴友，至終要使他們成為祂的新婦。他們不僅應當把祂當作醫生，好恢復他們的生命，也應當把祂當作新郎，好享受與祂同在的生活。他們乃是與祂同在喜樂的婚禮中，並不是參加沒有祂的悲哀葬禮。既是這樣，他們怎能在君尊的救主面前禁食而不宴樂？這異議的問題指明，約翰的一些門徒已經落到新宗教裏，並且也棄絕了君尊的救主。ˍ約翰的門徒所問的，似乎是道理的問題，但主不以道理，卻以一個最令人喜悅的人，新郎，來答覆。宗教的人總是注意道理，在道理上問“為甚麼，”但基督只在意祂自己。跟從主之人的生活、行動，不該由任何道理，只該由主自己和主的同在，來規範並指引。
footnotes.en: 9:15 1 sons The disciples of the Lord. In the transitional period of the Lord's ministry on earth, His disciples were the sons of the bridechamber. Later, they will become the bride (John 3:29; Rev. 19:7).

footnotes.zh: 这些伴友是主的门徒。主在地上尽职事的过渡时期中，祂的门徒是祂的伴友，以后他们要成为祂的新妇(约三29，启十九7)。

footnotes.en: 9:15 2 bridegroom In dealing with the self-righteous and dissenting Pharisees, who were of the old religion, the kingly Savior indicated that He was a Physician who had come to heal the sick (v. 12). In dealing with the fasting and dissenting disciples of John, who were of the new religion, He revealed Himself as the Bridegroom who had come to take the bride. John the Baptist had told his disciples that Christ was the Bridegroom who had come to take the bride (John 3:25-29). Now Christ, the kingly Savior, reminded some of them of this. Both a physician and a bridegroom are pleasant persons. The kingly Savior first healed His followers, and then made them the sons of the bridechamber; eventually, He will make them His bride. They should have laid hold of Him not only as their Physician, that their life might be recovered, but also as their Bridegroom, that they might have the enjoyment of living in His presence. They were with Him at a joyful wedding, not without Him at a mournful funeral. How then could they fast and not feast before Him? The dissenting question from John's disciples indicated that some of them had fallen into a new religion and had rejected the kingly Savior. The question from John's disciples seemed to relate to doctrine. However, the Lord answered not with a doctrine but with a person, the most pleasant person, the Bridegroom. The religious people always care for their doctrine, asking "why" in a doctrinal way. But Christ cares only for Himself. The living and walk of His followers should be regulated and directed only by Himself and His presence, not by any doctrine.

footnotes.zh: 或，新的，生的，未加工的。原文是由“未”和“梳理羊毛”构成，因此，意即未梳理的、未蒸洗的、未作完的、未漂过的、未处理的。未漂过的布，象征从成为肉体到钉十字架之前的基督，如同一块未处理、未作成的新布；路五36的新衣服，乃象征基督，经过了钉十字架的处理，如同一件新衣服(路五36的新，原文与太九17新皮袋的新同)。基督先是未漂过的布，为要作成一件新衣服；然后，祂借着死而复活，就作成了一件新衣服，在神面前作我们的义，遮盖我们，使我们能得神称义，蒙祂悦纳(路十五22，加三27，林前一30)。把未漂过的布补在旧衣服上，所补上的布会因缩水的力量，扯破旧衣服，使裂缝更大。这样作，是效法基督在地上为人生活时所作的。这是今天摩登派的人所尝试的。他们只效法耶稣的为人，以改良他们的行为；他们不相信钉十字架的耶稣是他们的救赎主；也不相信复活的基督是他们的义，使他们可以得神称义、蒙神悦纳。他们效法基督的为人生活，反扯破了他们的旧衣服，就是他们凭着天然旧生命而有的行事为人。国度子民不这样作；他们接受钉十字架、复活的基督作新衣服，在神面前作他们的义遮盖他们。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，新的，生的，未加工的。原文是由“未”和“梳理羊毛”構成，因此，意即未梳理的、未蒸洗的、未作完的、未漂過的、未處理的。未漂過的布，象徵從成為肉體到釘十字架之前的基督，如同一塊未處理、未作成的新布；路五36的新衣服，乃象徵基督，經過了釘十字架的處理，如同一件新衣服。（路五36的新，原文與太九17新皮袋的新同。）基督先是未漂過的布，為要作成一件新衣服；然後，祂藉著死而復活，就作成了一件新衣服，在神面前作我們的義，遮蓋我們，使我們能得神稱義，蒙祂悅納。（路十五22，加三27，林前一30。）把未漂過的布補在舊衣服上，所補上的布會因縮水的力量，扯破舊衣服，使裂縫更大。這樣作，是效法基督在地上為人生活時所作的。這是今天摩登派的人所嘗試的。他們只效法耶穌的為人，以改良他們的行為；他們不相信釘十字架的耶穌是他們的救贖主；也不相信復活的基督是他們的義，使他們可以得神稱義、蒙神悅納。他們效法基督的為人生活，反扯破了他們的舊衣服，就是他們憑著天然舊生命而有的行事為人。國度子民不這樣作；他們接受釘十字架、復活的基督作新衣服，在神面前作他們的義遮蓋他們。
footnotes.en: 9:16 1 unfulled Or, new, raw, unwrought. The Greek word is formed with not and to card or comb wool. Thus, the word means uncarded, unsteamed and unwashed, unfinished, unfulled, untreated. The unfulled cloth signifies Christ from His incarnation to His crucifixion, as a piece of new cloth, untreated, unfinished; whereas the new garment in Luke 5:36 signifies Christ as a new robe after He was "treated" in His crucifixion. (The Greek word for new in Luke 5:36 is the same as for fresh in Matt. 9:17.) Christ first was the unfulled cloth for making a new garment, and then through His death and resurrection was made a new garment to cover us as our righteousness before God that we might be justified by God and be acceptable to Him (Luke 15:22; Gal. 3:27; 1 Cor. 1:30). A patch of unfulled cloth sewn on an old garment pulls away from the garment because of the strength of its shrinking, thus making the tear worse. To sew a patch of unfulled cloth on an old garment means to imitate what Christ did in His human life on earth. This is what today's modernists are attempting to do. They only imitate Jesus' human deeds to improve their behavior; they do not believe in the crucified Jesus as their Redeemer or in the resurrected Christ as their righteousness that they may be justified by God and acceptable to Him. Their imitating of Christ's human living "pulls away" from their "old garment," their behavior produced by their old, natural life. The kingdom people would not do this; they take the crucified and resurrected Christ as their new garment to cover them as their righteousness before God.

footnotes.en: 9:17 1 new The Greek word for new means new in time, recent, newly possessed. The new wine here signifies Christ as the new life, full of vigor, stirring people to excitement. The kingly Savior is not only the Bridegroom to the kingdom people for their enjoyment but also their new garment for them to be equipped outwardly that they may be qualified to attend the wedding. Furthermore, He is their new life to stir them up inwardly to enjoy Him as their Bridegroom. He, as the heavenly King, is the Bridegroom for the kingdom people's enjoyment, and His heavenly kingdom is His wedding feast (Matt. 22:2), at which they will enjoy Him. To enjoy Him as the Bridegroom in the kingdom feast, they need Him as their new garment outwardly and their new wine inwardly.

footnotes.zh: 旧皮袋象征宗教的作法，就如旧宗教的法利赛人，以及新宗教的约翰门徒，所持守的禁食。一切的宗教都是旧皮袋。新酒装在旧皮袋里，由于新酒发酵的力量，会将皮袋胀裂。把新酒装在旧皮袋里，就是把基督这使人振奋的生命，放在任何一种宗教里。这就是今天所谓基要派和灵恩派所实行的，他们企图把基督塞进他们不同模式的宗教仪文、形式和作法里。国度子民绝不该这样作，他们必须把新酒装在新皮袋里。

footnotes.en: 9:17 2 old The old wineskins signify religious practices, such as the fasting maintained by the Pharisees, who were of the old religion, and by the disciples of John, who were of the new religion. All religions are old wineskins. New wine put into old wineskins bursts the wineskins by the power of its fermenting. To put new wine into old wineskins is to put Christ as the exciting life into any kind of religion. This is what the so-called fundamentalists and Pentecostalists are practicing today. They attempt to squeeze Christ into their different modes of religious ritual, formality, and practice. The kingdom people should never do this. They must put the new wine into fresh wineskins.

footnotes.zh: 这里的新，原文指在性质、品质和样式上是新的；不习惯的、未使用的；因此是新的。新皮袋象征地方召会的召会生活，是新酒的容器，这新酒乃是基督自己那使人振奋的生命。国度的子民是建造在召会中(十六18)，召会又是借着他们所活在其中的地方召会得着彰显(十八15～20)。他们是蒙了重生的人，构成基督的身体，成为召会(罗十二5，弗一22～23)。这基督的身体乃是祂的丰满，也称为“那基督，”(林前十二12，直译)，就是团体的基督。个人的基督是新酒，乃是里面使人振奋的生命；团体的基督是新皮袋，乃是外面盛装新酒的容器。对国度子民，不是禁食或任何其他宗教的作法，乃是以基督为内容的召会生活。基督来，不是建立仪式的属地宗教，乃是建立生命的属天国度；不是以任何死的宗教作法，乃是以祂自己这活的人位，作跟从祂之人的救主、医生、新郎、未漂过的布和新酒，作他们完满的享受，使他们能成为祂的新皮袋盛装祂，并成为祂国度的构成分子。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的新，原文指在性質、品質和樣式上是新的；不習慣的、未使用的；因此是新的。新皮袋象徵地方召會的召會生活，是新酒的容器，這新酒乃是基督自己那使人振奮的生命。國度的子民是建造在召會中，（十六18，）召會又是藉著他們所活在其中的地方召會得著彰顯。（十八15～20。）他們是蒙了重生的人，構成基督的身體，成為召會。（羅十二5，弗一22～23。）這基督的身體乃是祂的豐滿，也稱為“那基督，”（林前十二12，直譯，）就是團體的基督。個人的基督是新酒，乃是裏面使人振奮的生命；團體的基督是新皮袋，乃是外面盛裝新酒的容器。對國度子民，不是禁食或任何其他宗教的作法，乃是以基督為內容的召會生活。基督來，不是建立儀式的屬地宗教，乃是建立生命的屬天國度；不是以任何死的宗教作法，乃是以祂自己這活的人位，作跟從祂之人的救主、醫生、新郎、未漂過的布、和新酒，作他們完滿的享受，使他們能成為祂的新皮袋盛裝祂，並成為祂國度的構成分子。
footnotes.en: 9:17 3 fresh The Greek word for fresh means new in nature, quality, or form; unaccustomed, unused; hence, fresh. The fresh wineskins signify the church life in the local churches as the container of the new wine, which is Christ Himself as the exciting life. The kingdom people are built into the church (Matt. 16:18), and the church is expressed through the local churches in which the kingdom people live (Matt. 18:15-20). They are regenerated persons who constitute the Body of Christ and become the church (Rom. 12:5; Eph. 1:22-23). The Body of Christ as His fullness is also called "the Christ" (1 Cor. 12:12), referring to the corporate Christ. The individual Christ is the new wine, the inward exciting life, and the corporate Christ is the fresh wineskin, the outward container that holds the new wine. With the kingdom people it is not a matter of fasting or any other religious practice, but a matter of the church life with Christ as their content. Christ came to establish not an earthly religion of rituals but a heavenly kingdom of life. He is establishing such a kingdom not with any dead religious practices but with Himself, the living person, as the Savior, the Physician, the Bridegroom, the unfulled cloth, and the new wine to His followers for their full enjoyment, that they may be the fresh wineskin to contain Him and may become the constituents of His kingdom.

footnotes.zh: 18～34节描绘一幅今世和来世的简图。因此，本段记载也具有时代的意义，与八1～17一样。管会堂者的女儿代表犹太人，患血漏的女人代表外邦人。女儿死去时，女人得了医治；女人得医治后，女儿就活过来。接着，两个瞎子和一个哑吧都得了医治。这是预表，表示犹太人被砍下时，外邦人便得救；等到外邦人得救的数目添满后，犹太人便要得救(罗十一15，17，19，23～26)。接着，千年国就开始，其中所有的瞎子和哑吧，都要得着医治(赛三五5～6)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 18～34節描繪一幅今世和來世的簡圖。因此，本段記載也具有時代的意義，與八1～17一樣。管會堂者的女兒代表猶太人，患血漏的女人代表外邦人。女兒死去時，女人得了醫治；女人得醫治後，女兒就活過來。接著，兩個瞎子和一個啞吧都得了醫治。這是豫表，表示猶太人被砍下時，外邦人便得救；等到外邦人得救的數目添滿後，猶太人便要得救。（羅十一15，17，19，23～26。）接著，千年國就開始，其中所有的瞎子和啞吧，都要得著醫治。（賽三五5～6。）
footnotes.en: 9:18 1 As Verses Matt. 9:18-34 give a brief picture of this age and the coming age. Hence, the record in this section has a dispensational significance, as did the record in Matt. 8:1-17. The daughter of the ruler of the synagogue represents the Jews, and the woman with the hemorrhage represents the Gentiles. When the daughter died, the woman was healed. After the woman was healed, the daughter was revived. Subsequently, two blind men and one dumb man were healed. This is a type, showing that when the Jews were cut off, the Gentiles were saved, and that after the fullness of the salvation of the Gentiles, the Jews will be saved (Rom. 11:15, 17, 19, 23-26). After that, the millennium will begin, in which all the blind and dumb will be healed (Isa. 35:5-6).

footnotes.zh: 管会堂的名叫睚鲁(可五22，路八41)，意即他要光照，或蒙光照，表征主要光照外邦人(徒十三46～48)，他们犹太人也要蒙光照。

refs.text_en: And they laughed scornfully at Him. But He, putting them all out, took the father of the child and the mother and those with Him and went in to where the child was.

refs.text_gb: 就拉着小孩子的手，对她说，大利大古米！（翻出来就是，闺女，我吩咐你起来！）
refs.text_big5: 就拉著小孩子的手，對她說，大利大古米！（繙出來就是，閨女，我吩咐你起來！）
refs.text_en: And He took hold of the child's hand and said to her, Talitha koum! which being interpreted is, Little girl, to you I say, Arise!

refs.text_gb: 那闺女便立刻起来行走，那时她已经十二岁了。他们立即大大地惊奇。
refs.text_big5: 那閨女便立刻起來行走，那時她已經十二歲了。他們立即大大的驚奇。
refs.text_en: And immediately the little girl rose up and walked about, for she was twelve years old. And immediately, they were amazed with great amazement.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣再三地嘱咐他们，不要叫人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌再三的囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給她東西喫。
refs.text_en: And He strongly commanded them that no one should know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，有一个管会堂的，名叫睚鲁，来俯伏在耶稣脚前，求耶稣进他的家；
refs.text_big5: 看哪，有一個管會堂的，名叫睚魯，來俯伏在耶穌腳前，求耶穌進他的家；
refs.text_en: And behold, a man came whose name was Jairus, and this man was a ruler of the synagogue. And he fell at Jesus' feet and entreated Him to enter into his house,

refs.text_gb: 因他有一个独生女儿，约十二岁，快要死了。耶稣去的时候，群众拥挤祂。
refs.text_big5: 因他有一個獨生女兒，約十二歲，快要死了。耶穌去的時候，群眾擁擠祂。
refs.text_en: Because he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was dying. And as He went, the crowds pressed against Him.

refs.text_gb: 有一个女人，患了十二年血漏，在医生手里花尽了一切养生的，并没有一人能治好她。
refs.text_big5: 有一個女人，患了十二年血漏，在醫生手裏花盡了一切養生的，並沒有一人能治好她。
refs.text_en: And a woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years and who had spent all her livelihood on physicians and yet could not be healed by anyone,

refs.text_gb: 她来到耶稣背后，摸祂的衣服穗子，血漏立刻就止住了。
refs.text_big5: 她來到耶穌背後，摸祂的衣服繸子，血漏立刻就止住了。
refs.text_en: Approached Him from behind and touched the fringe of His garment, and instantly her flow of blood stopped.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，摸我的是谁？众人都不承认。彼得说，夫子，群众都围着你，拥挤你。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，摸我的是誰？眾人都不承認。彼得說，夫子，群眾都圍著你，擁擠你。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said, Who is the one who touched Me? And when all denied it, Peter said, Master, the crowds are pressing and crushing You.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，总有人摸我，因我觉得有能力从我身上出去。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，總有人摸我，因我覺得有能力從我身上出去。
refs.text_en: But Jesus said, Someone touched Me, for I perceived that power had gone out from Me.

refs.text_gb: 那女人知道不能隐藏，就战战兢兢地来俯伏在耶稣跟前，把摸祂的缘故，和怎样立刻得了医治，当着众百姓都说出来。
refs.text_big5: 那女人知道不能隱藏，就戰戰兢兢的來俯伏在耶穌跟前，把摸祂的緣故，和怎樣立刻得了醫治，當著眾百姓都說出來。
refs.text_en: And when the woman saw that she had not escaped notice, she came trembling and fell down before Him and declared before all the people the reason why she had touched Him and how she had been instantly healed.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对她说，女儿，你的信救了你，平平安安地走吧！
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對她說，女兒，你的信救了你，平平安安的走罷！
refs.text_en: And He said to her, Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣还说话的时候，有人从管会堂的家里来，说，你的女儿死了，不必再烦扰夫子了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裏來，說，你的女兒死了，不必再煩擾夫子了。
refs.text_en: While He was still speaking, someone came from the house of the ruler of the synagogue, saying, Your daughter has died; do not trouble the Teacher any longer.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣听见，就对他说，不要怕，只要信，你的女儿就必得拯救。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌聽見，就對他說，不要怕，只要信，你的女兒就必得拯救。
refs.text_en: But Jesus, hearing it, answered him, Do not be afraid-only believe, and she will be healed.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣到了他的家，除了彼得、约翰、雅各和女孩的父母，不许别人同祂进去。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌到了他的家，除了彼得、約翰、雅各和女孩的父母，不許別人同祂進去。
refs.text_en: And He came to the house and did not allow anyone to enter with Him, except Peter and John and James and the father of the child and the mother.

refs.text_gb: 众人都为这女孩哭泣捶胸。耶稣说，不要哭，她不是死了，乃是睡了。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都為這女孩哭泣捶胸。耶穌說，不要哭，她不是死了，乃是睡了。
refs.text_en: And all were weeping and mourning for her; but He said, Do not weep, for she has not died but is sleeping.

refs.text_gb: 他们明知她已经死了，就嗤笑耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 他們明知她已經死了，就嗤笑耶穌。
refs.text_en: And they laughed scornfully at Him, knowing that she had died.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣却拉着她的手，呼叫说，女孩，起来！
refs.text_big5: 耶穌卻拉著她的手，呼叫說，女孩，起來！
refs.text_en: But He took hold of her hand and called out, saying, Child, arise!

refs.text_gb: 她的灵便回来，她就立刻起来了，耶稣吩咐给她东西吃。
refs.text_big5: 她的靈便回來，她就立刻起來了，耶穌吩咐給她東西喫。
refs.text_en: And her spirit returned and she rose up instantly; and He directed that something be given to her to eat.

refs.text_gb: 她的父母就都惊奇，耶稣嘱咐他们，不要把所发生的事告诉人。
refs.text_big5: 她的父母就都驚奇，耶穌囑咐他們，不要把所發生的事告訴人。
refs.text_en: And her parents were amazed, but He charged them to tell no one what had happened.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，有一个患麻风的人前来拜祂，说，主啊，你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，有一個患痲瘋的人前來拜祂，說，主阿，你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。
refs.text_en: And behold, a leper, coming near, worshipped Him, saying, Lord, if You are willing, You can cleanse me.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣便起来，跟着他去，祂的门徒也跟了去。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌便起來，跟著他去，祂的門徒也跟了去。
verses.text_en: And Jesus rose and followed him, and so did His disciples.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣便起来，跟着他去，祂的门徒也跟了去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌便起來，跟著他去，祂的門徒也跟了去。

verses.text_gb: 看哪，有一个女人，患了十[Fn1]二年血[Fn2][Cra]漏，来[Fn3]到耶稣背后，摸祂[Fn4]的衣服穗[Crb]子；
verses.text_big5: 看哪，有一個女人，患了十[Fn1]二年血[Fn2][Cra]漏，來[Fn3]到耶穌背後，摸祂[Fn4]的衣服繸[Crb]子；
verses.text_en: And behold, a woman who had been suffering from a hemorrhage for twelve years approached from behind and touched the fringe of His garment,
verses.text_gb_plain: 看哪，有一个女人，患了十二年血漏，来到耶稣背后，摸祂的衣服穗子；
verses.text_big5_plain: 看哪，有一個女人，患了十二年血漏，來到耶穌背後，摸祂的衣服繸子；

footnotes.zh: 女人病了十二年，十二正是管会堂者死去之女儿的年龄(路八42)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 女人病了十二年，十二正是管會堂者死去之女兒的年齡。（路八42。）
footnotes.en: 9:20 1 hemorrhage A bloody flux, a flow or issue of blood (Lev. 15:25). The life of the flesh is in the blood (Lev. 17:11). Hence, this disease signifies a life that cannot be retained.

footnotes.zh: 不正常的出血、流血或漏血(利十五25)。肉身的生命是在血中(利十七11)；因此，这种疾病表征无法保存的生命。
footnotes.zh_big5: 不正常的出血、流血或漏血。（利十五25。）肉身的生命是在血中；（利十七11；）因此，這種疾病表徵無法保存的生命。
footnotes.en: 9:20 2 twelve The woman had been sick for twelve years, the age of the ruler's dead daughter (Luke 8:42).

footnotes.zh: 这里的女人和八5～10的百夫长，都代表外邦人，他们同样以信来接触主。她在主去管会堂者家的途中得了医治，表征外邦人是在基督前往以色列家的途中得救的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的女人和八5～10的百夫長，都代表外邦人，他們同樣以信來接觸主。她在主去管會堂者家的途中得了醫治，表徵外邦人是在基督前往以色列家的途中得救的。
footnotes.en: 9:20 3 approached The woman here and the centurion in Matt. 8:5-10, both representing the Gentiles, came to contact the Lord in the same way — with faith. The woman was healed while the Lord was on the way to the ruler's house. This signifies that the Gentiles are saved while Christ is on the way to the house of Israel.

footnotes.zh: “祂的衣服，”象征基督的义行；穗子象征属天的管治(民十五38～39)。基督受诸天管治的行为所生出的美德，成了医治的能力(十四36)。
footnotes.zh_big5: “祂的衣服，”象徵基督的義行；繸子象徵屬天的管治。（民十五38～39。）基督受諸天管治的行為所生出的美德，成了醫治的能力。（十四36。）
footnotes.en: 9:20 4 fringe Christ's garment signifies His righteous deeds, and the fringe signifies the heavenly ruling (Num. 15:38-39). Out of Christ's heaven-ruled deeds issues the virtue that becomes the healing power (Matt. 14:36).

refs.text_gb: 女人若在月经污秽期以外患多日的血漏，或是月经污秽期过长，有了漏症，她在血漏不洁净的日子中，与她在月经污秽的日子一样，是不洁净的。
refs.text_big5: 女人若在月經污穢期以外患多日的血漏，或是月經污穢期過長，有了漏症，她在血漏不潔淨的日子中，與她在月經污穢的日子一樣，是不潔淨的。
refs.text_en: And if a woman has a discharge of her blood for many days not at the time of her impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her impurity, during all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness she shall be as if in the days of her impurity; she is unclean.

refs.text_gb: 求祂让他们只摸祂的衣服穗子，凡摸着的，都完全得了拯救。
refs.text_big5: 求祂讓他們只摸祂的衣服繸子，凡摸著的，都完全得了拯救。
refs.text_en: And they begged Him that they might only touch the fringe of His garment. And as many as touched were completely healed.

refs.text_gb: 你要告诉以色列人，叫他们世世代代在衣服边上作穗子，又在衣边的穗子上钉一根蓝细带子。
refs.text_big5: 你要告訴以色列人，叫他們世世代代在衣服邊上作繸子，又在衣邊的繸子上釘一根藍細帶子。
refs.text_en: Speak to the children of Israel and tell them to make for themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations and to put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

refs.text_gb: 这穗子是要叫你们一看见，就记念并遵行耶和华一切的命令，不随从自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你们素常一样；
refs.text_big5: 這繸子是要叫你們一看見，就記念並遵行耶和華一切的命令，不隨從自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你們素常一樣；
refs.text_en: And it shall be a fringe for you, so that when you see it you will remember all the commandments of Jehovah and do them, so that you do not seek after your own heart and your own eyes, according to which you committed fornication;

refs.text_gb: 你要在所披的衣服上四角作穗子。
refs.text_big5: 你要在所披的衣服上四角作繸子。
refs.text_en: You shall make twisted cords upon the four corners of your garment with which you cover yourself.

verses.text_gb: 因为她心里说，我只要摸[Cra]着祂的衣服，就必[Fn1]得拯救。
verses.text_big5: 因為她心裏說，我只要摸[Cra]著祂的衣服，就必[Fn1]得拯救。
verses.text_en: For she said within herself, If only I touch His garment, I will be healed.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为她心里说，我只要摸着祂的衣服，就必得拯救。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為她心裏說，我只要摸著祂的衣服，就必得拯救。

footnotes.zh: 这是她的信。拯救，或，康复。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是她的信。拯救，或，康復。
footnotes.en: 9:21 1 I This was her faith.

refs.text_gb: 求祂让他们只摸祂的衣服穗子，凡摸着的，都完全得了拯救。
refs.text_big5: 求祂讓他們只摸祂的衣服繸子，凡摸著的，都完全得了拯救。
refs.text_en: And they begged Him that they might only touch the fringe of His garment. And as many as touched were completely healed.

refs.text_gb: 因为祂治好了许多人，以致凡有灾病的，都挤过来要摸祂。
refs.text_big5: 因為祂治好了許多人，以致凡有災病的，都擠過來要摸祂。
refs.text_en: For He healed many, so that as many as had afflictions pressed toward Him to touch Him.

refs.text_gb: 群众都想要摸祂，因为有能力从祂身上发出来，医治了众人。
refs.text_big5: 群眾都想要摸祂，因為有能力從祂身上發出來，醫治了眾人。
refs.text_en: And all the crowd sought to touch Him, because power was going out from Him and healing all.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣转过来，看见她，就说，女儿，放[Fn1][Cra]心，你的信[Crb]救了你。从那时候，那女人就得了拯救。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌轉過來，看見她，就說，女兒，放[Fn1][Cra]心，你的信[Crb]救了你。從那時候，那女人就得了拯救。
verses.text_en: And Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, Take courage, daughter; your faith has healed you. And the woman was healed from that hour.

footnotes.zh: 这里的闺女和八14～15彼得的岳母，都代表这世代末了的犹太人，他们因着主的来临和祂直接的摸，在家里得了医治。这指明在这世代的末了，所有的犹太遗民都要因着主的来临和祂直接的摸，在以色列家中得救(罗十一25～26，亚十二10)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的閨女和八14～15彼得的岳母，都代表這世代末了的猶太人，他們因著主的來臨和祂直接的摸，在家裏得了醫治。這指明在這世代的末了，所有的猶太遺民都要因著主的來臨和祂直接的摸，在以色列家中得救。（羅十一25～26，亞十二10。）
