refs.text_en: But He, knowing their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself becomes desolate, and a house divided against a house falls.

refs.text_gb: 若撒但自相分争，他的国怎能站住？因为你们说我是靠着别西卜赶鬼。
refs.text_big5: 若撒但自相分爭，他的國怎能站住？因為你們說我是靠著別西卜趕鬼。
refs.text_en: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? For you say that it is by Beelzebul that I cast out the demons.

refs.text_gb: 我若是靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟又是靠谁赶呢？这样，他们就要审判你们了。
refs.text_big5: 我若是靠著別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟又是靠誰趕呢？這樣，他們就要審判你們了。
refs.text_en: But if I by Beelzebul cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they shall be your judges.

refs.text_gb: 我若靠着神的指头赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。
refs.text_big5: 我若靠著神的指頭趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們了。
refs.text_en: But if I by the finger of God cast out the demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

refs.text_gb: 壮者全副武装，看守自己住宅的时候，他的家业就平安无事。
refs.text_big5: 壯者全副武裝，看守自己住宅的時候，他的家業就平安無事。
refs.text_en: When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own homestead, his possessions are in peace.

refs.text_gb: 但有一个比他更壮的来，胜过他，就夺去他所倚靠的全副军装，又分了他的掳物。
refs.text_big5: 但有一個比他更壯的來，勝過他，就奪去他所倚靠的全副軍裝，又分了他的擄物。
refs.text_en: But when one stronger than he comes upon him and overcomes him, he takes away his whole armor in which he had trusted and distributes his spoil.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就说，你们为什么心里思念恶事？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就說，你們為甚麼心裏思念惡事？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, Why are you thinking evil things in your hearts?

verses.text_gb: 若撒但赶逐撒但，他就自相分争，他的国[Fn1][Cra]怎能站住？
verses.text_big5: 若撒但趕逐撒但，他就自相分爭，他的國[Fn1][Cra]怎能站住？
verses.text_en: And if Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
verses.text_gb_plain: 若撒但赶逐撒但，他就自相分争，他的国怎能站住？
verses.text_big5_plain: 若撒但趕逐撒但，他就自相分爭，他的國怎能站住？

footnotes.zh: 撒但是这世界的王(约十二31)，也是空中掌权者的首领(弗二2)。他有他的权势(徒二六18)和他的使者(二五41)，就是他的从属，是这黑暗世界的执政者、掌权者和管辖者(弗六12)。因此，他有他的国，就是黑暗的权势(西一13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 撒但是這世界的王，（約十二31，）也是空中掌權者的首領。（弗二2。）他有他的權勢（徒二六18）和他的使者，（二五41，）就是他的從屬，是這黑暗世界的執政者、掌權者和管轄者。（弗六12。）因此，他有他的國，就是黑暗的權勢。（西一13。）
footnotes.en: 12:26 1 kingdom Satan is the ruler of this world (John 12:31) and the ruler of the authority of the air (Eph. 2:2). He has his authority (Acts 26:18) and his angels (Matt. 25:41), who are his subordinates as rulers, authorities, and world-rulers of the darkness of this world (Eph. 6:12). Hence, he has his kingdom, the authority of darkness (Col. 1:13).

refs.text_gb: 那时，你们在其中行事为人，随着这世界的世代，顺着空中掌权者的首领，就是那现今在悖逆之子里面运行之灵的首领；
refs.text_big5: 那時，你們在其中行事為人，隨著這世界的世代，順著空中掌權者的首領，就是那現今在悖逆之子裏面運行之靈的首領；
refs.text_en: In which you once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit which is now operating in the sons of disobedience;

refs.text_gb: 因我们并不是与血肉之人摔跤，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这黑暗世界的、以及诸天界里那邪恶的属灵势力摔跤。
refs.text_big5: 因我們並不是與血肉之人摔跤，乃是與那些執政的、掌權的、管轄這黑暗世界的、以及諸天界裏那邪惡的屬靈勢力摔跤。
refs.text_en: For our wrestling is not against blood and flesh but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenlies.

refs.text_gb: 祂拯救了我们脱离黑暗的权势，把我们迁入祂爱子的国里；
refs.text_big5: 祂拯救了我們脫離黑暗的權勢，把我們遷入祂愛子的國裏；
refs.text_en: Who delivered us out of the authority of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of the Son of His love,

verses.text_gb: 我若是靠着别[Cra]西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟又是靠着谁赶[Crb]呢？这样，他们就要审判你们了。
verses.text_big5: 我若是靠著別[Cra]西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟又是靠著誰趕[Crb]呢？這樣，他們就要審判你們了。
verses.text_en: And if I, by Beelzebul, cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我若是靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟又是靠着谁赶呢？这样，他们就要审判你们了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我若是靠著別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟又是靠著誰趕呢？這樣，他們就要審判你們了。

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人听见了，却说，这个人赶鬼，无非是靠着鬼王别西卜。
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人聽見了，卻說，這個人趕鬼，無非是靠著鬼王別西卜。
refs.text_en: But the Pharisees, hearing this, said, This man does not cast out the demons except by Beelzebul, ruler of the demons.

refs.text_gb: 那时，有几个游行各处，念咒赶鬼的犹太人，向那被恶灵附着的人，擅自称主耶稣的名，说，我靠保罗所传扬的耶稣，敕令你们出来。
refs.text_big5: 那時，有幾個遊行各處，念咒趕鬼的猶太人，向那被惡靈附著的人，擅自稱主耶穌的名，說，我靠保羅所傳揚的耶穌，敕令你們出來。
refs.text_en: But some of the Jewish exorcists who also went about took it upon themselves to name over those who had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, I adjure you by the Jesus whom Paul preaches.

refs.text_gb: 作这事的，有犹太祭司长士基瓦的七个儿子。
refs.text_big5: 作這事的，有猶太祭司長士基瓦的七個兒子。
refs.text_en: And there were seven sons of a certain Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, doing this.

verses.text_gb: 我若靠着神[Fn1]的灵[Cra]赶鬼，这就是神[Fn2][Crb]的国临到你们了。
verses.text_big5: 我若靠著神[Fn1]的靈[Cra]趕鬼，這就是神[Fn2][Crb]的國臨到你們了。
verses.text_en: But if I, by the Spirit of God, cast out the demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我若靠着神的灵赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我若靠著神的靈趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們了。

footnotes.zh: 神的灵乃是神国的能力。神的灵在那里掌权，那里就有神的国，并且那里鬼就没有地位。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神的靈乃是神國的能力。神的靈在那裏掌權，那裏就有神的國，並且那裏鬼就沒有地位。
footnotes.en: 12:28 1 Spirit The Spirit of God is the power of the kingdom of God. Where the Spirit of God is in power, there the kingdom of God is, and there the demons have no ground.

footnotes.zh: 这里是神的国，不是诸天的国。甚至到这时，诸天的国还没有来到。然而，神的国已经在那里了。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏是神的國，不是諸天的國。甚至到這時，諸天的國還沒有來到。然而，神的國已經在那裏了。
footnotes.en: 12:28 2 kingdom The kingdom of God, not the kingdom of the heavens, is indicated here. Even at that time the kingdom of the heavens still had not come. The kingdom of God, however, was there already.

refs.text_gb: “看哪，我的仆人，我所拣选，我所爱，我魂所喜悦的；我要将我的灵放在祂身上，祂必将公理宣布与外邦。
refs.text_big5: “看哪，我的僕人，我所揀選，我所愛，我魂所喜悅的；我要將我的靈放在祂身上，祂必將公理宣佈與外邦。
refs.text_en: "Behold, My Servant whom I have chosen, My Beloved in whom My soul has found delight. I will put My Spirit upon Him, and He will announce justice to the Gentiles.

refs.text_gb: 就是神怎样以圣灵和能力膏拿撒勒人耶稣，祂周游各处行善事，医好凡被魔鬼压制的人，因为神与祂同在。
refs.text_big5: 就是神怎樣以聖靈和能力膏拿撒勒人耶穌，祂周遊各處行善事，醫好凡被魔鬼壓制的人，因為神與祂同在。
refs.text_en: Jesus, the One from Nazareth, how God anointed Him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all those who were being oppressed by the devil, for God was with Him.

refs.text_gb: 我又告诉你们，骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进神的国还容易。
refs.text_big5: 我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過鍼的眼，比財主進神的國還容易。
refs.text_en: And again I say to you, It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 两个当中，哪一个完成了父亲的心意？他们说，大的。耶稣对他们说，我实在告诉你们，税吏和娼妓要在你们以前进神的国。
refs.text_big5: 兩個當中，那一個完成了父親的心意？他們說，大的。耶穌對他們說，我實在告訴你們，稅吏和娼妓要在你們以前進神的國。
refs.text_en: Which of the two did the will of the father? They said, The first. Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that the tax collectors and the harlots are going into the kingdom of God before you.

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，神的国必从你们夺去，赐给那能结果子的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，神的國必從你們奪去，賜給那能結果子的百姓。
refs.text_en: Therefore I say to you that the kingdom of God shall be taken from you and shall be given to a nation producing its fruit.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人问神的国几时来到，耶稣回答说，神的国来到，不是观察得到的；
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人問神的國幾時來到，耶穌回答說，神的國來到，不是觀察得到的；
refs.text_en: And when He was questioned by the Pharisees as to when the kingdom of God was coming, He answered them and said, The kingdom of God does not come with observation;

refs.text_gb: 人也不得说，看哪，在这里，或说，在那里；因为看哪，神的国就在你们中间。
refs.text_big5: 人也不得說，看哪，在這裏，或說，在那裏；因為看哪，神的國就在你們中間。
refs.text_en: Nor will they say, Behold, here it is! or, There! For behold, the kingdom of God is in the midst of you.

verses.text_gb: 人怎能进壮[Fn1]者家[Fn2]里，抢[Cra]夺他的家[Fn3]具？除非先捆[Fn4]绑那壮者，才能洗劫他的家。
verses.text_big5: 人怎能進壯[Fn1]者家[Fn2]裏，搶[Cra]奪他的家[Fn3]具？除非先捆[Fn4]綁那壯者，纔能洗劫他的家。
verses.text_en: Or how can anyone enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods unless he first binds the strong man? And then he will thoroughly plunder his house.
verses.text_gb_plain: 人怎能进壮者家里，抢夺他的家具？除非先捆绑那壮者，才能洗劫他的家。
verses.text_big5_plain: 人怎能進壯者家裏，搶奪他的家具？除非先捆綁那壯者，纔能洗劫他的家。

footnotes.zh: 壮者就是那恶者撒但。
footnotes.zh_big5: 壯者就是那惡者撒但。
footnotes.en: 12:29 1 house The house here signifies the kingdom of Satan.

footnotes.zh: 这里的家表征撒但的国。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的家表徵撒但的國。
footnotes.en: 12:29 2 strong The strong man is Satan, the evil one.

footnotes.zh: 或，工具，器具。因此是货品、物品。堕落的人在撒但的辖制之下，乃是供他使用的器皿、工具。他们是他的货物，存在他的家、他的国里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，工具，器具。因此是貨品、物品。墮落的人在撒但的轄制之下，乃是供他使用的器皿、工具。他們是他的貨物，存在他的家、他的國裏。
footnotes.en: 12:29 3 goods Or, instruments, apparatus; hence, goods, stuff. The fallen people, who are under Satan, are his vessels, his instruments, and are for his use. They are his goods, kept in his house, his kingdom.

footnotes.zh: 这指明主赶鬼时，先捆绑撒但。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明主趕鬼時，先捆綁撒但。
footnotes.en: 12:29 4 binds This indicates that when the Lord cast out demons, He first bound Satan.

refs.text_gb: 壮者抢去的岂能夺回？理当掳掠的岂能解救么？
refs.text_big5: 壯者搶去的豈能奪回？理當擄掠的豈能解救麼？
refs.text_en: Can the booty be taken from the strong man, / Or the lawful captives be delivered?

refs.text_gb: 耶和华实在如此说，就是壮者所掳掠的，也可以夺回，强暴人所抢的，也可以解救；因为与你相争的，我必与他相争，我要拯救你的儿女；
refs.text_big5: 耶和華實在如此說，就是壯者所擄掠的，也可以奪回，強暴人所搶的，也可以解救；因為與你相爭的，我必與他相爭，我要拯救你的兒女；
refs.text_en: Surely, thus says Jehovah, / Even the captive may be taken from the strong man, / And the booty may be released from the tyrant; / For I will strive with those who strive with you, / And I will save your children;

verses.text_gb: 不[Fn1]与我相合的，就是敌[Cra]我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
verses.text_big5: 不[Fn1]與我相合的，就是敵[Cra]我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
verses.text_en: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。

footnotes.zh: 见可九40注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見可九40註1。
footnotes.en: 12:30 1 He See note Mark 9:40 1 .

refs.text_gb: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
refs.text_big5: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
refs.text_en: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

refs.text_gb: 不抵挡我们的，就是帮助我们的。
refs.text_big5: 不抵擋我們的，就是幫助我們的。
refs.text_en: For he who is not against us is for us.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，不要禁止他；因为不抵挡你们的，就是帮助你们的。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，不要禁止他；因為不抵擋你們的，就是幫助你們的。
refs.text_en: But Jesus said to him, Do not forbid him, for he who is not against you is for you.

verses.text_gb: 所[Cra]以我告诉你们，人一切的罪和亵[Crb]渎，都能得赦免；唯独亵[Fn1]渎那灵，不能得赦免。
verses.text_big5: 所[Cra]以我告訴你們，人一切的罪和褻[Crb]瀆，都能得赦免；惟獨褻[Fn1]瀆那靈，不能得赦免。
verses.text_en: Therefore I say to you, Every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以我告诉你们，人一切的罪和亵渎，都能得赦免；唯独亵渎那灵，不能得赦免。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以我告訴你們，人一切的罪和褻瀆，都能得赦免；惟獨褻瀆那靈，不能得赦免。

footnotes.zh: 亵渎那灵和亵慢那灵(来十29)不同。亵慢那灵是故意不顺从祂，许多信徒都是这样。他们若认这罪，就必得着赦免，并蒙主的血洗净(约壹一7，9)。但亵渎那灵乃是毁谤祂，如法利赛人在24节所作的。主靠着那灵赶鬼，法利赛人看见，却说主是靠着鬼王别西卜赶鬼，这就是亵渎那灵。因着这样的亵渎，法利赛人弃绝属天的王达到极峰。
footnotes.zh_big5: 褻瀆那靈和褻慢那靈（來十29）不同。褻慢那靈是故意不順從祂，許多信徒都是這樣。他們若認這罪，就必得著赦免，並蒙主的血洗淨。（約壹一7，9。）但褻瀆那靈乃是毀謗祂，如法利賽人在24節所作的。主靠著那靈趕鬼，法利賽人看見，卻說主是靠著鬼王別西卜趕鬼，這就是褻瀆那靈。因著這樣的褻瀆，法利賽人棄絕屬天的王達到極峰。
footnotes.en: 12:31 1 blasphemy Blaspheming the Spirit differs from insulting the Spirit (Heb. 10:29). To insult the Spirit is to disobey Him willfully. Many believers do this. If they confess this sin, they will be forgiven and cleansed by the Lord's blood (1 John 1:7, 9). But to blaspheme the Spirit is to slander Him, as the Pharisees did in v. 24. It was by the Spirit that the Lord cast out a demon. But the Pharisees, seeing it, said that the Lord cast out demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons. This was blasphemy against the Spirit. By such blasphemy the Pharisees' rejection of the heavenly King reached its climax.

refs.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，人一切的罪和亵渎，无论是亵渎什么，都能得赦免；
refs.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，人一切的罪和褻瀆，無論是褻瀆甚麼，都能得赦免；
refs.text_en: Truly I say to you that all sins will be forgiven the sons of men, and whatever blasphemies they blaspheme,

refs.text_gb: 但无论谁亵渎圣灵，却永不得赦免，乃要担当永远的罪。
refs.text_big5: 但無論誰褻瀆聖靈，卻永不得赦免，乃要擔當永遠的罪。
refs.text_en: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit has no forgiveness forever, but is guilty of an everlasting sin.

refs.text_gb: 这话是因为他们说，祂有污灵附着。
refs.text_big5: 這話是因為他們說，祂有污靈附著。
refs.text_en: He said this because they said, He has an unclean spirit.

refs.text_gb: 凡说话抵挡人子的，还能得赦免；唯独亵渎圣灵的，不能得赦免。
refs.text_big5: 凡說話抵擋人子的，還能得赦免；惟獨褻瀆聖靈的，不能得赦免。
refs.text_en: And everyone who will say a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven.

refs.text_gb: 我从前是亵渎神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了怜悯，因我是在不信中，无知而作的。
refs.text_big5: 我從前是褻瀆神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了憐憫，因我是在不信中，無知而作的。
refs.text_en: Who formerly was a blasphemer and a persecutor and an insulting person; but I was shown mercy because, being ignorant, I acted in unbelief.

verses.text_gb: 并且无论谁说话抵挡人子，他都能得赦免；但无论谁说[Fn1]话抵挡圣灵，无论在今世[Fn2][Cra]，或是在来世，他都[Crb]不能得赦免。
verses.text_big5: 並且無論誰說話抵擋人子，他都能得赦免；但無論誰說[Fn1]話抵擋聖靈，無論在今世[Fn2][Cra]，或是在來世，他都[Crb]不能得赦免。
verses.text_en: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age nor in the one to come.
verses.text_gb_plain: 并且无论谁说话抵挡人子，他都能得赦免；但无论谁说话抵挡圣灵，无论在今世，或是在来世，他都不能得赦免。
verses.text_big5_plain: 並且無論誰說話抵擋人子，他都能得赦免；但無論誰說話抵擋聖靈，無論在今世，或是在來世，他都不能得赦免。

footnotes.zh: 在三一神的经纶里，父构想祂救赎的计划(弗一5，9)，子按照父的计划完成救赎(彼前二24，加一4)，那灵临到罪人，实施子所完成的救赎(林前六11，彼前一2)。倘若罪人亵渎子，像大数的扫罗一样，那灵还有地位在他身上作工，使他悔改、相信子，好得着赦免(见提前一13～16)。但罪人若亵渎那灵，那灵就没有地位在他身上作工，也就没有什么能使他悔改相信了。因此，这样的人不可能得着赦免。这不仅按理由说是合乎逻辑的，就是按神行政的原则说，也是合乎管治的，正如主的话在这里所启示的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在三一神的經綸裏，父構想祂救贖的計畫，（弗一5，9，）子按照父的計畫完成救贖，（彼前二24，加一4，）那靈臨到罪人，實施子所完成的救贖。（林前六11，彼前一2。）倘若罪人褻瀆子，像大數的掃羅一樣，那靈還有地位在他身上作工，使他悔改、相信子，好得著赦免。（見提前一13～16。）但罪人若褻瀆那靈，那靈就沒有地位在他身上作工，也就沒有甚麼能使他悔改相信了。因此，這樣的人不可能得著赦免。這不僅按理由說是合乎邏輯的，就是按神行政的原則說，也是合乎管治的，正如主的話在這裏所啟示的。
footnotes.en: 12:32 1 speaks In the economy of the Triune God, the Father conceived the plan of redemption (Eph. 1:5, 9), the Son accomplished redemption according to the Father's plan (1 Pet. 2:24; Gal. 1:4), and the Spirit reaches sinners to apply the redemption accomplished by the Son (1 Cor. 6:11; 1 Pet. 1:2). If a sinner blasphemes the Son, as Saul of Tarsus did, the Spirit will still have the ground to work on him and cause him to repent and believe in the Son that he may be forgiven (see 1 Tim. 1:13-16). But if a sinner blasphemes the Spirit, the Spirit will have no ground to work on him, and there will be no one left to cause him to repent and believe. Hence, it is impossible for such a person to be forgiven. This is not only logical according to reason but also governmental according to God's administrative principle, as revealed here by the Lord's word.

footnotes.zh: 在神管治的行政里，祂的赦免是有时代讲究的。为着祂的行政，祂计划了不同的世代。从基督第一次来一直到永世的这段时期，在时代上分为三个世代：(一)今世，现今的世代，从基督第一次来，到祂再来；(二)来世，千年国，就是复兴和属天管治的一千年，从基督再来，到旧天旧地结束；(三)永世，新天新地的永远世代。神在今世的赦免，是为了罪人永远的得救。这赦免是给罪人，也是给信徒的。神在来世的赦免，与信徒时代的赏赐有关。倘若信徒得救后犯了罪，不肯在他死前或主回来前，借着认罪和主血的洗净(约壹一7，9)，清楚对付，这罪在今世就不得赦免，乃要留到基督的审判台前受审判(林后五10)。他不能得着国度为赏赐，不能在诸天的国实现时，与基督一同有分于荣耀和喜乐，却要受管教，以清除这罪，而在来世得着赦免(十八23～35)。这种赦免要保持他永远的救恩。但不会使他够资格有分于要来国度的荣耀和喜乐。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在神管治的行政裏，祂的赦免是有時代講究的。為著祂的行政，祂計畫了不同的世代。從基督第一次來一直到永世的這段時期，在時代上分為三個世代：(一)今世，現今的世代，從基督第一次來，到祂再來；(二)來世，千年國，就是復興和屬天管治的一千年，從基督再來，到舊天舊地結束；(三)永世，新天新地的永遠世代。神在今世的赦免，是為了罪人永遠的得救。這赦免是給罪人，也是給信徒的。神在來世的赦免，與信徒時代的賞賜有關。倘若信徒得救後犯了罪，不肯在他死前或主回來前，藉著認罪和主血的洗淨，（約壹一7，9，）清楚對付，這罪在今世就不得赦免，乃要留到基督的審判臺前受審判。（林後五10。）他不能得著國度為賞賜，不能在諸天的國實現時，與基督一同有分於榮耀和喜樂，卻要受管教，以清除這罪，而在來世得著赦免。（十八23～35。）這種赦免要保持他永遠的救恩。但不會使他彀資格有分於要來國度的榮耀和喜樂。
footnotes.en: 12:32 2 age In God's governmental administration His forgiveness is dispensational. For His administration He has planned different ages. The period from the first coming of Christ to eternity is divided dispensationally into three ages: 1) this age, the present one, from Christ's first coming to His second coming; 2) the coming age, the millennium, the one thousand years for restoration and heavenly reigning, from Christ's second coming to the end of the old heaven and old earth; 3) eternity, the eternal age of the new heaven and new earth. God's forgiveness in this age is for sinners' eternal salvation. This forgiveness is given to both sinners and believers. God's forgiveness in the coming age is related to the believers' dispensational reward. If after being saved a believer commits a sin but will not make a clearance through confession and the cleansing of the Lord's blood (1 John 1:7, 9) before he dies or the Lord comes back, the sin will not be forgiven in this age but will remain and will be judged at the judgment seat of Christ (2 Cor. 5:10). In such a case, the believer will not be rewarded with the kingdom, i.e., will not participate with Christ in the glory and joy in the manifestation of the kingdom of the heavens, but will be disciplined so that the sin is cleared, and will be forgiven in the coming age (Matt. 18:23-35). This kind of forgiveness will maintain this believer's eternal salvation but will not qualify him to participate in the glory and joy of the coming kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 没有不在今世得百倍，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母亲、儿女和田地，同各样的逼迫，且要在来世得永远生命的。
refs.text_big5: 沒有不在今世得百倍，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母親、兒女和田地，同各樣的逼迫，且要在來世得永遠生命的。
refs.text_en: But that he shall receive a hundred times as much now at this time, houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, with persecutions, and in the coming age, eternal life.

refs.text_gb: 远超过一切执政的、掌权的、有能的、主治的、以及一切受称之名，不但是今世的，连来世的也都在内，
refs.text_big5: 遠超過一切執政的、掌權的、有能的、主治的、以及一切受稱之名，不但是今世的，連來世的也都在內，
refs.text_en: Far above all rule and authority and power and lordship and every name that is named not only in this age but also in that which is to come;

refs.text_gb: 人若看见他的弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，就当为他祈求，将生命赐给他，就是给那些犯了不至于死之罪的。有至于死的罪，我不说当为那罪祈求。
refs.text_big5: 人若看見他的弟兄犯了不至於死的罪，就當為他祈求，將生命賜給他，就是給那些犯了不至於死之罪的。有至於死的罪，我不說當為那罪祈求。
refs.text_en: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask and he will give life to him, to those sinning not unto death. There is a sin unto death; I do not say that he should make request concerning that.

verses.text_gb: 或说树好，果[Cra]子就好；或说树坏，果子也坏；树总是凭[Fn1]果子认出来的。
verses.text_big5: 或說樹好，果[Cra]子就好；或說樹壞，果子也壞；樹總是憑[Fn1]果子認出來的。
verses.text_en: Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for by the fruit the tree is known.
verses.text_gb_plain: 或说树好，果子就好；或说树坏，果子也坏；树总是凭果子认出来的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 或說樹好，果子就好；或說樹壞，果子也壞；樹總是憑果子認出來的。

footnotes.zh: 直译，由。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，由。
footnotes.en: 12:33 1 by Lit., from.

refs.text_gb: 从他们的果子，你们就可以认出他们来。人岂能从荆棘收取葡萄？或从蒺藜收取无花果？
refs.text_big5: 從他們的果子，你們就可以認出他們來。人豈能從荊棘收取葡萄？或從蒺藜收取無花果？
refs.text_en: By their fruits you will recognize them. Do men gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?

refs.text_gb: 这样，凡是好树都结善果，唯独坏树才结恶果。
refs.text_big5: 這樣，凡是好樹都結善果，惟獨壞樹纔結惡果。
refs.text_en: Even so every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces bad fruit.

refs.text_gb: 好树不能结恶果，坏树也不能结善果。
refs.text_big5: 好樹不能結惡果，壞樹也不能結善果。
refs.text_en: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

refs.text_gb: 凡不结善果的树，就砍下来，丢在火里。
refs.text_big5: 凡不結善果的樹，就砍下來，丟在火裏。
refs.text_en: Every tree that does not produce good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

refs.text_gb: 所以，从他们的果子，你们就可以认出他们来。
refs.text_big5: 所以，從他們的果子，你們就可以認出他們來。
refs.text_en: So then, by their fruits you will recognize them.

refs.text_gb: 因为没有好树结坏果子，也没有坏树结好果子。
refs.text_big5: 因為沒有好樹結壞果子，也沒有壞樹結好果子。
refs.text_en: For there is no good tree that produces corrupt fruit, nor again a corrupt tree that produces good fruit.

refs.text_gb: 每一棵树都是凭自己的果子认出来的。人不是从荆棘收取无花果，也不是从蒺藜收采葡萄。
refs.text_big5: 每一棵樹都是憑自己的果子認出來的。人不是從荊棘收取無花果，也不是從蒺藜收採葡萄。
refs.text_en: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For men do not collect figs from thorns, nor do they pick grapes from a thornbush.

verses.text_gb: 毒[Cra]蛇之种，你们既是恶的，怎能说出善来？因为心[Crb]里所充满的，口里就说出来。
verses.text_big5: 毒[Cra]蛇之種，你們既是惡的，怎能說出善來？因為心[Crb]裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。
verses.text_en: Offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
verses.text_gb_plain: 毒蛇之种，你们既是恶的，怎能说出善来？因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 毒蛇之種，你們既是惡的，怎能說出善來？因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。

refs.text_gb: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人，来受他的浸，就对他们说，毒蛇之种，谁指示你们逃避要来的忿怒？
refs.text_big5: 約翰看見許多法利賽人和撒都該人，來受他的浸，就對他們說，毒蛇之種，誰指示你們逃避要來的忿怒？
refs.text_en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, Offspring of vipers, who prompted you to flee from the coming wrath?

refs.text_gb: 蛇类，毒蛇之种，你们怎能逃避火坑的审判？
refs.text_big5: 蛇類，毒蛇之種，你們怎能逃避火坑的審判？
refs.text_en: Serpents! Brood of vipers! How shall you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

refs.text_gb: 唯独出口的，是从心里发出来的，那才污秽人。
refs.text_big5: 惟獨出口的，是從心裏發出來的，那纔污穢人。
refs.text_en: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and those defile the man.

refs.text_gb: 因为从心里发出恶念、凶杀、奸淫、淫乱、偷窃、假见证和谤讟，
refs.text_big5: 因為從心裏發出惡念、兇殺、姦淫、淫亂、偷竊、假見證和謗讟，
refs.text_en: For out of the heart come evil reasonings, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witnessings, blasphemies.

refs.text_gb: 善人从他心里所存的善，发出善来；恶人从他心里所存的恶，发出恶来；因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。
refs.text_big5: 善人從他心裏所存的善，發出善來；惡人從他心裏所存的惡，發出惡來；因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。
refs.text_en: The good man, out of the good treasure of his heart, brings forth that which is good, and the evil man, out of the evil treasure of his heart, brings forth that which is evil; for out of the abundance of his heart his mouth speaks.

verses.text_gb: 善人从他所存的善，发出善来；恶人从他所存的恶，发出恶来。
verses.text_big5: 善人從他所存的善，發出善來；惡人從他所存的惡，發出惡來。
verses.text_en: The good man, out of his good treasure, brings forth good things, and the evil man, out of his evil treasure, brings forth evil things.
verses.text_gb_plain: 善人从他所存的善，发出善来；恶人从他所存的恶，发出恶来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 善人從他所存的善，發出善來；惡人從他所存的惡，發出惡來。

verses.text_gb: 我还告诉你们，人所说的每句闲[Fn1]话，在审[Cra]判的日子，都必须供[Fn2][Crb]出来。
verses.text_big5: 我還告訴你們，人所說的每句閒[Fn1]話，在審[Cra]判的日子，都必須供[Fn2][Crb]出來。
verses.text_en: And I say to you that every idle word which men shall speak, they will render an account concerning it in the day of judgment.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我还告诉你们，人所说的每句闲话，在审判的日子，都必须供出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我還告訴你們，人所說的每句閒話，在審判的日子，都必須供出來。

footnotes.zh: 原文意不工作。闲话就是没有作用、无效的话，是没有积极功用的、无用的、无益的、不结果的、不生育的。说这种话的人，在审判的日子，必须把所说的都供出来。既是这样，我们恶毒的话岂不更要句句供出来！
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文意不工作。閒話就是沒有作用、無效的話，是沒有積極功用的、無用的、無益的、不結果的、不生育的。說這種話的人，在審判的日子，必須把所說的都供出來。既是這樣，我們惡毒的話豈不更要句句供出來！
footnotes.en: 12:36 1 idle The Greek word means not working. An idle word is a non-working word, an inoperative word, a word that has no positive function and is useless, unprofitable, unfruitful, and barren. Those who have spoken such words will render an account concerning every one of them in the day of judgment. Since this is the case, how much more must we account for every wicked word!

footnotes.zh: 供出来，直译，交账。
footnotes.zh_big5: 供出來，直譯，交賬。

refs.text_gb: 你竟任着你刚硬不悔改的心，为自己在神动怒并显示祂公义审判的日子，积蓄忿怒。
refs.text_big5: 你竟任著你剛硬不悔改的心，為自己在神動怒並顯示祂公義審判的日子，積蓄忿怒。
refs.text_en: But, according to your hardness and your unrepentant heart, you are storing up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,

refs.text_gb: 就是在神借耶稣基督，照着我的福音，审判人隐秘事的日子。
refs.text_big5: 就是在神藉耶穌基督，照著我的福音，審判人隱祕事的日子。
refs.text_en: In the day when God judges the secrets of men according to my gospel through Jesus Christ.

refs.text_gb: 因为祂已经定了日子，要借着祂所设立的人，按公义审判天下；祂已叫这人从死人中复活，供万人作可信的凭据。
refs.text_big5: 因為祂已經定了日子，要藉著祂所設立的人，按公義審判天下；祂已叫這人從死人中復活，供萬人作可信的憑據。
refs.text_en: Because He has set a day in which He is to judge the world in righteousness by the man whom He has designated, having furnished proof to all by raising Him from the dead.

refs.text_gb: 他们必向那预备好要审判活人死人的主交账。
refs.text_big5: 他們必向那豫備好要審判活人死人的主交賬。
refs.text_en: Who will render an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

verses.text_gb: 因为要凭你的话[Fn1][Cra]，称你为义；也要凭你的话，定你有罪。
verses.text_big5: 因為要憑你的話[Fn1][Cra]，稱你為義；也要憑你的話，定你有罪。
verses.text_en: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为要凭你的话，称你为义；也要凭你的话，定你有罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為要憑你的話，稱你為義；也要憑你的話，定你有罪。

footnotes.zh: 这真是一个警告！我们必须学习管制并约束自己的说话。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這真是一個警告！我們必須學習管制並約束自己的說話。
footnotes.en: 12:37 1 words What a warning this is! We must learn to control and restrict our speaking.

refs.text_gb: 我们在许多事上都有过失，若有人在话语上没有过失，他就是完全人，也能勒住全身。
refs.text_big5: 我們在許多事上都有過失，若有人在話語上沒有過失，他就是完全人，也能勒住全身。
refs.text_en: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone does not stumble in word, this one is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body as well.

verses.text_gb: 当时有几个经学家和法利赛人应声对耶稣说，夫子，我们愿意你[Fn1]显个神[Fn2][Cra]迹给我们看。
verses.text_big5: 當時有幾個經學家和法利賽人應聲對耶穌說，夫子，我們願意你[Fn1]顯個神[Fn2][Cra]蹟給我們看。
verses.text_en: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered Him, saying, Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.
verses.text_gb_plain: 当时有几个经学家和法利赛人应声对耶稣说，夫子，我们愿意你显个神迹给我们看。
verses.text_big5_plain: 當時有幾個經學家和法利賽人應聲對耶穌說，夫子，我們願意你顯個神蹟給我們看。

footnotes.zh: 直译，从你得看一个神迹。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，從你得看一個神蹟。
footnotes.en: 12:38 1 sign A sign is a miracle that has some spiritual significance. The Jews always seek signs (1 Cor. 1:22).

footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，表號，兆頭。指帶著屬靈意義的神蹟。猶太人總是尋求神蹟。（林前一22。）

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人和撒都该人进前来，试诱耶稣，求祂从天上显个神迹给他们看。

refs.text_en: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing Him asked Him to show them a sign out of heaven.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人出来，同耶稣辩论，向祂寻求一个从天上来的神迹，想要试诱祂。

refs.text_en: And He groaned deeply in His spirit and said, Why does this generation seek a sign? Truly I tell you, No sign shall be given to this generation.

footnotes.zh: 地心称为地的低下之处(弗四9)和阴间(徒二27)，这是主死后所去的地方。阴间有两部分：受苦的部分和得安慰的部分(路十六23～26)。得安慰的部分是乐园，就是主同得救的强盗，在十字架上死了之后所去的地方(路二三43)。因此，地心、地的低下之处、阴间和乐园，都是同义辞，指主在受死后、复活前，停留三日三夜的地方。
footnotes.zh_big5: 地心稱為地的低下之處（弗四9）和陰間，（徒二27，）這是主死後所去的地方。陰間有兩部分：受苦的部分和得安慰的部分。（路十六23～26。）得安慰的部分是樂園，就是主同得救的強盜，在十字架上死了之後所去的地方。（路二三43。）因此，地心、地的低下之處、陰間和樂園，都是同義辭，指主在受死後、復活前，停留三日三夜的地方。
footnotes.en: 12:40 1 heart The heart of the earth is called "the lower parts of the earth" (Eph. 4:9) and Hades (Acts 2:27), where the Lord went after His death. Hades, equal to Sheol in the Old Testament (see note Matt. 11:23 1 ), has two sections, the section of torment and the section of comfort (Luke 16:23-26). The section of comfort is Paradise, where the Lord went with the saved thief after they died on the cross (Luke 23:43). Hence, heart of the earth, lower parts of the earth, Hades, and Paradise are synonymous terms, referring to the place where the Lord stayed for three days and three nights after His death and before His resurrection.

footnotes.zh: 同42节者，指质更好、量更多；因此，更大。与6节的更大不同，那是指外部的尺寸或度量更大。基督是神差遣到祂百姓那里的申言者(申十八15，18)，比申言者约拿更大。约拿是从以色列人转向外邦人的申言者，曾被放在大鱼腹中。他在那里停留三日，出来后成了那世代叫人悔改的神迹(兆头)(拿一2，17，三2～10)。这预表基督要从以色列人转向外邦人，并要埋在地心里三日三夜，然后从死人中复活，成了这世代叫人得救的神迹(兆头)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 同42節者，指質更好、量更多；因此，更大。與6節的更大不同，那是指外部的尺寸或度量更大。基督是神差遣到祂百姓那裏的申言者，（申十八15，18，）比申言者約拿更大。約拿是從以色列人轉向外邦人的申言者，曾被放在大魚腹中。他在那裏停留三日，出來後成了那世代叫人悔改的神蹟（兆頭）。（拿一2，17，三2～10。）這豫表基督要從以色列人轉向外邦人，並要埋在地心裏三日三夜，然後從死人中復活，成了這世代叫人得救的神蹟（兆頭）。
footnotes.en: 12:41 1 more The Greek word for more, occurring also in v. 42, means better in quality and larger in quantity; hence, more. It differs from the word for greater in v. 6, which means greater in external size or measure. Christ, as the Prophet sent by God to His people (Deut. 18:15, 18), is more than Jonah the prophet. Jonah was the prophet who turned from Israel to the Gentiles and was put into the belly of the great fish. After remaining there for three days, he came out to become a sign to that generation for repentance (Jonah 1:2, 17; 3:2-10). This was a type of Christ, who would turn from Israel to the Gentiles and who would be buried in the heart of the earth for three days and then be resurrected, becoming a sign to this generation for salvation.

footnotes.zh: 见41注1。基督这位大卫的儿子，乃是君王，比所罗门王更大。所罗门建造神的殿，并说智慧的话，外邦女王曾来见他(王上六2，十1～8)。这也是基督的预表。祂建造召会作神的殿，并说智慧的话，寻求祂的外邦人都转向祂。 这两个预表指明，基督无论是神所差的申言者，或是神所膏的君王，都要从以色列人转向外邦人，如18、21节所预言的。 按照历史，所罗门王在申言者约拿之前；但按照属灵的意义，约拿在先，如马太所记载的。这也证明马太的记载不是按历史的次序，乃是按道理的次序(见八16注1二段)。按照道理，基督必须先死而复活，然后建造召会，并说智慧的话。这对这世代，无论犹太人或外邦人，都是真实的神迹(兆头)(林前一22，24)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見41註1。基督這位大衛的兒子，乃是君王，比所羅門王更大。所羅門建造神的殿，並說智慧的話，外邦女王曾來見他。（王上六2，十1～8。）這也是基督的豫表。祂建造召會作神的殿，並說智慧的話，尋求祂的外邦人都轉向祂。ˍ這兩個豫表指明，基督無論是神所差的申言者，或是神所膏的君王，都要從以色列人轉向外邦人，如18、21節所豫言的。ˍ按照歷史，所羅門王在申言者約拿之前；但按照屬靈的意義，約拿在先，如馬太所記載的。這也證明馬太的記載不是按歷史的次序，乃是按道理的次序。（見八16註1二段。）按照道理，基督必須先死而復活，然後建造召會，並說智慧的話。這對這世代，無論猶太人或外邦人，都是真實的神蹟（兆頭）。（林前一22，24。）
footnotes.en: 12:42 1 more See note Matt. 12:41 1 . Christ, as the Son of David, as the King, is more than Solomon the king. Solomon built the temple of God and spoke the word of wisdom. To him the Gentile queen came (1 Kings 6:2; 10:1-8). This too was a type of Christ, who is building the church, making it the temple of God, and is speaking the word of wisdom. To Him the Gentile seekers turn. This type, and that in v. 41, indicate that Christ, whether as the Prophet sent by God or as the King anointed by God, would turn from Israel to the Gentiles, as prophesied in vv. 18, 21. According to history King Solomon preceded Jonah the prophet. But according to spiritual significance Jonah came first, as recorded in Matthew. This too shows that Matthew's record is not according to the sequence of history but according to the sequence of doctrine (see note Matt. 8:16 1 par. 2 ). According to doctrine, first Christ had to die and be resurrected; then He would build the church and speak the word of wisdom. Christ's death and resurrection are the real sign to this generation, to both the Jews and the Gentiles (1 Cor. 1:22, 24).

refs.text_en: And the queen of Sheba had heard of Solomon's fame, and she came to Jerusalem with a very large retinue and with camels bearing spices and much gold and precious stones to test Solomon with hard questions. And when she came to Solomon, she spoke with him all that was on her heart.

footnotes.en: 12:43 1 waterless The unclean spirit, a demon (v. 22), seeks rest but cannot find it in waterless places because the lodging place of demons, after God's judgment by water in Gen. 1:2, is the sea. (See Life-study of Genesis, Message Two.) Since a demon cannot find rest in dry places, it returns to the human body that it originally possessed and settles down there (vv. 44-45).

footnotes.zh: 在道理上，43节是接着22节。这两节之间记载犹太人弃绝基督，基督也放弃他们。这里，主将弃绝祂的犹太人这邪恶的世代，比喻为鬼附的人。在主眼中，弃绝祂的犹太人就像鬼附的人一样。约拿和所罗门的两个神迹，指明外邦人要悔改；但鬼附之人的事例，指明弃绝祂的犹太人不肯悔改。他们只肯扫除污秽，增添饰物以美化自己，却不肯接受基督来充满。他们宁愿仍然虚空，仍然空着。这就是今天犹太人的真实光景。将近这世代的末了，他们被鬼附的情形要加重七倍，景况就比先前更坏了。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在道理上，43節是接著22節。這兩節之間記載猶太人棄絕基督，基督也放棄他們。這裏，主將棄絕祂的猶太人這邪惡的世代，比喻為鬼附的人。在主眼中，棄絕祂的猶太人就像鬼附的人一樣。約拿和所羅門的兩個神蹟，指明外邦人要悔改；但鬼附之人的事例，指明棄絕祂的猶太人不肯悔改。他們只肯掃除污穢，增添飾物以美化自己，卻不肯接受基督來充滿。他們寧願仍然虛空，仍然空著。這就是今天猶太人的真實光景。將近這世代的末了，他們被鬼附的情形要加重七倍，景況就比先前更壞了。
footnotes.en: 12:45 1 this Doctrinally, v. 43 continues v. 22. Between these two verses is a record of the Jews' rejection of Christ and of Christ's forsaking of them. Here the Lord likened the evil generation of the rejecting Jews to the demon possessed man. In the eyes of the Lord the rejecting Jews were like the demon possessed people. The signs of Jonah and Solomon indicated that the Gentiles would repent, but the case of the demon possessed man indicated that the rejecting Jews would not repent. They would only sweep away the dirt and decorate by adding good things to beautify themselves. They would not receive Christ and allow Him to fill them. Rather, they would remain empty and unoccupied. This is the actual condition of today's Jews. Near the end of this age they will be seven times more possessed by demons, and their state will become worse than ever.

refs.text_en: But He answered and said to them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and a sign shall not be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.

footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明屬天的王放棄了祂和猶太人肉身的關係。在本章，猶太人棄絕基督達到極峰，以致基督完全放棄他們。此時，他們開始與基督決裂，而與基督隔絕了。（羅十一17，19～20。）
footnotes.en: 12:48 1 Who This indicates that the heavenly King forsook His relationship in the flesh with the Jews. In this chapter the Jews' rejection of Christ, having reached its climax, caused Christ to forsake them fully. At this point the break between them and Christ began, and they were severed from Christ (Rom. 11:17, 19-20).

footnotes.zh: 在十二章末了，属天的王既被犹太宗教首领完全弃绝，就和他们决裂了。那一天，祂从屋子里出来，坐在海边，这是很有意义的。屋子象征以色列家(十6)，海象征外邦世界(但七3，17，启十七15)。王从屋子里出来，坐在海边，表征祂和犹太人决裂以后，就放弃以色列家，而转向外邦人。此后，祂在海边讲论关于国度奥秘的比喻。这表征国度的奥秘是启示在召会里。因此，本章所有的比喻都是对门徒说的，不是对犹太人说的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在十二章末了，屬天的王既被猶太宗教首領完全棄絕，就和他們決裂了。那一天，祂從屋子裏出來，坐在海邊，這是很有意義的。屋子象徵以色列家，（十6，）海象徵外邦世界。（但七3，17，啟十七15。）王從屋子裏出來，坐在海邊，表徵祂和猶太人決裂以後，就放棄以色列家，而轉向外邦人。此後，祂在海邊講論關於國度奧祕的比喻。這表徵國度的奧祕是啟示在召會裏。因此，本章所有的比喻都是對門徒說的，不是對猶太人說的。
footnotes.en: 13:1 1 On At the end of ch. 12 the heavenly King, having been fully rejected by the leaders of the Jewish religion, made a break with them. On that day He went out of the house and sat beside the sea. This is very significant. The house signifies the house of Israel (Matt. 10:6), and the sea signifies the Gentile world (Dan. 7:3, 17; Rev. 17:15). The King's going out of the house to sit beside the sea signifies that after His break with the Jews, He forsook the house of Israel and turned to the Gentiles. It was after this, while on the seashore, that He gave the parables concerning the mysteries of the kingdom. This signifies that the mysteries of the kingdom were revealed in the church. Hence, all the parables in this chapter were spoken to His disciples, not to the Jews.

footnotes.zh: 在关于国度奥秘的七个比喻中，主在第一个比喻的开头，没有说“诸天的国好比……，”如祂在另外六个比喻中所说的(24，31，33，44～45，47)，因为诸天的国开始于第二个比喻。在第一个比喻里，主出去只是为国度撒了种，那时种子还没有长成庄稼，形成国度。正如主在那时传道所说的，国度还没有来到，不过是已经临近了(四17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在關於國度奧祕的七個比喻中，主在第一個比喻的開頭，沒有說“諸天的國好比…，”如祂在另外六個比喻中所說的，（24，31，33，44～45，47，）因為諸天的國開始於第二個比喻。在第一個比喻裏，主出去只是為國度撒了種，那時種子還沒有長成莊稼，形成國度。正如主在那時傳道所說的，國度還沒有來到，不過是已經臨近了。（四17。）
footnotes.en: 13:3 1 Behold In contrast to what He said in the other six parables (vv. 24, 31, 33, 44-45, 47), at the beginning of this parable, the first of the seven parables concerning the mysteries of the kingdom, the Lord did not say, "The kingdom of the heavens is (or, has become) like...," because the kingdom of the heavens began with the second parable. In this first parable the Lord went out only to sow the seed for the kingdom. At that time the seed had not yet grown to be the crop for the formation of the kingdom. As the Lord said in His preaching at that time, the kingdom had not yet come but had only drawn near (Matt. 4:17).

footnotes.en: 13:4 1 The seeds are the word of the kingdom (v. 19), the Lord being in this word as life.

footnotes.zh: 飞鸟象征撒但那恶者，他来把撒在硬心里国度的道夺了去(19)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 飛鳥象徵撒但那惡者，他來把撒在硬心裏國度的道奪了去。（19。）
footnotes.en: 13:4 2 beside Beside the way refers to a place close to the way. It is hardened by the traffic of the way; thus, it is difficult for the seeds to penetrate it. The wayside signifies the heart that is hardened by worldly traffic and cannot open to understand, to comprehend, the word of the kingdom (v. 19).

refs.text_gb: 凡听见国度之道不领悟的，那恶者就来，把撒在他心里的夺了去；这就是那撒在路旁的。
refs.text_big5: 凡聽見國度之道不領悟的，那惡者就來，把撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是那撒在路旁的。
refs.text_en: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom and does not understand, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is the one sown beside the way.

verses.text_gb: 又有的落在土[Fn1]浅石[Cra]头地上，土既不深[Crb]，立刻发苗；
verses.text_big5: 又有的落在土[Fn1]淺石[Cra]頭地上，土既不深[Crb]，立刻發苗；
verses.text_en: And others fell on the rocky places, where they did not have much earth, and immediately they sprang up because they had no depth of earth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又有的落在土浅石头地上，土既不深，立刻发苗；
verses.text_big5_plain: 又有的落在土淺石頭地上，土既不深，立刻發苗；

footnotes.zh: 土浅石头地，象征有的心接受国度的道是肤浅的，因为深处有石头，就是隐藏的罪、个人的欲望、自私和自怜，阻挠种子在心的深处扎根。
footnotes.zh_big5: 土淺石頭地，象徵有的心接受國度的道是膚淺的，因為深處有石頭，就是隱藏的罪、個人的慾望、自私和自憐，阻撓種子在心的深處扎根。
footnotes.en: 13:5 1 rocky The rocky places that do not have much earth signify the heart that is shallow in receiving the word of the kingdom. Deep within such a heart are rocks — hidden sins, personal desires, self-seeking, and self-pity — which hinder the seed from taking root in the depths of the heart.

refs.text_gb: 又有那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，
refs.text_big5: 又有那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，
refs.text_en: And the one sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;

refs.text_gb: 只因他里面没有根，不过是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难或逼迫，就立刻绊跌了。
refs.text_big5: 只因他裏面沒有根，不過是暫時的；一旦為道遭遇患難或逼迫，就立刻絆跌了。
refs.text_en: Yet he does not have root in himself but lasts only for a time, and when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately he is stumbled.

verses.text_gb: 等日[Fn1][Cra]头一出来，就晒焦了，又因没有根，便枯干了。
verses.text_big5: 等日[Fn1][Cra]頭一出來，就曬焦了，又因沒有根，便枯乾了。
verses.text_en: But when the sun rose, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered.
verses.text_gb_plain: 等日头一出来，就晒焦了，又因没有根，便枯干了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 等日頭一出來，就曬焦了，又因沒有根，便枯乾了。

footnotes.zh: 日头及其炙热象征患难或逼迫(21)。这日头的炙热将生根不深的苗晒干了。苗只要深深地扎根，日头的热就使庄稼长大并成熟。但由于苗扎根不深，日头那助长成熟的热，反成了庄稼致命的打击。
footnotes.zh_big5: 日頭及其炙熱象徵患難或逼迫。（21。）這日頭的炙熱將生根不深的苗曬乾了。苗只要深深的扎根，日頭的熱就使莊稼長大並成熟。但由於苗扎根不深，日頭那助長成熟的熱，反成了莊稼致命的打擊。
footnotes.en: 13:6 1 sun The sun with its scorching heat signifies affliction or persecution (v. 21). The scorching heat of the sun causes the seed that is not rooted to wither. The heat of the sun is for the growth and ripening of the crop, which take place once the seed has been deeply rooted. But because of the seed's lack of root, the sun's heat, which should cause growth and ripening, becomes a death blow to the seed.

refs.text_gb: 只因他里面没有根，不过是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难或逼迫，就立刻绊跌了。
refs.text_big5: 只因他裏面沒有根，不過是暫時的；一旦為道遭遇患難或逼迫，就立刻絆跌了。
refs.text_en: Yet he does not have root in himself but lasts only for a time, and when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately he is stumbled.

refs.text_gb: 太阳升起，热气薰烤，草就枯干，花也凋谢，美容就消没了；那富足的人在他所行的事上，也要这样衰残。
refs.text_big5: 太陽升起，熱氣薰烤，草就枯乾，花也凋謝，美容就消沒了；那富足的人在他所行的事上，也要這樣衰殘。
refs.text_en: For the sun rises with its scorching heat and withers the grass, and its flower falls off, and the beauty of its appearance is destroyed; so also the rich man will fade away in his pursuits.

verses.text_gb: 还有的落在荆[Fn1][Cra]棘里，荆棘长起来，就把它挤住了。
verses.text_big5: 還有的落在荊[Fn1][Cra]棘裏，荊棘長起來，就把它擠住了。
verses.text_en: And others fell on the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 还有的落在荆棘里，荆棘长起来，就把它挤住了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 還有的落在荊棘裏，荊棘長起來，就把它擠住了。

footnotes.zh: 荆棘象征今世的思虑和钱财的迷惑。这荆棘把道全然挤住了，使道不能在心里长大并结实(22)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 荊棘象徵今世的思慮和錢財的迷惑。這荊棘把道全然擠住了，使道不能在心裏長大並結實。（22。）
footnotes.en: 13:7 1 thorns The thorns signify the anxiety of the age and the deceitfulness of riches, which utterly choke the word, preventing it from growing in the heart and causing it to become unfruitful (v. 22).

refs.text_gb: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有今世的思虑，和钱财的迷惑，把道全然挤住了，道就不能结实。
refs.text_big5: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有今世的思慮，和錢財的迷惑，把道全然擠住了，道就不能結實。
refs.text_en: And the one sown in the thorns, this is he who hears the word, and the anxiety of the age and the deceitfulness of riches utterly choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对犹大和耶路撒冷人如此说，要开垦你们未耕之地，不要撒种在荆棘中。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對猶大和耶路撒冷人如此說，要開墾你們未耕之地，不要撒種在荊棘中。
refs.text_en: For thus says Jehovah to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, / Break up your fallow ground, / And do not sow among thorns.

verses.text_gb: 但有的落在好[Fn1][Cra]土里，就结果实，有的一[Crb]百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
verses.text_big5: 但有的落在好[Fn1][Cra]土裏，就結果實，有的一[Crb]百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
verses.text_en: But others fell on the good earth and yielded fruit, one a hundredfold, and one sixtyfold, and one thirtyfold.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但有的落在好土里，就结果实，有的一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但有的落在好土裏，就結果實，有的一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。

footnotes.zh: 好土象征好的心，没有为属世的交通往来所硬化，没有隐藏的罪，也没有今世的思虑和钱财的迷惑。这样的心让出每一寸的地土，接受主的话，使主的话可以长大，结出果实，甚至结了百倍(23)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 好土象徵好的心，沒有為屬世的交通往來所硬化，沒有隱藏的罪，也沒有今世的思慮和錢財的迷惑。這樣的心讓出每一寸的地土，接受主的話，使主的話可以長大，結出果實，甚至結了百倍。（23。）
footnotes.en: 13:8 1 good The good earth signifies the good heart that is not hardened by worldly traffic, that is without hidden sins, and that is without the anxiety of the age and the deceitfulness of riches. Such a heart gives every inch of its ground to receive the word that the word may grow, bear fruit, and produce even a hundredfold (v. 23).

refs.text_gb: 但那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，也领悟了，他就结出果实，有的结了一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
refs.text_big5: 但那撒在好土裏的，就是人聽了道，也領悟了，他就結出果實，有的結了一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
refs.text_en: But the one sown on the good earth, this is he who hears the word and understands, who by all means bears fruit and produces, one a hundredfold, and one sixtyfold, and one thirtyfold.

refs.text_gb: 以撒在那地撒种，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和华赐福给他，
refs.text_big5: 以撒在那地撒種，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和華賜福給他，
refs.text_en: And Isaac sowed in that land and gained in the same year a hundredfold. And Jehovah blessed him,

verses.text_gb: 有耳[Fn1][Cra]可听的，就应当听。
verses.text_big5: 有耳[Fn1][Cra]可聽的，就應當聽。
verses.text_en: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有耳可听的，就应当听。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽。

footnotes.zh: 这话指明反对并弃绝主的犹太人，无耳可听。因此，他们听不见。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這話指明反對並棄絕主的猶太人，無耳可聽。因此，他們聽不見。
footnotes.en: 13:9 1 ears This word indicates that the opposing and rejecting Jews did not have ears to hear. Hence, they could not hear.

refs.text_gb: 那时，义人在他们父的国里，要发光如同太阳。有耳可听的，就应当听。
refs.text_big5: 那時，義人在他們父的國裏，要發光如同太陽。有耳可聽的，就應當聽。
refs.text_en: Then the righteous will shine forth like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

refs.text_gb: 有耳可听的，就应当听。
refs.text_big5: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽。
refs.text_en: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.text_gb: 门[Cra]徒进前来，对祂说，你对众人讲话，为什么用比喻？
verses.text_big5: 門[Cra]徒進前來，對祂說，你對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻？
verses.text_en: And the disciples came and said to Him, Why do You speak in parables to them?
verses.text_gb_plain: 门徒进前来，对祂说，你对众人讲话，为什么用比喻？
verses.text_big5_plain: 門徒進前來，對祂說，你對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻？

refs.text_gb: 当耶稣独自的时候，祂周围的人，和十二个门徒，就将这些比喻问祂。
refs.text_big5: 當耶穌獨自的時候，祂周圍的人，和十二個門徒，就將這些比喻問祂。
refs.text_en: And when He was alone, those around Him, with the twelve, asked Him about the parables.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，神国的奥秘，只给你们知道，但对外人，凡事就用比喻，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，神國的奧祕，只給你們知道，但對外人，凡事就用比喻，
refs.text_en: And He said to them, To you it has been given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God, but to those outside, all things are in parables,

refs.text_gb: 叫他们看是看见，却看不透，听是听见，却不领悟；恐怕他们回转过来，就得赦免。
refs.text_big5: 叫他們看是看見，卻看不透，聽是聽見，卻不領悟；恐怕他們回轉過來，就得赦免。
refs.text_en: In order that seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest they turn and it be forgiven them.

refs.text_gb: 门徒问祂这比喻是什么意思。
refs.text_big5: 門徒問祂這比喻是甚麼意思。
refs.text_en: And His disciples questioned Him as to what this parable might be.

refs.text_gb: 祂说，神国的奥秘，只给你们知道。但对其余的人就用比喻，叫他们看却看不见，听也不领悟。
refs.text_big5: 祂說，神國的奧祕，只給你們知道。但對其餘的人就用比喻，叫他們看卻看不見，聽也不領悟。
refs.text_en: And He said, To you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest they are in parables, in order that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.

verses.text_gb: 祂回答说，因为诸[Cra]天之国的奥[Fn1][Crb]秘，只给你们知道，不给他们知道。
verses.text_big5: 祂回答說，因為諸[Cra]天之國的奧[Fn1][Crb]祕，只給你們知道，不給他們知道。
verses.text_en: And He answered and said to them, Because to you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of the heavens, but to them it has not been given.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂回答说，因为诸天之国的奥秘，只给你们知道，不给他们知道。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂回答說，因為諸天之國的奧祕，只給你們知道，不給他們知道。

footnotes.zh: 原文，复数。属天国度的王用比喻启示国度的事(34)，为要使国度的事，对那些反对并弃绝祂的犹太人成为奥秘，叫他们明白不来。从王来撒种，到祂回来收割庄稼，每一件关于国度的事，对天然的心思都是奥秘。惟有服从之人的心中，蒙了光照的心思，才能明白这些奥秘。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文，複數。屬天國度的王用比喻啟示國度的事，（34，）為要使國度的事，對那些反對並棄絕祂的猶太人成為奧祕，叫他們明白不來。從王來撒種，到祂回來收割莊稼，每一件關於國度的事，對天然的心思都是奧祕。惟有服從之人的心中，蒙了光照的心思，纔能明白這些奧祕。
footnotes.en: 13:11 1 mysteries The King of the heavenly kingdom used parables to reveal the things of the kingdom (v. 34) in order to make them mysteries to the opposing and rejecting Jews so that they would not understand them. From the time the King came to sow the seed until He comes back to reap the harvest, everything concerning the kingdom is a mystery to the natural mind. Only the enlightened mind of a submissive heart can understand these mysteries.

refs.text_gb: 你们要悔改，因为诸天的国已经临近了。
refs.text_big5: 你們要悔改，因為諸天的國已經臨近了。
refs.text_en: And saying, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.

refs.text_gb: 神能照我的福音，就是关于耶稣基督的传扬，照历世以来密而不宣之奥秘的启示，坚固你们；
refs.text_big5: 神能照我的福音，就是關於耶穌基督的傳揚，照歷世以來密而不宣之奧祕的啟示，堅固你們；
refs.text_en: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel, that is, the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which has been kept in silence in the times of the ages

refs.text_gb: 这是极大的奥秘，但我是指着基督与召会说的。
refs.text_big5: 這是極大的奧祕，但我是指著基督與召會說的。
refs.text_en: This mystery is great, but I speak with regard to Christ and the church.

refs.text_gb: 并且，大哉！敬虔的奥秘！这是众所公认的，就是：祂显现于肉体，被称义于灵里，被天使看见，被传于万邦，被信仰于世人中，被接去于荣耀里。
refs.text_big5: 並且，大哉！敬虔的奧祕！這是眾所公認的，就是：祂顯現於肉體，被稱義於靈裏，被天使看見，被傳於萬邦，被信仰於世人中，被接去於榮耀裏。
refs.text_en: And confessedly, great is the mystery of godliness: He who was manifested in the flesh, / Justified in the Spirit, / Seen by angels, / Preached among the nations, / Believed on in the world, / Taken up in glory.

verses.text_gb: 因为凡[Fn1][Cra]有的，还要给他，他就充盈有余；凡[Fn2]没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
verses.text_big5: 因為凡[Fn1][Cra]有的，還要給他，他就充盈有餘；凡[Fn2]沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。
verses.text_en: For whoever has, it shall be given to him, and he will abound; but whoever does not have, even that which he has shall be taken away from him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为凡有的，还要给他，他就充盈有余；凡没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為凡有的，還要給他，他就充盈有餘；凡沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。

footnotes.zh: 这是接受并跟从属天君王的人。关于国度的启示，要充盈有余的赐给他们。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是接受並跟從屬天君王的人。關於國度的啟示，要充盈有餘的賜給他們。
footnotes.en: 13:12 1 whoever This is the receiver and follower of the heavenly King; to such a one the revelation concerning the kingdom will be given in abundance.

footnotes.zh: 这是反对并弃绝主的犹太人。属天的王所说、所行的，要从他们夺去。这是犹太人今天真实的光景。他们对于诸天之国的事毫无认识，诸天的国对他们完全是未知的奥秘。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是反對並棄絕主的猶太人。屬天的王所說、所行的，要從他們奪去。這是猶太人今天真實的光景。他們對於諸天之國的事毫無認識，諸天的國對他們完全是未知的奧祕。
footnotes.en: 13:12 2 whoever This is the opposing and rejecting Jew, from whom what the heavenly King has spoken and done will be taken away. This is the real condition of the Jews today. They have no knowledge whatever concerning the kingdom of the heavens. It is altogether a mystery unknown to them.

refs.text_gb: 因为凡有的，还要给他，他就充盈有余；没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
refs.text_big5: 因為凡有的，還要給他，他就充盈有餘；沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。
refs.text_en: For to everyone who has, more shall be given, and he shall abound; but from him who does not have, even that which he has shall be taken away from him.

refs.text_gb: 因为有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
refs.text_big5: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。
refs.text_en: For he who has, it shall be given to him; and he who does not have, even what he has shall be taken away from him.

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要留心怎样听；因为凡有的，还要加给他；凡没有的，连他自以为有的，也要从他夺去。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要留心怎樣聽；因為凡有的，還要加給他；凡沒有的，連他自以為有的，也要從他奪去。
refs.text_en: Take heed therefore how you hear, for whoever has, it shall be given to him, and whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has shall be taken away from him.

refs.text_gb: 主人说，我告诉你们，凡有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
refs.text_big5: 主人說，我告訴你們，凡有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。
refs.text_en: I tell you that to everyone who has, more shall be given, but from him who does not have, even that which he has shall be taken away.

verses.text_gb: 所以我用比喻对他们讲，因为他们看却看[Cra]不见，听也听不见，也不领悟。
verses.text_big5: 所以我用比喻對他們講，因為他們看卻看[Cra]不見，聽也聽不見，也不領悟。
verses.text_en: For this reason I speak to them in parables, because seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以我用比喻对他们讲，因为他们看却看不见，听也听不见，也不领悟。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以我用比喻對他們講，因為他們看卻看不見，聽也聽不見，也不領悟。

refs.text_gb: 但直到今日，耶和华还没有使你们心能明白，眼能看见，耳能听见。
refs.text_big5: 但直到今日，耶和華還沒有使你們心能明白，眼能看見，耳能聽見。
refs.text_en: But Jehovah has not given you a heart to understand and eyes to see and ears to hear until this day.

refs.text_gb: 因为耶和华将沉睡的灵浇灌你们，封闭你们的眼，就是申言者；蒙盖你们的头，就是先见。
refs.text_big5: 因為耶和華將沉睡的靈澆灌你們，封閉你們的眼，就是申言者；蒙蓋你們的頭，就是先見。
refs.text_en: For Jehovah has poured out upon you / A spirit of deep sleep / And has shut your eyes, the prophets; / And your heads, the seers, He has covered.

refs.text_gb: 愚昧无知的百姓啊，你们有眼不看，有耳不听，现在当听这话：
refs.text_big5: 愚昧無知的百姓阿，你們有眼不看，有耳不聽，現在當聽這話：
refs.text_en: Now hear this, / O people, who are foolish and without understanding, / Who have eyes but do not see, / Who have ears but do not hear:

refs.text_gb: 人子啊，你住在悖逆的家中；他们有眼可看，却看不见，有耳可听，却听不见，因为他们是悖逆之家。
refs.text_big5: 人子阿，你住在悖逆的家中；他們有眼可看，卻看不見，有耳可聽，卻聽不見，因為他們是悖逆之家。
refs.text_en: Son of man, you are dwelling in the midst of a rebellious house, who have eyes to see but do not see and have ears to hear but do not hear; for they are a rebellious house.

refs.text_gb: 如经上所记：“神给他们昏睡的灵，看不见的眼，听不见的耳，直到今日。”
refs.text_big5: 如經上所記：“神給他們昏睡的靈，看不見的眼，聽不見的耳，直到今日。”
refs.text_en: As it is written, "God gave them a spirit of deep sleep, eyes to see not and ears to hear not, until this very day."

verses.text_gb: 在他们身上，应验了以赛亚的申言，说，“你[Cra]们听是要听见，却绝不领悟；看是要看见，却绝看不透。
verses.text_big5: 在他們身上，應驗了以賽亞的申言，說，“你[Cra]們聽是要聽見，卻絕不領悟；看是要看見，卻絕看不透。
verses.text_en: And in them the prophecy of Isaiah is being fulfilled, which says, "In hearing you shall hear and by no means understand, and seeing you shall see and by no means perceive.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在他们身上，应验了以赛亚的申言，说，“你们听是要听见，却绝不领悟；看是要看见，却绝看不透。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在他們身上，應驗了以賽亞的申言，說，“你們聽是要聽見，卻絕不領悟；看是要看見，卻絕看不透。

refs.text_gb: 祂说，你去对这百姓说，你们听是要听见，却绝不领悟；看是要看见，却绝不晓得。
refs.text_big5: 祂說，你去對這百姓說，你們聽是要聽見，卻絕不領悟；看是要看見，卻絕不曉得。
refs.text_en: And He said, Go and say to this people, Hear indeed, but do not perceive; / And see indeed, but do not understand.

refs.text_gb: 你要使这百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵发沉，眼睛封闭；恐怕他们眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里领悟，回转过来，便得医治。
refs.text_big5: 你要使這百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵發沉，眼睛封閉；恐怕他們眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏領悟，回轉過來，便得醫治。
refs.text_en: Make the heart of this people numb; / Dull their ears, / And seal their eyes; / Lest they see with their eyes and hear with their ears, / And their heart perceive and return, and they are healed.

refs.text_gb: “主叫他们瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他们眼睛看见，心里明白，回转过来，我就医治他们。”
refs.text_big5: “主叫他們瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他們眼睛看見，心裏明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。”
refs.text_en: "He has blinded their eyes and He hardened their heart, that they might not see with their eyes and understand with their heart and turn, and I will heal them."

refs.text_gb: “你去对这百姓说，你们听是要听见，却绝不领悟；看是要看见，却绝看不透；
refs.text_big5: “你去對這百姓說，你們聽是要聽見，卻絕不領悟；看是要看見，卻絕看不透；
refs.text_en: Saying, "Go to this people and say, In hearing you shall hear and by no means understand, and seeing you will see and by no means perceive;

verses.text_gb: 因为这百姓心蒙脂油，耳听不灵，眼[Cra]睛闭着；恐怕他们眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里领悟，回转过来，我就医治他们。”
verses.text_big5: 因為這百姓心蒙脂油，耳聽不靈，眼[Cra]睛閉著；恐怕他們眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏領悟，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。”
verses.text_en: For the heart of this people has become fat, and with their ears they have heard heavily, and their eyes they have closed, lest they perceive with their eyes and hear with their ears and understand with their heart, and they turn around, and I will heal them."
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为这百姓心蒙脂油，耳听不灵，眼睛闭着；恐怕他们眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里领悟，回转过来，我就医治他们。”
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為這百姓心蒙脂油，耳聽不靈，眼睛閉著；恐怕他們眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏領悟，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。”

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，我为审判到这世上来，叫看不见的可以看见，看得见的反瞎了眼。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，我為審判到這世上來，叫看不見的可以看見，看得見的反瞎了眼。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said, For judgment I have come into this world, that those who do not see may see, and that those who see may become blind.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，你们若瞎了眼，就没有罪了；但现在你们说，我们看得见，所以你们的罪还存在。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，你們若瞎了眼，就沒有罪了；但現在你們說，我們看得見，所以你們的罪還存在。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to them, If you were blind, you would not have sin; but now that you say, We see; your sin remains.

verses.text_gb: 但你们的眼睛是有[Cra]福的，因为看见了；你们的耳朵也是有福的，因为听见了。
verses.text_big5: 但你們的眼睛是有[Cra]福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。
verses.text_en: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但你们的眼睛是有福的，因为看见了；你们的耳朵也是有福的，因为听见了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但你們的眼睛是有福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣转身，暗暗地对门徒说，看见你们所看见的，那眼睛就有福了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌轉身，暗暗的對門徒說，看見你們所看見的，那眼睛就有福了。
refs.text_en: And turning to the disciples, He said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他说，西门巴约拿，你是有福的，因为不是血肉之人启示了你，乃是我在诸天之上的父启示了你。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他說，西門巴約拿，你是有福的，因為不是血肉之人啟示了你，乃是我在諸天之上的父啟示了你。
refs.text_en: And Jesus answered and said to him, Blessed are you, Simon Barjona, because flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but My Father who is in the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，你因看见了我才信，那没有看见就信的有福了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，你因看見了我纔信，那沒有看見就信的有福了。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to him, Because you have seen Me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.

verses.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，曾经有许多申言者和义人，渴想要看[Cra]你们所看[Fn1]的，却没有看见；要听你们所听的，却没有听见。
verses.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，曾經有許多申言者和義人，渴想要看[Cra]你們所看[Fn1]的，卻沒有看見；要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。
verses.text_en: For truly I say to you that many prophets and righteous men have desired to perceive the things that you see, and have not perceived them, and to hear the things that you hear, and have not heard them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我实在告诉你们，曾经有许多申言者和义人，渴想要看你们所看的，却没有看见；要听你们所听的，却没有听见。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我實在告訴你們，曾經有許多申言者和義人，渴想要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見；要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。

footnotes.zh: 看见并听见属天国度的奥秘，是何等有福！
footnotes.en: 13:17 1 see; hear What a blessing it is to see and hear the mysteries of the heavenly kingdom!

refs.text_gb: 我告诉你们，曾经有许多申言者和君王，想要看你们所看的，却没有看见；要听你们所听的，却没有听见。
refs.text_big5: 我告訴你們，曾經有許多申言者和君王，想要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見；要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。
refs.text_en: For I tell you that many prophets and kings have wanted to perceive the things that you see, and have not perceived them, and to hear the things that you hear, and have not heard them.

refs.text_gb: 你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕欢腾的要见我的日子，既看见了，就欢乐。
refs.text_big5: 你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕歡騰的要見我的日子，既看見了，就歡樂。
refs.text_en: Your father Abraham exulted that he would see My day, and he saw it and rejoiced.

refs.text_gb: 这些人都是存着信心死的，并没有得着所应许的，却从远处望见，且欢喜迎接，又承认自己在地上是客旅，是寄居的。
refs.text_big5: 這些人都是存著信心死的，並沒有得著所應許的，卻從遠處望見，且歡喜迎接，又承認自己在地上是客旅，是寄居的。
refs.text_en: All these died in faith, not receiving the promises but seeing them from afar and joyfully greeting them and confessing that they were strangers and sojourners on the earth.

refs.text_gb: 关于这救恩，那预言你们要得恩典的众申言者，已经详细地寻求考察过，
refs.text_big5: 關於這救恩，那豫言你們要得恩典的眾申言者，已經詳細的尋求考察過，
refs.text_en: Concerning this salvation the prophets, who prophesied concerning the grace that was to come unto you, sought and searched diligently,

refs.text_gb: 就是考察在他们里面基督的灵，预先证明那要临到基督的苦难，以及后来的荣耀，所指明的是什么时候，并怎样的时候；
refs.text_big5: 就是考察在他們裏面基督的靈，豫先證明那要臨到基督的苦難，以及後來的榮耀，所指明的是甚麼時候，並怎樣的時候；
refs.text_en: Searching into what time or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ in them was making clear, testifying beforehand of the sufferings of Christ and the glories after these.

refs.text_gb: 他们得了启示，知道他们供应这些事，不是为自己，乃是为你们；那些靠着从天上差来的圣灵，传福音给你们的人，现在将这些事报给你们；天使也渴望详细察看这些事。
refs.text_big5: 他們得了啟示，知道他們供應這些事，不是為自己，乃是為你們；那些靠著從天上差來的聖靈，傳福音給你們的人，現在將這些事報給你們；天使也渴望詳細察看這些事。
refs.text_en: To them it was revealed that not to themselves but to you they ministered these things, which have now been announced to you through those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven, which things angels long to look into.

verses.text_gb: 所[Cra]以你们要听这撒种者的比喻。
verses.text_big5: 所[Cra]以你們要聽這撒種者的比喻。
verses.text_en: You therefore hear the parable of the one who sowed.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以你们要听这撒种者的比喻。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以你們要聽這撒種者的比喻。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣又对他们说，你们不晓得这比喻么？这样怎能明白一切的比喻？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌又對他們說，你們不曉得這比喻麼？這樣怎能明白一切的比喻？
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Do you not know this parable? And how will you know all the parables?

refs.text_gb: 那撒种者所撒的，乃是道。
refs.text_big5: 那撒種者所撒的，乃是道。
refs.text_en: The sower sows the word.

refs.text_gb: 那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他们里面的道夺了去。
refs.text_big5: 那撒在路旁的，就是人聽了道，撒但立刻來，把撒在他們裏面的道奪了去。
refs.text_en: And these are the ones beside the way, where the word is sown; and when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown into them.

refs.text_gb: 那撒在石头地上的，照样也是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，
refs.text_big5: 那撒在石頭地上的，照樣也是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，
refs.text_en: And likewise, these are the ones being sown on the rocky places, who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy.

refs.text_gb: 但他们里面没有根，不过是暂时的；及至为道遭遇患难或逼迫，就立刻绊跌了。
refs.text_big5: 但他們裏面沒有根，不過是暫時的；及至為道遭遇患難或逼迫，就立刻絆跌了。
refs.text_en: Yet they have no root in themselves, but last only for a time; then when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately they are stumbled.

refs.text_gb: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，
refs.text_big5: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，
refs.text_en: And others are the ones being sown into the thorns; these are the ones who have heard the word,

refs.text_gb: 后来有今世的思虑、钱财的迷惑、以及其他的贪欲，进来把道全然挤住了，道就不能结实。
refs.text_big5: 後來有今世的思慮、錢財的迷惑、以及其他的貪慾，進來把道全然擠住了，道就不能結實。
refs.text_en: And the anxieties of the age and the deceitfulness of riches and the lusts for other things enter in and utterly choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

refs.text_gb: 但那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，接受了，并且结实，有的三十倍，有的六十倍，有的一百倍。
refs.text_big5: 但那撒在好土裏的，就是人聽了道，接受了，並且結實，有的三十倍，有的六十倍，有的一百倍。
refs.text_en: And these are the ones sown on the good earth: those who hear the word and receive it and bear fruit, one thirtyfold, and one sixtyfold, and one a hundredfold.

refs.text_gb: 这比喻乃是这样：种子就是神的道。
refs.text_big5: 這比喻乃是這樣：種子就是神的道。
refs.text_en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

refs.text_gb: 那些在路旁的，就是人听了道，随后魔鬼来，从他们心里把道夺去，恐怕他们信了得救。
refs.text_big5: 那些在路旁的，就是人聽了道，隨後魔鬼來，從他們心裏把道奪去，恐怕他們信了得救。
refs.text_en: And those beside the way are those who heard; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, so that they would not believe and be saved.

refs.text_gb: 那些在磐石上的，就是人听了道，欢喜领受，但没有根，不过是暂时信了，在试炼的时候，就退后了。
refs.text_big5: 那些在磐石上的，就是人聽了道，歡喜領受，但沒有根，不過是暫時信了，在試煉的時候，就退後了。
refs.text_en: And those on the rock are those who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; yet these have no root, who believe only for a while, and in time of trial they draw back.

refs.text_gb: 那落在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，走开以后，被今生的思虑、钱财和宴乐全然挤住了，便结不出成熟的子粒来。
refs.text_big5: 那落在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，走開以後，被今生的思慮、錢財和宴樂全然擠住了，便結不出成熟的子粒來。
refs.text_en: And that which fell into the thorns, these are those who heard and, going away, are utterly choked by anxieties and riches and pleasures of this life, and do not bring any fruit to maturity.

refs.text_gb: 但那落在好土里的，就是人用美好善良的心听了道，便持守住，并且忍耐着结实。
refs.text_big5: 但那落在好土裏的，就是人用美好善良的心聽了道，便持守住，並且忍耐著結實。
refs.text_en: But that which is in the good earth, these are those who in a noble and good heart hear the word and hold it fast and bear fruit with endurance.

verses.text_gb: 凡听见国度之道不领悟的，那恶[Fn1][Cra]者就来，把撒在他心里的夺了去；这就是那撒在路旁的。
verses.text_big5: 凡聽見國度之道不領悟的，那惡[Fn1][Cra]者就來，把撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是那撒在路旁的。
verses.text_en: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom and does not understand, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is the one sown beside the way.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡听见国度之道不领悟的，那恶者就来，把撒在他心里的夺了去；这就是那撒在路旁的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡聽見國度之道不領悟的，那惡者就來，把撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是那撒在路旁的。

footnotes.zh: 那恶者就是魔鬼(38～39)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 那惡者就是魔鬼。（38～39。）
footnotes.en: 13:19 1 evil The evil one is the devil (vv. 38-39).

refs.text_gb: 你们的话，是，就说是，不是，就说不是；若再多说，就是出于那恶者。
refs.text_big5: 你們的話，是，就說是，不是，就說不是；若再多說，就是出於那惡者。
refs.text_en: But let your word be, Yes, yes; No, no; for anything more than these is of the evil one.

verses.text_gb: 又有那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，
verses.text_big5: 又有那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，
verses.text_en: And the one sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;
verses.text_gb_plain: 又有那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，
verses.text_big5_plain: 又有那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，

verses.text_gb: 只因他里面没有根，不过是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难或逼迫，就立刻绊[Cra]跌了。
verses.text_big5: 只因他裏面沒有根，不過是暫時的；一旦為道遭遇患難或逼迫，就立刻絆[Cra]跌了。
verses.text_en: Yet he does not have root in himself but lasts only for a time, and when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately he is stumbled.
verses.text_gb_plain: 只因他里面没有根，不过是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难或逼迫，就立刻绊跌了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 只因他裏面沒有根，不過是暫時的；一旦為道遭遇患難或逼迫，就立刻絆跌了。

refs.text_gb: 凡不因我绊跌的，就有福了。
refs.text_big5: 凡不因我絆跌的，就有福了。
refs.text_en: And blessed is he who is not stumbled because of Me.

refs.text_gb: 他们就因祂绊跌。但耶稣对他们说，申言者除了在本地本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。
refs.text_big5: 他們就因祂絆跌。但耶穌對他們說，申言者除了在本地本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。
refs.text_en: And they were stumbled because of Him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor except in his own country and in his own house.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣心里知道门徒为这话唧咕议论，就对他们说，这话是叫你们绊跌么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌心裏知道門徒為這話唧咕議論，就對他們說，這話是叫你們絆跌麼？
refs.text_en: But Jesus, knowing in Himself that His disciples were murmuring about this, said to them, Does this stumble you?

verses.text_gb: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有今世[Cra]的思[Crb]虑，和钱[Crc]财的迷惑，把道全然挤住了，道就不能结实。
verses.text_big5: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有今世[Cra]的思[Crb]慮，和錢[Crc]財的迷惑，把道全然擠住了，道就不能結實。
verses.text_en: And the one sown in the thorns, this is he who hears the word, and the anxiety of the age and the deceitfulness of riches utterly choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.text_gb_plain: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有今世的思虑，和钱财的迷惑，把道全然挤住了，道就不能结实。
verses.text_big5_plain: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有今世的思慮，和錢財的迷惑，把道全然擠住了，道就不能結實。

refs.text_gb: 在他们里面，这世代的神弄瞎了他们这不信者的心思，叫基督荣耀之福音的光照，不照亮他们；基督本是神的像。
refs.text_big5: 在他們裏面，這世代的神弄瞎了他們這不信者的心思，叫基督榮耀之福音的光照，不照亮他們；基督本是神的像。
refs.text_en: In whom the god of this age has blinded the thoughts of the unbelievers that the illumination of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, might not shine on them.

refs.text_gb: 不要模仿这世代，反要借着心思的更新而变化，叫你们验证何为神那美好、可喜悦、并纯全的旨意。
refs.text_big5: 不要模倣這世代，反要藉著心思的更新而變化，叫你們驗證何為神那美好、可喜悅、並純全的旨意。
refs.text_en: And do not be fashioned according to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of the mind that you may prove what the will of God is, that which is good and well pleasing and perfect.

refs.text_gb: 基督照着我们神与父的旨意，为我们的罪舍了自己，要把我们从现今这邪恶的世代救出来。
refs.text_big5: 基督照著我們神與父的旨意，為我們的罪捨了自己，要把我們從現今這邪惡的世代救出來。
refs.text_en: Who gave Himself for our sins that He might rescue us out of the present evil age according to the will of our God and Father,

refs.text_gb: 所以不要忧虑，说，我们要吃什么？喝什么？披戴什么？
refs.text_big5: 所以不要憂慮，說，我們要喫甚麼？喝甚麼？披戴甚麼？
refs.text_en: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, With what shall we be clothed?

refs.text_gb: 应当一无挂虑，只要凡事借着祷告、祈求，带着感谢，将你们所要的告诉神；
refs.text_big5: 應當一無罣慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，帶著感謝，將你們所要的告訴神；
refs.text_en: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God;

refs.text_gb: 你们要将一切的忧虑卸给神，因为祂顾念你们。
refs.text_big5: 你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，因為祂顧念你們。
refs.text_en: Casting all your anxiety on Him because it matters to Him concerning you.

refs.text_gb: 于是耶稣对门徒说，我实在告诉你们，财主进诸天的国是难的。
refs.text_big5: 於是耶穌對門徒說，我實在告訴你們，財主進諸天的國是難的。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to His disciples, Truly I say to you, Only with difficulty will a rich man enter into the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 我又告诉你们，骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进神的国还容易。
refs.text_big5: 我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過鍼的眼，比財主進神的國還容易。
refs.text_en: And again I say to you, It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣周围一看，对门徒说，有钱财的人要进神的国，是何等的难！
refs.text_big5: 耶穌周圍一看，對門徒說，有錢財的人要進神的國，是何等的難！
refs.text_en: And Jesus, looking around, said to His disciples, How difficult it will be for those who have riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

refs.text_gb: 但那些想要发财的人，就陷在试诱、网罗、和许多无知有害的私欲里，叫人沉溺在败坏和灭亡中。
refs.text_big5: 但那些想要發財的人，就陷在試誘、網羅、和許多無知有害的私慾裏，叫人沉溺在敗壞和滅亡中。
refs.text_en: But those who intend to be rich fall into temptation and a snare and many foolish and harmful desires, which plunge men into destruction and ruin.

refs.text_gb: 因为贪财是万恶之根，有人贪恋钱财，就受迷惑，离弃了信仰，用许多苦痛把自己刺透了。
refs.text_big5: 因為貪財是萬惡之根，有人貪戀錢財，就受迷惑，離棄了信仰，用許多苦痛把自己刺透了。
refs.text_en: For the love of money is a root of all evils, because of which some, aspiring after money, have been led away from the faith and pierced themselves through with many pains.

refs.text_gb: 你要嘱咐那些今世富足的人，不要心思高傲，也不要寄望于无定的钱财，只要寄望于那将百物丰富的供给我们享受的神；
refs.text_big5: 你要囑咐那些今世富足的人，不要心思高傲，也不要寄望於無定的錢財，只要寄望於那將百物豐富的供給我們享受的神；
refs.text_en: Charge those who are rich in the present age not to be high-minded, nor to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches but on God, who affords us all things richly for our enjoyment;

verses.text_gb: 但那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，也领悟了，他就结出果[Cra]实，有的结了一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
verses.text_big5: 但那撒在好土裏的，就是人聽了道，也領悟了，他就結出果[Cra]實，有的結了一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
verses.text_en: But the one sown on the good earth, this is he who hears the word and understands, who by all means bears fruit and produces, one a hundredfold, and one sixtyfold, and one thirtyfold.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，也领悟了，他就结出果实，有的结了一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但那撒在好土裏的，就是人聽了道，也領悟了，他就結出果實，有的結了一百倍，有的六十倍，有的三十倍。

refs.text_gb: 是因那给你们存在诸天之上的盼望，就是你们从前在福音真理的话上所听见的；
refs.text_big5: 是因那給你們存在諸天之上的盼望，就是你們從前在福音真理的話上所聽見的；
refs.text_en: Because of the hope laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel,

refs.text_gb: 这福音传到你们那里，也传到全世界，一直结果增长，正如在你们中间，自从你们听见，并在真实中认识神恩典的日子一样；
refs.text_big5: 這福音傳到你們那裏，也傳到全世界，一直結果增長，正如在你們中間，自從你們聽見，並在真實中認識神恩典的日子一樣；
refs.text_en: Which has come to you, even as it is also in all the world, bearing fruit and growing, as also in you, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;

verses.text_gb: 耶稣在他们跟前另设一个比喻，说，诸[Fn1][Cra]天的国好比人[Crb]撒好种[Crc]在他的田里；
verses.text_big5: 耶穌在他們跟前另設一個比喻，說，諸[Fn1][Cra]天的國好比人[Crb]撒好種[Crc]在他的田裏；
verses.text_en: Another parable He set before them, saying, The kingdom of the heavens has become like a man sowing good seed in his field.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣在他们跟前另设一个比喻，说，诸天的国好比人撒好种在他的田里；
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌在他們跟前另設一個比喻，說，諸天的國好比人撒好種在他的田裏；

footnotes.zh: 从第二个比喻，主开始说，诸天的国好比。因为当五旬节召会建造时(十六18～19)，诸天的国才开始建立，第二个比喻才开始应验。从那时，就是召会建立以后，稗子，假信徒，便撒在真信徒，麦子，中间，成为天国的外表。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從第二個比喻，主開始說，諸天的國好比。因為當五旬節召會建造時，（十六18～19，）諸天的國纔開始建立，第二個比喻纔開始應驗。從那時，就是召會建立以後，稗子，假信徒，便撒在真信徒，麥子，中間，成為天國的外表。
footnotes.en: 13:24 1 kingdom In this, the second, parable the Lord began to say, "The kingdom of the heavens is (or, has become) like...," because the kingdom of the heavens began to be established when this parable began to be fulfilled, i.e., on the day of Pentecost, when the church was built (Matt. 16:18-19). It was from that time, after the church had been founded, that the tares, the false believers, were sown among the true believers, the wheat, forming the appearance of the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣在他们跟前另设一个比喻，说，诸天的国好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在他的田里。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌在他們跟前另設一個比喻，說，諸天的國好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在他的田裏。
refs.text_en: Another parable He set before them, saying, The kingdom of the heavens is like a mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field,

refs.text_gb: 祂对他们另讲一个比喻说，诸天的国好像面酵，有妇人拿去藏在三斗面里，直到全团都发了酵。
refs.text_big5: 祂對他們另講一個比喻說，諸天的國好像麵酵，有婦人拿去藏在三斗麵裏，直到全團都發了酵。
refs.text_en: Another parable He spoke to them: The kingdom of the heavens is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal until the whole was leavened.

refs.text_gb: 诸天的国好像宝贝藏在田地里，人找到了，就藏起来，欢欢喜喜地去变卖他一切所有的，买这田地。
refs.text_big5: 諸天的國好像寶貝藏在田地裏，人找到了，就藏起來，歡歡喜喜的去變賣他一切所有的，買這田地。
refs.text_en: The kingdom of the heavens is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid, and in his joy goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

refs.text_gb: 诸天的国又好像一个商人，寻找好珠子，
refs.text_big5: 諸天的國又好像一個商人，尋找好珠子，
refs.text_en: Again, the kingdom of the heavens is like a merchant seeking fine pearls;

refs.text_big5: 還有，諸天的國好像網撒在海裏，聚攏各樣的水族。
refs.text_en: Again, the kingdom of the heavens is like a net cast into the sea and gathering from every species,

refs.text_gb: 你们要悔改，因为诸天的国已经临近了。
refs.text_big5: 你們要悔改，因為諸天的國已經臨近了。
refs.text_en: And saying, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.

refs.text_gb: 祂就回答说，那撒好种的就是人子，
refs.text_big5: 祂就回答說，那撒好種的就是人子，
refs.text_en: And He answered and said, He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man;

refs.text_gb: 田地就是世界，好种就是国度之子，稗子就是恶者之子，
refs.text_big5: 田地就是世界，好種就是國度之子，稗子就是惡者之子，
refs.text_en: And the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the tares are the sons of the evil one;

verses.text_gb: 及至人[Fn1]们睡觉的时候，他的仇[Cra]敌来了，将稗[Fn2][Crb]子撒在麦[Fn3]子中间，就走了。
verses.text_big5: 及至人[Fn1]們睡覺的時候，他的仇[Cra]敵來了，將稗[Fn2][Crb]子撒在麥[Fn3]子中間，就走了。
verses.text_en: But while the men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares in the midst of the wheat and went away.
verses.text_gb_plain: 及至人们睡觉的时候，他的仇敌来了，将稗子撒在麦子中间，就走了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 及至人們睡覺的時候，他的仇敵來了，將稗子撒在麥子中間，就走了。

footnotes.zh: “人们”是奴仆(27)，指主的奴仆，主要的是使徒。当主的奴仆睡觉、不儆醒时，主的仇敌魔鬼，便来把假信徒撒在真信徒中间。
footnotes.zh_big5: “人們”是奴僕，（27，）指主的奴僕，主要的是使徒。當主的奴僕睡覺、不儆醒時，主的仇敵魔鬼，便來把假信徒撒在真信徒中間。
footnotes.en: 13:25 1 men The men were the slaves (v. 27), referring to the Lord's slaves, mainly the apostles. It was when the Lord's slaves were sleeping and were not watching that the Lord's enemy, the devil, came and sowed false believers among the true.

footnotes.zh: 稗子是一种毒麦，是类似麦子的杂草，种子有毒，叫人昏睡、呕吐、痉挛，甚至死亡。稗子的芽和叶看起来与麦子一样，必须到吐穗的时候，二者才能分辨出来。麦穗呈金黄色，稗穗呈黑色。
footnotes.zh_big5: 稗子是一種毒麥，是類似麥子的雜草，種子有毒，叫人昏睡、嘔吐、痙攣，甚至死亡。稗子的芽和葉看起來與麥子一樣，必須到吐穗的時候，二者纔能分辨出來。麥穗呈金黃色，稗穗呈黑色。
footnotes.en: 13:25 2 tares A tare is a kind of darnel, a weed resembling wheat. Its seeds are poisonous and can cause sleepiness, nausea, convulsions, and even death. The sprout and leaves of tares look the same as those of wheat. It is impossible to distinguish wheat from tares until the fruit is produced. The fruit of the wheat is golden yellow, but that of the tares is black.

footnotes.zh: 旧约把神国里的以色列人，比作长在葡萄园的葡萄(二一33～34)；但新约把诸天之国里的国度子民，比作长在田里的麦子。葡萄园是围起来的，只限于犹太人；但田是遍及世界的、开放的，不限于任何民族。
footnotes.zh_big5: 舊約把神國裏的以色列人，比作長在葡萄園的葡萄；（二一33～34；）但新約把諸天之國裏的國度子民，比作長在田裏的麥子。葡萄園是圍起來的，只限於猶太人；但田是遍及世界的、開放的，不限於任何民族。
footnotes.en: 13:25 3 wheat In the Old Testament the children of Israel, who were in the kingdom of God, were likened to grapes growing in the vineyard (Matt. 21:33-34), whereas in the New Testament the kingdom people, who are in the kingdom of the heavens, are likened to wheat growing in the field. The vineyard was fenced, limited, and included only the Jews, whereas the field is worldwide, open, unlimited, and includes all peoples.

refs.text_en: For uttering great swelling words of vanity, they entice by lusts of the flesh, with licentiousness, those who are barely escaping from them who live in error;

refs.text_en: For if, having escaped the defilements of the world by the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ but having again been entangled in these, they are defeated, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

refs.text_gb: 他们认识义路，竟转离所传授给他们神圣的诫命，倒不如不认识为妙。

refs.text_en: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

refs.text_gb: 俗语说得真对，狗所吐的，它转过来又吃；猪洗净了，又到泥里去滚。这话在他们身上发生了。
refs.text_big5: 俗語說得真對，狗所吐的，牠轉過來又喫；豬洗淨了，又到泥裏去滾。這話在他們身上發生了。
refs.text_en: It has happened to them according to the true proverb: The dog has turned to its own vomit, and the washed sow to wallowing in the mud.

refs.text_gb: 但要远避世俗的空谈，因为这些空谈必进而成为更不敬虔。

refs.text_en: But avoid profane, vain babblings, for they will advance to more ungodliness,

refs.text_en: And their word will spread like gangrene, of whom are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

refs.text_big5: 他們在真理上偏離了目標，說復活的事已過，就傾覆一些人的信心。
refs.text_en: Who concerning the truth have misaimed, saying that the resurrection has already taken place, and overthrow the faith of some.

refs.text_gb: 然而，神坚固的根基立住了，上面有这印记说，主认识属于祂的人。又说，凡称呼主名的人，总要离开不义。

refs.text_en: However the firm foundation of God stands, having this seal, The Lord knows those who are His, and, Let everyone who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.

refs.text_en: If therefore anyone cleanses himself from these, he will be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, useful to the master, prepared unto every good work.

verses.text_big5: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。

verses.text_big5: 家主的奴僕就進前來對他說，主阿，你不是撒好種在你的田裏麼？從那裏來的稗子？

footnotes.zh: 稗子和麦子一齐长在田里，田乃是世界(38)。假信徒和真信徒都活在世界里。从田里薅集稗子，意思是将假信徒从世上除去。主不要祂的奴仆这样作，免得将假信徒从世上除去的时候，也将真信徒从世上除去。罗马天主教就是作了不少这样的事，杀害了许多真信徒。
footnotes.zh_big5: 稗子和麥子一齊長在田裏，田乃是世界。（38。）假信徒和真信徒都活在世界裏。從田裏薅集稗子，意思是將假信徒從世上除去。主不要祂的奴僕這樣作，免得將假信徒從世上除去的時候，也將真信徒從世上除去。羅馬天主教就是作了不少這樣的事，殺害了許多真信徒。
footnotes.en: 13:29 1 collecting Both the tares and the wheat grow in the field, and the field is the world (v. 38). The false believers and the true live in the world. To collect the tares from the field means to take away the false believers from the world. The Lord did not want His slaves to do this, because while taking away the false believers from the world, they might also take the true ones away. The Catholic Church did this very much and by so doing killed many true believers.

footnotes.zh: 头两个比喻的麦子，和这里第三个比喻的芥菜，都是作食物的。这指明国度的子民，就是国度和召会的构成分子，都该像庄稼一样出产食物，让神和人同得满足。

This indicates that the kingdom people, the constituents of the kingdom and of the church, should be like a crop that produces food for the satisfaction of God and man.

footnotes.zh: 召会是国度的具体表现，该像菜蔬一样生产食物，却成了树，作飞鸟的宿处，其性质和功用都变了(这违反神创造的律，植物必须各从其类——创一11～12)。这事发生在第四世纪初叶，康士坦丁大帝把世界搀入召会时。他把成千成万的假信徒带进召会，使其变成基督教国，而不再是召会了。因此，这第三个比喻相当于启二、三里，七个召会的第三个，在别迦摩的召会(启二12～17，见12注1)。芥菜是一年生的菜蔬，树是多年生的植物。召会按其属天、属灵的性质，该像芥菜一样寄居地上。但召会的性质改变了，像树一样深深扎根、定居地上，其事业繁茂如同枝条，许多恶人、恶事栖宿其上。这形成了诸天之国外表的外在组织。
footnotes.zh_big5: 召會是國度的具體表現，該像菜蔬一樣生產食物，卻成了樹，作飛鳥的宿處，其性質和功用都變了。（這違反神創造的律，植物必須各從其類─創一11～12。）這事發生在第四世紀初葉，康士坦丁大帝把世界攙入召會時。他把成千成萬的假信徒帶進召會，使其變成基督教國，而不再是召會了。因此，這第三個比喻相當於啟二、三裏，七個召會的第三個，在別迦摩的召會。（啟二12～17，見12註1。）芥菜是一年生的菜蔬，樹是多年生的植物。召會按其屬天、屬靈的性質，該像芥菜一樣寄居地上。但召會的性質改變了，像樹一樣深深扎根、定居地上，其事業繁茂如同枝條，許多惡人、惡事棲宿其上。這形成了諸天之國外表的外在組織。
footnotes.en: 13:32 1 tree The church, which is the embodiment of the kingdom, should be like an herb that produces food. However, its nature and function were changed, so that it became a "tree," a lodging place for birds. (This is against the law of God's creation, that is, that every plant must be after its kind — Gen. 1:11-12.) This change happened in the first part of the fourth century, when Constantine the Great mixed the church with the world. He brought thousands of false believers into Christianity, making it Christendom, no longer the church. Hence, this third parable corresponds with the third of the seven churches in Rev. 2 and Rev. 3, the church in Pergamos (Rev. 2:12-17 — see note Rev. 2:12 1 ). The mustard is an annual herb, whereas the tree is a perennial plant. The church, according to its heavenly and spiritual nature, should be like the mustard, sojourning on the earth. But with its nature changed, the church became deeply rooted and settled as a tree in the earth, flourishing with its enterprises as the branches in which many evil persons and things are lodged. This resulted in the formation of the outward organization of the outward appearance of the kingdom of the heavens.

footnotes.en: 13:33 1 leaven In the Scriptures leaven signifies evil things (1 Cor. 5:6, 8) and evil doctrines (Matt. 16:6, 11-12).

footnotes.zh: 召会既是实行的诸天之国，有基督，那无酵的细面为内容，就必定是无酵的饼(林前五7～8)。然而，由这里妇人所象征，那在第六世纪完全且正式形成的罗马天主教，采取了许多异教的作法、异端的道理和邪恶的事物，将其搀到关于基督的教训里，使基督教的全部内容都发了酵。这第四个比喻相当于启二、三里，七个召会中的第四个，在推雅推喇的召会(启二18～29，见20注3)。这成为诸天之国外表的腐败内容。
footnotes.zh_big5: 召會既是實行的諸天之國，有基督，那無酵的細麵為內容，就必定是無酵的餅。（林前五7～8。）然而，由這裏婦人所象徵，那在第六世紀完全且正式形成的羅馬天主教，採取了許多異教的作法、異端的道理和邪惡的事物，將其攙到關於基督的教訓裏，使基督教的全部內容都發了酵。這第四個比喻相當於啟二、三裏，七個召會中的第四個，在推雅推喇的召會。（啟二18～29，見20註3。）這成為諸天之國外表的腐敗內容。
footnotes.en: 13:33 2 woman The church as the practical kingdom of the heavens, with Christ, the unleavened fine flour, as its content, must be a loaf of unleavened bread (1 Cor. 5:7-8). However, the Catholic Church, which was fully and officially formed in the sixth century and which is signified by the woman here, took in many pagan practices, heretical doctrines, and evil matters and mixed them with the teachings concerning Christ, leavening the whole content of Christianity. This mixture became the corrupted content of the outward appearance of the kingdom of the heavens. This fourth parable corresponds with the fourth of the seven churches in Rev. 2 and Rev. 3, the church in Thyatira (Rev. 2:18-29 — see note Rev. 2:20 1 ).

footnotes.zh: “面”是为作素祭(利二1)，象征基督是神和人的食物。“三斗”乃是作一全餐所需之量(创十八6)。因此，把酵藏在三斗面里，象征天主教暗中使一切关于基督的教训都发了酵。这是罗马天主教真实的光景，完全违反了圣经，圣经是严禁在素祭中搀酵的(利二4～5，11)。
footnotes.zh_big5: “麵”是為作素祭，（利二1，）象徵基督是神和人的食物。“三斗”乃是作一全餐所需之量。（創十八6。）因此，把酵藏在三斗麵裏，象徵天主教暗中使一切關於基督的教訓都發了酵。這是羅馬天主教真實的光景，完全違反了聖經，聖經是嚴禁在素祭中攙酵的。（利二4～5，11。）
footnotes.en: 13:33 3 meal Meal, for making the meal offering (Lev. 2:1), signifies Christ as food to both God and man. Three measures is the quantity needed to make a full meal (Gen. 18:6). Hence, the hiding of the leaven in three measures of meal signifies that the Catholic Church has fully leavened in a hidden way all the teachings concerning Christ. This is the actual situation in the Roman Catholic Church. Such leavening is absolutely against the Scriptures, which strongly forbid putting any leaven into the meal offering (Lev. 2:4-5, 11).

refs.text_en: But while the men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares in the midst of the wheat and went away.

refs.text_big5: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。
refs.text_en: And when the blade sprouted and produced fruit, then the tares appeared also.

refs.text_big5: 他就對他們說，這是仇敵作的。奴僕就對他說，那麼你要我們去薅集它們麼？
refs.text_en: And he said to them, An enemy has done this. And the slaves said to him, Do you want us then to go and collect them?

refs.text_big5: 他就說，不，免得薅集稗子，連麥子也一齊帶根薅出來。
refs.text_en: But he said, No, lest while collecting the tares, you uproot the wheat along with them.

refs.text_gb: 让这两样一齐长，直到收割。在收割的时候，我要对收割的人说，先薅集稗子，捆成捆，好把它们烧了，麦子却要收到我的仓里。

refs.text_en: Let both grow together until the harvest, and at the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, Collect first the tares and bind them into bundles to burn them up, but the wheat gather into my barn.

footnotes.zh: 这比喻揭示，借着召会的建造，国度得着建立后不久，诸天之国的情形就起了变化。国度是由国度之子，麦子，建立起来的，但恶者之子，稗子，长起来改变了情形。于是，诸天的国及其外表就产生了差异。国度之子，麦子，构成了国度；恶者之子，稗子，形成了国度的外表，就是今天所谓的基督教国。
footnotes.en: 13:38 1 good; tares This parable discloses that not long after the kingdom was established through the building of the church, the situation of the kingdom of the heavens changed. The kingdom was established with the sons of the kingdom, the wheat. But the sons of the evil one, the tares, grew up to alter the situation. Hence, a difference has arisen between the kingdom of the heavens and its outward appearance. The sons of the kingdom, the wheat, constitute the kingdom, whereas the sons of the evil one, the tares, have formed the outward appearance of the kingdom, which today is called Christendom.

refs.text_big5: 你們是出於那父魔鬼，你們父的私慾，你們願意行。他從起初就是殺人的，並且不站在真理中，因為在他裏面沒有真理。他說謊是出於他自己的私有物，因他是說謊的，也是說謊者的父。
refs.text_en: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks the lie, he speaks it out of his own possessions; for he is a liar and the father of it.

refs.text_gb: 你这满了各样诡诈和奸恶，魔鬼的儿子，众义的仇敌，你歪曲主的正路，还不止住么？

refs.text_en: And said, O you who are full of all deceit and all unscrupulousness, son of the devil, enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease perverting the straight ways of the Lord?

refs.text_en: In this the children of God and the children of the devil are manifest. Everyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, neither he who does not love his brother.
